papers.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
papers.summary: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 面向FP4解码的系统化方案，实用价值高但泛化待证。
pros: 算法与系统协同设计完整，针对三类误差有明确机制
端到端吞吐提升显著，并覆盖Dense/MoE与多注意力形态
cons: 结果高度依赖特定硬件与内核实现，跨平台收益和可复现性风险仍需更多独立验证

papers.title_zh: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法系统协同设计进行本机 FP4 KV 缓存解码
papers.summary_zh: 键值 (KV) 缓存在长上下文 LLM 服务中主导内存容量和带宽。虽然 4 位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）缩小了缓存并在 FP4 Tensor Core 上运行注意力，但算法量化和系统感知加速之间仍然存在根本差距：现有 FP4 KV 系统使用普通量化，导致精度严重下降，而面向精度的 4 位算法依赖于矢量码本，其查找开销会降低解码吞吐量。我们提出了 BitDecoding-FP4，这是一种算法系统协同设计，用于准确高效的本地 FP4 KV 解码。我们减轻了三个错误源：双残差查询量化将查询拆分为两个 FP4 张量，将查询 logit 错误从 60% 减少到 1%；下溢感知概率缩放可防止 E4M3 缩放将长上下文概率舍入为零；离群值感知关键量化结合了静态平滑、Hadamard 旋转和尺度搜索，以抑制 token-wise 缩放下的关键离群值。在系统层面，我们通过转置softmax与融合概率量化和分页KV缓存上的堆叠查询MMA来消除softmax瓶颈。在具有 GQA 和 MLA 的密集模型和 MoE 模型中，BitDecoding-FP4 使用 NVFP4 时的 BF16 KV 精度保持在 0.5 点以内（使用 MXFP4 时为 1 点），并在 RL 训练中跟踪 BF16 KV。在采用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 NVIDIA B300 上进行端到端服务时，它的峰值服务吞吐量比 BF16 KV 高 2.4-3.0$\times$。该实现可在 https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4 上找到。

papers.title: FOSCAR: Accelerating Decode Attention over 2- and 4-Bit KV Caches through Affine Folding
papers.summary: Large-language-model decode attention streams the key-value (KV) cache for every generated token. Packing that cache into 2-bit or 4-bit quantized integers reduces memory traffic but does not automatically translate into latency saving. Existing 2-bit fused kernels reach under 31%/15% of peak HBM throughput on H100/B200. Converting each value and applying its scale and offset before feeding Tensor Cores is a major bottleneck because instruction-issue throughput is scarce on modern GPUs. Instead of applying scale and offset to each KV value, FOSCAR uses affine folding to apply them to the other operand or the output of decode-attention matrix products, depending on the quantization scheme (token-wise or channel-wise). This reduces scale-and-offset operations by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving the dequantized attention output in exact arithmetic. FOSCAR also uses bit manipulation to feed KV operands to Tensor Cores efficiently, requiring only 1 and 0.19 ALU instructions per INT2 element on H100 and B200, respectively. Finally, FOSCAR builds warp-specialized GPU pipelines for Hopper (H100) and Blackwell (B200) using wgmma and tcgen05. On H100, FOSCAR INT2 and INT4 kernels achieve geo-mean speedups of $3.36\times$ and $2.83\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, and $2.03\times$ and $1.71\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8. On B200, the corresponding INT2 and INT4 speedups are $2.67\times$ and $2.30\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, $1.48\times$ and $1.28\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8, and $1.16\times$ and $1.00\times$ over TensorRT-LLM NVFP4. We integrate FOSCAR into SGLang to benchmark serving efficiency. On long-context serving workloads, FOSCAR increases peak aggregate throughput by up to 170% and 341% over 2-bit and 16-bit baselines, respectively. We open-source FOSCAR as a kernel library at https://github.com/FutureMLS-Lab/FOSCAR.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程创新扎实，潜在影响大但证据仍需补强。
pros: 提出仿射折叠将反量化代价转移并显著减少标量操作，思路新且贴合GPU瓶颈。
在H100/B200与多基线对比中报告了稳定加速，并给出端到端服务吞吐提升与开源实现。
cons: 摘要缺少精度退化、数值稳定性、跨模型泛化与统计显著性细节，且收益可能依赖特定硬件与内核实现。

papers.title_zh: FOSCAR：通过仿射折叠加速 2 位和 4 位 KV 缓存上的解码注意力
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型解码注意力流为每个生成的令牌传输键值 (KV) 缓存。将缓存打包成 2 位或 4 位量化整数可以减少内存流量，但不会自动转化为延迟节省。现有的 2 位融合内核在 H100/B200 上达到峰值 HBM 吞吐量的 31%/15% 以下。在向 Tensor Core 提供数据之前转换每个值并应用其比例和偏移量是一个主要瓶颈，因为现代 GPU 上指令发出的吞吐量很少。 FOSCAR 没有将缩放和偏移应用于每个 KV 值，而是使用仿射折叠将它们应用于其他操作数或解码注意矩阵乘积的输出，具体取决于量化方案（令牌方式或通道方式）。这将缩放和偏移操作减少了两个数量级，同时以精确的算术保留了反量化的注意力输出。 FOSCAR 还使用位操作有效地将 KV 操作数馈送到 Tensor Core，在 H100 和 B200 上每个 INT2 元素分别只需要 1 条和 0.19 条 ALU 指令。最后，FOSCAR 使用 wgmma 和 tcgen05 为 Hopper (H100) 和 Blackwell (B200) 构建了扭曲专用 GPU 管道。在 H100 上，FOSCAR INT2 和 INT4 内核的几何平均加速比 FlashInfer BF16 分别为 $3.36\times$ 和 $2.83\times$，比 TensorRT-LLM FP8 实现 $2.03\times$ 和 $1.71\times$。在 B200 上，相对应的 INT2 和 INT4 加速比 FlashInfer BF16 分别为 $2.67\times$ 和 $2.30\times$，相对于 TensorRT-LLM FP8 分别为 $1.48\times$ 和 $1.28\times$，相对于 TensorRT-LLM NVFP4 分别为 $1.16\times$ 和 $1.00\times$。我们将 FOSCAR 集成到 SGLang 中以衡量服务效率。在长上下文服务工作负载上，FOSCAR 使峰值聚合吞吐量比 2 位和 16 位基准分别提高了 170% 和 341%。我们在 https://github.com/FutureMLS-Lab/FOSCAR 上开源了 FOSCAR 作为内核库。

papers.title: Intent-Aware Caching for Efficient LLM Serving
papers.summary: Modern LLM serving systems use prefix caching to accelerate multi-turn conversational workloads. They cache the key-value states of previous conversation prefixes and reuse them when subsequent requests share the same prefix, to avoid redundant prefill computation and reduce serving latency. However, achieving a high cache hit rate remains challenging because cache reuse depends on whether a conversation continues and how soon the next turn arrives. Our analysis of real workloads shows that user intent is a useful signal for this behavior, as different intents exhibit different continuation probabilities and inter-turn delays. Based on this key insight, we propose Intent-Aware Caching (IAC), an online eviction policy that classifies requests by intent, learns lightweight reuse statistics from recent serving logs and leverages these statistics to guide an oracle-inspired eviction strategy. Extensive evaluation on real workloads (WildChat and ShareChat) shows that IAC reaches a 34.6% cache hit rate. This substantially outperforms both the previous learning-based approach (18.8%) and traditional methods such as least recently used (LRU, 12.2%), while reducing average serving latency by up to 46.1%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，结果显著但证据仍偏摘要级。
pros: 抓住前缀缓存命中率低的关键瓶颈，动机与场景契合真实多轮服务
利用意图信号建模继续对话概率与间隔时间，方法直观且工程可落地
cons: 创新更偏策略整合而非机制突破，摘要未说明分类误差、开销与鲁棒性边界

papers.title_zh: 用于高效 LLM 服务的意图感知缓存
papers.summary_zh: 现代 LLM 服务系统使用前缀缓存来加速多轮会话工作负载。它们缓存先前会话前缀的键值状态，并在后续请求共享相同前缀时重用它们，以避免冗余预填充计算并减少服务延迟。然而，实现高缓存命中率仍然具有挑战性，因为缓存重用取决于会话是否继续以及下一轮到达的时间。我们对实际工作负载的分析表明，用户意图是这种行为的有用信号，因为不同的意图表现出不同的持续概率和轮间延迟。基于这一关键见解，我们提出了意图感知缓存（IAC），这是一种在线逐出策略，可按意图对请求进行分类，从最近的服务日志中学习轻量级重用统计数据，并利用这些统计数据来指导受预言机启发的逐出策略。对实际工作负载（WildChat 和 ShareChat）的广泛评估表明，IAC 的缓存命中率达到 34.6%。这大大优于之前基于学习的方法 (18.8%) 和最近最少使用的传统方法 (LRU，12.2%)，同时将平均服务延迟降低高达 46.1%。

papers.title: Transformer-FSQ: Discrete Latents for Extreme KV-Cache Compression
papers.summary: Private, personalised language models must run on local consumer devices, where large, frontier models cannot fit, and retaining long contexts is non-trivial. Sequential memory---the key-value (KV) cache---grows linearly with context length, quickly dwarfing the model itself: for Qwen3-1.7B-Base, 200,000 retained entries require 21 GiB, 6.6 times more than the model weights. Yet the KV-cache compression methods we measured fail beyond moderate compression ratios. We introduce Transformer-FSQ, addressing extreme KV-cache compression by replacing standard key and value projections with a finite scalar quantisation bottleneck. Our cache stores a packed vector of discrete integer codes per token, with no per-token quantisation metadata. Converting a pretrained transformer trains only these projections on 0.25 tokens per original parameter. We evaluate Transformer-FSQ against five baseline families on models from 0.6B to 8B parameters. On long-context retrieval (RULER), from 12$\times$ to 97.5$\times$ Transformer-FSQ is the most accurate method we evaluate, across scales. A fused Triton kernel decodes directly from the integer codes; with baselines given their authors' kernels where available, it decodes at $1.01\times$ (95% interval $0.98$--$1.05$) the throughput of native SDPA attention on the uncompressed Qwen3-8B-Base at $32\times$ and $1.54\times$ at $97.5\times$. Extreme KV-cache compression is therefore a practical way to extend how much context a fixed device can hold.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、结果亮眼，但证据仍需更全面。
pros: 聚焦本地长上下文KV缓存瓶颈，问题设定具现实紧迫性。
提出离散潜变量缓存并配合融合内核，在超高压缩比下兼顾精度与吞吐。
cons: 仅凭摘要难判断泛化与稳健性，缺少跨任务、跨语言及生成质量退化分析。
训练仅改投影层虽高效，但对不同架构/分布迁移成本与失败案例未充分披露。

papers.title_zh: Transformer-FSQ：极端 KV 缓存压缩的离散潜伏
papers.summary_zh: 私有的、个性化的语言模型必须在本地消费者设备上运行，大型的前沿模型无法适应，并且保留长上下文也并非易事。顺序内存——键值 (KV) 缓存——随着上下文长度线性增长，很快使模型本身相形见绌：对于 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，200,000 个保留条目需要 21 GiB，是模型权重的 6.6 倍。然而，我们测量的 KV 缓存压缩方法超出了中等压缩率。我们引入了 Transformer-FSQ，通过用有限标量量化瓶颈替换标准键和值投影来解决极端的 KV 缓存压缩问题。我们的缓存存储每个令牌的离散整数代码的打包向量，没有每个令牌的量化元数据。转换预训练的 Transformer 仅在每个原始参数 0.25 个标记上训练这些投影。我们针对从 0.6B 到 8B 参数的模型的五个基线系列来评估 Transformer-FSQ。在长上下文检索 (RULER) 上，从 12$\times$ 到 97.5$\times$ Transformer-FSQ 是我们跨尺度评估的最准确的方法。融合的 Triton 内核直接从整数代码解码；在给定作者可用内核的基线下，它以 $1.01\times$（95% 间隔 $0.98$-$1.05$）解码未压缩 Qwen3-8B-Base 上的本机 SDPA 注意力的吞吐量为 $32\times$ 和 $1.54\times$ 以及 $97.5\times$。因此，极限 KV 缓存压缩是扩展固定设备可以容纳的上下文量的实用方法。

papers.title: Nebula: Distributed Position-Independent Caching for LLM Serving
papers.summary: Modern LLM workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and LLM agents, build long prompts from multiple independent text segments, making prefill a major source of computation. Reusing KV caches is therefore important for reducing serving costs and latency: distributed caching systems spread KV cache across a cluster to increase aggregate capacity, while position-independent caching (PIC) enables reuse of recurring segments under different prefixes. However, existing systems distribute KV caches but still rely on prefix caching (PC), while existing PIC methods enable position-independent reuse without cluster-wide resource management. We present Nebula, the first distributed LLM serving framework to treat PIC segments as first-class citizens, enabling remote PIC reuse and parallel prefill. To track PIC's fine-grained, asynchronous state changes, Nebula combines optimistic accounting with event-driven updates to provide a timely and truthful cluster view for cache management and prefill scheduling. To accommodate diverse reuse patterns across workloads, Nebula leverages cluster-wide ghost-hit feedback to automatically tune the allocation of shared cache capacity between PC and PIC. Finally, Nebula incorporates queueing, computation, and KV transfer costs into a unified prefill completion time model to guide elastic parallelism adjustment and locality-aware compute placement. Across four models and four real-world RAG and agentic workloads, Nebula reduces median TTFT by an average of 61.4% compared with the strongest existing baseline and recovers an average of 76.1% of the tokens missed by prefix caching.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，系统创新强，但严谨性待细证。
pros: 首次将位置无关缓存作为分布式一等公民，整合远程复用与并行prefill
联合容量自适应与时延建模，面向RAG/Agent场景有较高实用价值
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融与开销细节（如控制面一致性代价、跨负载稳定性与泛化边界），当前证据更偏经验有效

papers.title_zh: Nebula：用于 LLM 服务的分布式位置无关缓存
papers.summary_zh: 现代 LLM 工作流程，例如检索增强生成 (RAG) 和 LLM 代理，从多个独立文本段构建长提示，使预填充成为主要的计算来源。因此，重用 KV 缓存对于降低服务成本和延迟非常重要：分布式缓存系统将 KV 缓存分布在集群中以增加聚合容量，而位置无关缓存 (PIC) 可以重用不同前缀下的重复段。然而，现有系统分布 KV 缓存，但仍然依赖前缀缓存 (PC)，而现有 PIC 方法可以实现与位置无关的重用，无需集群范围的资源管理。我们推出了 Nebula，这是第一个将 PIC 段视为一等公民的分布式 LLM 服务框架，支持远程 PIC 重用和并行预填充。为了跟踪 PIC 的细粒度、异步状态变化，Nebula 将乐观统计与事件驱动的更新相结合，为缓存管理和预填充调度提供及时、真实的集群视图。为了适应跨工作负载的不同重用模式，Nebula 利用集群范围的幽灵命中反馈来自动调整 PC 和 PIC 之间共享缓存容量的分配。最后，Nebula 将排队、计算和 KV 传输成本合并到统一的预填充完成时间模型中，以指导弹性并行调整和局部感知计算布局。在四个模型和四个现实世界的 RAG 和代理工作负载中，与最强的现有基线相比，Nebula 将 TTFT 中值平均降低了 61.4%，并平均恢复了前缀缓存丢失的 76.1% 的令牌。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Issues in GPU Kernel Libraries for LLM Systems
papers.summary: Behind the expanding use of large language models (LLMs) across application domains lies a growing dependence on specialized GPU kernel libraries. These libraries underpin the correctness and efficiency of training and inference across diverse GPU platforms, implementing attention, GEMM, quantization, and low-precision operators while managing tensor shapes, memory layouts, code generation, and hardware-specific dispatch. Problems at this layer can silently corrupt outputs, hang GPUs, prevent compilation, introduce deployment incompatibilities, or degrade performance, thereby reducing developer productivity and wasting expensive GPU resources. We present the first comprehensive empirical study of issues in GPU kernel libraries for LLM systems. We manually analyzed 300 high-quality GitHub issue reports, their discussions, and available fixes from seven representative libraries: FlashInfer, FlashAttention, Triton, CUTLASS, DeepGEMM, xFormers, and bitsandbytes. The analysis characterizes symptoms, root causes, fixes, and testing and debugging practices. Our main findings are: (1) 60.33% of the sampled issues originate in the Compiler and Build System or Runtime Environment dimensions, so validation must cover the deployment and execution stack, not just kernel code. (2) Kernel specialization imposes implicit correctness constraints on tensor shapes, metadata layouts, memory aliasing, and hardware resources. Violations can produce incorrect outputs or launch failures even for supported operations, highlighting the need for explicit contract validation and boundary-case testing. (3) Current testing and debugging practices are often insufficient for identifying low-precision numerical problems and hardware-specific execution failures. We outline research opportunities and tooling directions to support future LLM GPU kernel development.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且实证扎实，但方法创新有限
pros: 聚焦LLM内核库真实工程痛点，实践价值高
覆盖七个代表性库并给出可操作的测试调试方向
cons: 主要基于300个Issue的归纳，外部效度与可重复性仍需更强量化验证

papers.title_zh: LLM 系统 GPU 内核库问题的实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 在跨应用领域扩大使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的背后，是对专用 GPU 内核库的日益依赖。这些库支持跨不同 GPU 平台训练和推理的正确性和效率，实现注意力、GEMM、量化和低精度运算符，同时管理张量形状、内存布局、代码生成和特定于硬件的调度。这一层的问题可能会悄悄地破坏输出、挂起 GPU、阻止编译、引入部署不兼容性或降低性能，从而降低开发人员的工作效率并浪费昂贵的 GPU 资源。我们首次针对 LLM 系统的 GPU 内核库问题进行了全面的实证研究。我们手动分析了 300 个高质量的 GitHub 问题报告、它们的讨论以及来自七个代表性库的可用修复：FlashInfer、FlashAttention、Triton、CUTLASS、DeepGEMM、xFormers 和 bitsandbytes。该分析描述了症状、根本原因、修复以及测试和调试实践的特征。我们的主要发现是：(1) 60.33% 的抽样问题源自编译器和构建系统或运行时环境维度，因此验证必须涵盖部署和执行堆栈，而不仅仅是内核代码。 (2) 内核专门化对张量形状、元数据布局、内存别名和硬件资源施加隐式正确性约束。即使对于受支持的操作，违规也可能会产生不正确的输出或启动失败，这凸显了显式合同验证和边界情况测试的必要性。 (3) 当前的测试和调试实践通常不足以识别低精度数值问题和特定于硬件的执行故障。我们概述了支持未来 LLM GPU 内核开发的研究机会和工具方向。

papers.title: DARIC: A Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse System with Distribution-Aware Recomputation
papers.summary: The context lengths of large language models (LLMs) are rapidly increasing in real-world applications such as agentic systems and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). To accelerate LLM inference in these scenarios, reusing position-independent key-value (KV) caches across requests has emerged as a promising approach. This technique typically relies on recomputing a selected subset of tokens to restore cross-chunk interactions. However, existing solutions suffer from critical limitations in both algorithmic efficiency and system deployment. Algorithmically, they overlook the distribution of KV cache deviations, leading to either high token-selection overhead or degraded generation quality. At the system level, the reliance on custom LLM execution flows for recomputation complicates deployment and prevents seamless integration with highly optimized inference engines. In this paper, we propose DARIC (\textbf{D}istribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ecomputation for \textbf{I}ndependent KV \textbf{C}ache Reuse), a novel KV cache reuse method based on system-algorithm co-design. At its core, DARIC introduces a distribution-aware token selection strategy that adaptively schedules token recomputation based on empirical KV deviation patterns, striking an optimal balance between generation quality and computational efficiency. Moreover, DARIC is built on a lightweight system architecture that enables independent KV cache generation and recomputation with minimal integration overhead, fully preserving existing system-level optimizations of standard inference engines. Comprehensive experiments across various datasets and LLMs demonstrate that DARIC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a 1.1$\times$--4.5$\times$ speedup in time-to-first-token (TTFT) with negligible loss in generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/Lenovo-ICI/DARIC.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但方法增量性偏强
pros: 聚焦长上下文推理中KV复用部署难题，应用价值明确
算法与系统协同设计思路务实，强调与现有引擎兼容
cons: 摘要对理论依据与复杂度分析交代不足，严谨性仍待实证细节支撑
速度收益区间跨度大，可能依赖场景与模型，泛化稳定性风险未充分说明

papers.title_zh: DARIC：具有分布感知重新计算功能的位置无关 KV 缓存重用系统
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的上下文长度在代理系统和检索增强生成 (RAG) 等实际应用中迅速增加。为了加速这些场景中的 LLM 推理，跨请求重用位置无关的键值 (KV) 缓存已成为一种有前景的方法。该技术通常依赖于重新计算选定的标记子集来恢复跨块交互。然而，现有的解决方案在算法效率和系统部署方面都受到严重限制。从算法上来说，它们忽略了 KV 缓存偏差的分布，导致令牌选择开销较高或生成质量下降。在系统级别，依赖自定义 LLM 执行流进行重新计算使部署变得复杂，并妨碍与高度优化的推理引擎的无缝集成。在本文中，我们提出了 DARIC（\textbf{D}istribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ecomputation for \textbf{I}ndependent KV \textbf{C}ache Reuse），一种基于系统算法协同设计的新型 KV 缓存重用方法。 DARIC 的核心是引入了一种分布感知的令牌选择策略，该策略根据经验 KV 偏差模式自适应地安排令牌重新计算，从而在生成质量和计算效率之间取得最佳平衡。此外，DARIC建立在轻量级系统架构之上，能够以最小的集成开销实现独立的KV缓存生成和重新计算，充分保留了标准推理引擎的现有系统级优化。跨各种数据集和 LLM 的综合实验表明，DARIC 始终优于最先进的方法，在首次代币时间 (TTFT) 方面实现了 1.1$\times$--4.5$\times$ 加速，而生成质量的损失可以忽略不计。代码可在 https://github.com/Lenovo-ICI/DARIC 获取。

papers.title: ReKV: Overlapping Quantized KV Transfer and Suffix Recomputation
papers.summary: Prefill--decode disaggregation moves a prompt's key--value (KV) cache between workers before the first token can be generated. Reducing this handoff to either cache compression or recomputation misses a useful choice: which layers to transmit, at what precision, and which layers to execute again on the decode worker. ReKV transfers a quantized prefix KV cache and one BF16 boundary state, then reconstructs a contiguous suffix while the prefix is in flight. In a model-shaped synthetic benchmark on cross-node H100s, the Q8 configuration meeting separately evaluated quality criteria reduces 8K handoff latency by $2.36\times$, $2.84\times$, and $3.65\times$ over BF16 transfer for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Qwen3-8B. It is also faster than the best measured transfer-only or recompute-only action at those points. A separate real-weight BF16 recomputation experiment reduces prefill-to-token-return time by $1.16$--$1.63\times$. The preferred action changes with prompt length and link bandwidth.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果可观，但证据链仍偏薄弱。
pros: 提出“量化传输+后缀重算”联合动作，较单一路径更实用
在多模型与8K场景给出显著降时，工程价值明确
cons: 核心结果主要来自模型形状合成基准，真实端到端与质量保持验证不足

papers.title_zh: ReKV：重叠量化KV传输和后缀重新计算
papers.summary_zh: 在生成第一个令牌之前，预填充-解码分解会在工作人员之间移动提示的键值 (KV) 缓存。将这种切换减少到缓存压缩或重新计算会错过一个有用的选择：传输哪些层、以什么精度以及在解码工作器上再次执行哪些层。 ReKV 传输量化的前缀 KV 缓存和一个 BF16 边界状态，然后在前缀运行时重建连续的后缀。在跨节点 H100 的模型综合基准中，满足单独评估的质量标准的 Q8 配置将 Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen3-8B 的 BF16 传输的 8K 切换延迟降低了 $2.36\times$、$2.84\times$ 和 $3.65\times$。在这些点上，它也比最佳测量的仅传输或仅重新计算操作更快。单独的实际权重 BF16 重新计算实验将预填充到令牌返回时间减少了 $1.16$--$1.63\times$。首选操作随提示长度和链路带宽而变化。

papers.title: Enabling Retraining-Free Accurate Inference in Analog Compute in Memory Accelerators
papers.summary: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators compute matrix-vector products directly inside memory arrays, eliminating weight movement and promising order-of-magnitude gains in inference efficiency. However, converter and device errors make pretrained models unusable on these arrays, and hardware-aware retraining is costly. We enable retraining-free, accurate inference of pretrained models on simple analog arrays with low-cost, shared calibration. Our key observation is that analog error depends on how each layer is represented on the array, and that this representation can be changed offline without changing the computation. We center the inputs and apply Hadamard rotations designed for analog arrays, which keep shared reference errors spread and confine input mixing to each array. Across CNNs, vision transformers and LLMs up to 14B parameters on PCM and ReRAM, the method brings vision models and larger LLMs within a few points of floating-point accuracy and matches or approaches published hardware-aware training without training any weights. On ReRAM with 6-bit ADCs, it restores ViT-B/16 from 37.4% to 82.9% and Phi-4 from 27.0% to 72.2%, both within 2.2 points of floating-point accuracy.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、效果强，但泛化与复现细节待验证。
pros: 提出免重训的表示变换思路，契合模拟CIM部署痛点
跨CNN/ViT/LLM与PCM/ReRAM展示大幅精度恢复，工程价值高
cons: 摘要缺少校准开销、延迟/能耗增益及统计显著性等严谨性细节，真实部署稳健性仍有风险

papers.title_zh: 在内存加速器中的模拟计算中实现无需重新训练的准确推理
papers.summary_zh: 模拟内存计算 (CIM) 加速器直接在内存阵列内计算矩阵向量乘积，消除重量移动并有望提高推理效率。然而，转换器和设备错误使得预训练模型无法在这些阵列上使用，并且硬件感知的重新训练成本高昂。我们通过低成本、共享校准，可以在简单的模拟阵列上实现预训练模型的免重新训练、准确推理。我们的主要观察结果是，模拟误差取决于每一层在阵列上的表示方式，并且可以在不改变计算的情况下离线更改这种表示方式。我们将输入居中并应用为模拟阵列设计的哈达玛旋转，这可以保持共享参考误差的扩散并将输入混合限制到每个阵列。在 PCM 和 ReRAM 上的 CNN、视觉转换器和 LLM 中，参数高达 14B，该方法将视觉模型和更大的 LLM 的浮点精度控制在几个点内，并匹配或接近已发布的硬件感知训练，而无需训练任何权重。在具有 6 位 ADC 的 ReRAM 上，它将 ViT-B/16 从 37.4% 恢复到 82.9%，将 Phi-4 从 27.0% 恢复到 72.2%，两者的浮点精度都在 2.2 个点以内。

papers.title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding has become a standard way to accelerate LLM inference: a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target verifies in one parallel pass. Existing drafters face trade-offs that limits their speedups: autoregressive drafters generate tokens one at a time, so drafting cost grows with draft length, while diffusion drafters generate tokens in parallel but predict each position independently, ignoring inter-token dependencies. We introduce ChainFlow, a new speculative decoding paradigm and the first flow-matching drafter conditioned on the target's hidden states. ChainFlow treats drafting as a short transport over hidden states, needing one or two flow steps instead of the many denoising steps of generation from noise. A variational autoencoder compresses these states so drafting cost barely grows with target size, lightweight feedback heads restore inter-token dependencies, and tree drafting raises acceptance. On Qwen3.5 models, at matched drafter size and training data, ChainFlow outperforms EAGLE-3 and DFlash in vLLM by 39% and 11%, respectively. These gains further widen as drafters are adapted to new languages sequentially. Our ablations cover drafter design and concurrent serving, and we open-source our code and drafter models.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但泛化与严谨性仍待验证。
pros: 提出基于目标隐状态的少步流匹配草稿器，区别于现有AR与扩散路线
在统一规模与数据下报告对EAGLE-3和DFlash的显著吞吐提升，工程价值明确
cons: 证据主要集中在Qwen3.5与特定实现栈，跨模型族与任务泛化仍不充分
摘要未充分说明质量保持、拒绝率-延迟权衡及统计显著性，严谨性存在不确定

papers.title_zh: ChainFlow：用于推测解码的少步潜在流匹配
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码已成为加速 LLM 推理的一种标准方法：轻量级起草者提出目标在一次并行传递中验证的标记。现有的起草者面临着限制其加速的权衡：自回归起草者一次生成一个令牌，因此起草成本随着草稿长度的增加而增加，而扩散起草者并行生成令牌但独立预测每个位置，忽略令牌间的依赖关系。我们引入了 ChainFlow，一种新的推测性解码范例和第一个以目标隐藏状态为条件的流匹配起草器。 ChainFlow 将绘图视为隐藏状态上的短传输，需要一两个流程步骤，而不是从噪声生成的许多去噪步骤。变分自动编码器压缩这些状态，因此起草成本几乎不随目标大小而增长，轻量级反馈头恢复令牌间依赖性，并且树起草提高了接受度。在 Qwen3.5 模型上，在匹配的绘图员大小和训练数据下，ChainFlow 在 vLLM 中的表现分别优于 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 39% 和 11%。随着起草者相继适应新语言，这些成果进一步扩大。我们的消融涵盖起草者设计和并发服务，并且我们开源我们的代码和起草者模型。

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且潜力大，但实证与归因仍需更严谨。
pros: 提出潜在空间群体协作与KV缓存通信，方向有明显新意
在多任务上呈现显著加速与较强性能，具备实际应用价值
cons: 关键收益归因与公平对比细节不足，稳健性和可复现性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现和优化的潜在代理群
papers.summary_zh: LLM 引导的进化搜索使用 AI 代理，通过迭代改进解决方案并结合高分方法来改进数学和计算问题的程序。然而，这个过程通常很慢，因为法学硕士每轮都会生成很长的文本思想链，并且必须多次重复这一生成以保持群体多样性。我们提出了 SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮数百个低成本代理以群体的形式工作，在潜在空间中进行推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递 KV 缓存来共享信息。每个群体从不同的角度研究问题。新奇过滤器通过直接测量代理隐藏状态向量之间的距离来保留最独特的代理想法。当摘要器代理收到所有群体成员的组合 KV 缓存时，思想的交叉自然地发生在潜在空间中。在数学发现和科学计算的 21 个问题上，SwarmEvolve 获得了最高的平均分数，并且只需要 3 到 8 分钟的中位数即可达到其他最先进框架在 60 分钟内达到的最佳分数。在几个问题上，SwarmEvolve 与 Qwen3 8B 改进了 AlphaEvolve 首次通过前沿法学硕士找到的解决方案。我们的工作表明，在潜在空间中进行通信的代理群为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。

papers.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
papers.summary: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据链仍待强化。
pros: 提出分层精度流式补偿，较好打破量化精度与速度权衡
跨GPU与统一内存平台、长上下文与多模型结果显示潜在实用价值
cons: 摘要缺少与更多强基线和端到端时延分解对比，泛化与稳定性证据不足
关键机制（选择策略、复用收益、SSD场景）对不同负载的最坏情况开销未交代

papers.title_zh: StrataFlux：内存层次结构本机低位 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 量化减少了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的内存和带宽需求，但会降低准确性；卸载更高精度的数据反而会阻碍生成。我们引入了 StrataFlux，这是一个挑战这种权衡的框架，它可以恢复因低位权重和键值 (KV) 缓存量化而损失的精度，同时保留量化的内存和速度优势。 StrataFlux 共同设计细化表示、选择和交付，使主机 RAM 和固态驱动器成为额外精度的有用来源。其选择性精度流减少了传输量，将交付与计算重叠，并在解码步骤中重用获取的精度，因此生成无需等待每次传输。我们在专用 GPU 和统一内存平台上评估 2-4 位权重和 2-3 位 KV 缓存。对于 2 位 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 权重，StrataFlux 将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 9.46 降低到 8.40，同时在 RTX 5090 上保持 95.4% 的量化基础吞吐量。借助 2 位权重和 KV，StrataFlux 将 Qwen3-8B 的 AIME 2024/2025 准确度从 11.0% 提高在 GPU 内存使用不变的情况下，性能提升至 47.1%。在 128K 环境下，具有 3 位权重和 2 位 KV 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 RTX 5090 上实现了与 vLLM 的 4 位 AWQ 权重和 8 位 KV 相当的复杂度和速度，仅使用大约一半的 GPU 内存。这些结果表明，GPU 驻留精度不需要设置精度上限，卸载层延迟也不需要决定解码速度。

papers.title: CoRD: Coupled Rollouts Fill the Blind Spot of On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. On frozen teacher-reached states, a 4B student trained with CoRD reaches in 16 steps a gap closure that on-policy distillation does not reach in 80, and substitution rules intervening at least as often in other directions fall short of CoRD.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实证积极，但因果与泛化证据仍偏弱
pros: 以最大耦合构造干预最小化的状态分布迁移，方法动机与机制较完整
在多尺寸多家族学生与多数学基准上报告稳定增益，并给出收敛速度对比
cons: 摘要未充分说明计算开销、统计显著性与跨任务泛化，当前证据更像特定设定下的有效改进

papers.title_zh: CoRD：耦合推出填补了政策蒸馏的盲点
papers.summary_zh: 政策蒸馏会根据自己的部署对学生进行培训，因此教师会达到，但学生不会，很少受到监督。我们引入了CoRD（耦合推出蒸馏），它保留了在策略损失，并且仅将训练状态的分布向教师移动，通过推测解码的最大耦合从学生和教师的几何插值中绘制推出。只要两个分布一致，耦合就会保留学生的令牌，否则会替换学生权重不足的目标部分的令牌，因此干预措施与任何精确采样器允许的情况一样罕见，并随着学生的学习而减少。在来自两个模型系列（Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5，0.6B 到 4B）的 6 名基础学生中，CoRD 在五个公共数学基准上，在相同步骤和数据下，将平均 pass@1 比 on-policy 蒸馏提高了 0.9 到 2.0 分，将 pass@8 提高了 1.2 到 3.4 分。在教师达到冻结状态的州，接受 CoRD 训练的 4B 学生只需 16 个步骤即可完成在 80 步内策略蒸馏无法达到的差距，并且在其他方​​向进行干预的替代规则至少与 CoRD 的频率相同。

papers.title: CAMP: Context-Aware Mapping and Placement for LLMs on 3D-IMC Arrays
papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur severe memory-access overheads due to the cost of loading large weight matrices and key-value (KV) caches. Analog In-Memory Computing (AIMC) is an emerging solution that enables computation directly on static weights stored in memory, substantially reducing energy and latency. 3D-IMC further stacks memory arrays into vertical tiers, increasing capacity but revealing a new challenge: how weights are placed in memory determines which matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) can execute concurrently, affecting latency and throughput. The concurrency aspect of 3D-IMC weight-mapping remains underexplored in the literature, leading to sub-optimal utilization of compute resources on 3D-IMC chips. In this context we propose CAMP (Context-Aware Mapping and Placement), an inference-context-aware weight mapping algorithm for 3D-IMC-based LLM accelerators. CAMP captures the potential resource contention resulting from the architecture, targeted network, and runtime context in a conflict matrix, enabling throughput-optimized weight mapping. This mapping is refined through a profiling-driven feedback loop that efficiently prunes the search space and returns optimized mappings within practical runtimes. CAMP is an offline, software-based solution requiring no hardware changes and improving 3D-IMC compute utilization from 42.4% to 60.3%, delivering up to 2.0x higher 3D-IMC throughput and 1.74x higher end-to-end throughput over state-of-the-art mapping algorithms.

与SOTA对比口径可能受工作负载与系统假设影响，2.0x收益上界属性较强

papers.title_zh: CAMP：3D-IMC 阵列上 LLM 的上下文感知映射和放置
papers.summary_zh: 由于加载大型权重矩阵和键值 (KV) 缓存的成本，大型语言模型 (LLM) 会产生严重的内存访问开销。模拟内存计算 (AIMC) 是一种新兴解决方案，可直接对存储在内存中的静态权重进行计算，从而大幅减少能耗和延迟。 3D-IMC 进一步将内存阵列堆叠成垂直层，增加了容量，但也带来了新的挑战：内存中权重的放置方式决定了哪些矩阵向量乘法 (MVM) 可以同时执行，从而影响延迟和吞吐量。 3D-IMC 权重映射的并发方面在文献中仍未得到充分探索，导致 3D-IMC 芯片上计算资源的利用率不高。在此背景下，我们提出了 CAMP（上下文感知映射和放置），这是一种用于基于 3D-IMC 的 LLM 加速器的推理上下文感知权重映射算法。 CAMP 在冲突矩阵中捕获架构、目标网络和运行时上下文导致的潜在资源争用，从而实现吞吐量优化的权重映射。这种映射是通过分析驱动的反馈循环来完善的，该循环可以有效地修剪搜索空间并在实际运行时返回优化的映射。 CAMP 是一种基于软件的离线解决方案，无需更改硬件，并将 3D-IMC 计算利用率从 42.4% 提高到 60.3%，与最先进的映射算法相比，3D-IMC 吞吐量提高了 2.0 倍，端到端吞吐量提高了 1.74 倍。

papers.title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
papers.summary: Most existing equivariant architectures for Hamiltonian prediction propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors, whereas the target Hamiltonian is naturally an operator block in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases. This representation mismatch fragments contiguous Hamiltonian blocks, obscures direct manipulation of orbital couplings, and organizes features into irregular angular-momentum components that require numerous transformations and are poorly aligned with efficient hardware execution and memory management. To address both the representation mismatch and computational bottleneck, we propose DP-Learner, an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space. Theoretically, we propose Lie-generator-based directional embedding and invariantly weighted left--right products and contractions that preserve equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversions, without explicit Clebsch--Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction. Methodologically, we instantiate this principle as a Transformer architecture, in which Hamiltonian-like feature matrices or tensors evolve through equivariant operators in the direct-product space, while non-linear invariant scalar routing controls structured gating over matrix units, directional propagation, attention, and environment-embedded context interactions. We further construct MP-HAM-110K, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset comprising more than 110,000 material structures covering 68 elements with both Hamiltonian and wavefunction data. Experiments on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC demonstrate that DP-Learner dramatically improves Hamiltonian prediction accuracy and inference efficiency over the state-of-the-art method.

papers.title_zh: 电子结构哈密顿预测的直积空间中的等变深度学习
papers.summary_zh: 大多数现有的哈密顿量预测的等变架构在不可约球面张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标哈密顿量自然是局部轨道和自旋基上的直积表示中的算子块。这种表示不匹配会破坏连续的哈密顿块，模糊了轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织成不规则的角动量分量，这些分量需要大量的变换，并且与高效的硬件执行和内存管理不太一致。为了解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈问题，我们提出了 DP-Learner，这是一种等变学习框架，可直接在直积空间中的类似哈密顿算子块上执行消息传递。理论上，我们提出基于李生成器的方向嵌入和不变加权左右乘积和收缩，以保持 SO(3)、SU(2) 和空间反演的等变性，而无需显式的 Clebsch-Gordan 分解或逆重构。从方法上讲，我们将这一原理实例化为 Transformer 架构，其中类似哈密顿量的特征矩阵或张量通过直积空间中的等变算子演化，而非线性不变标量路由控制矩阵单元、定向传播、注意力和环境嵌入上下文交互的结构化门控。我们进一步构建了 MP-HAM-110K，这是一个大规模哈密顿量数据集，包含超过 110,000 个材料结构，涵盖 68 个元素，包含哈密顿量和波函数数据。MP-HAM-110K 和 Materials-HAM-SOC 上的实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，DP-Learner 显着提高了哈密顿量预测精度和推理效率。

papers.title: The Gating Mechanism of KV Cache Eviction
papers.summary: KV cache eviction must decide which entries carry information that the rest of the cache can no longer supply. A natural way to estimate this is a learnable gate: give each cached entry a gate on its attention weight and train the gate on the model's own objective. The gate belongs inside the normalizing softmax, where suppressing one entry hands its mass to the others rather than discarding it. That same normalizer absorbs any per-query constant, so a constant gate cancels and reproduces the frozen model exactly. Trained on the language-modeling loss the gate stays near a constant score while its loss falls throughout: optimization succeeds, but a frozen backbone was fit for dense attention, so its loss prefers the no-op, and a near-constant score ranks nothing. The no-op is not a floor the gate improves from but what its objective asks for. A second obstacle survives once the gate moves, since the same gradient charges the gate for errors the frozen model already makes, which no reweighting of positions separates out. Much of the machinery in learnable eviction, from sparsity penalties to relaxations of the discrete decision, works around the first obstacle rather than removing it; both are removed by putting dense attention beyond the gate's reach and making the dense model's predictions its target. Under these two conditions capacity is never the missing ingredient: neither a larger scorer, nor explicit access to the past, nor a trainable backbone helps. The same holds for what eviction unavoidably discards, which is recovered by parameter-free centroids read inside the same softmax far better than by any memory read outside it, since the mass they must return is a share of that normalizer and available nowhere else. At 75\% KV cache compression, this gate reaches 90.14 on RULER at 8K and 46.03 on LongBench with Qwen3-8B, 3.72 and 1.36 points below full-cache inference.

papers.title_zh: KV 缓存驱逐的门控机制
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存驱逐必须决定哪些条目携带缓存其余部分不再提供的信息。估计这一点的自然方法是可学习门：为每个缓存条目提供一个关于其注意力权重的门，并根据模型自身的目标训练该门。该门属于归一化 softmax 内部，其中抑制一个条目将其质量传递给其他条目而不是丢弃它。同一个规范化器吸收任何每个查询常量，因此常量门会取消并准确地再现冻结模型。在语言建模损失上进行训练时，门保持在恒定分数附近，而其损失始终下降：优化成功，但冻结的骨干网适合密集注意力，因此它的损失更喜欢无操作，并且接近恒定的分数排名不高。无操作不是门改进的楼层，而是其目标所要求的。一旦门移动，第二个障碍就会存在，因为相同的梯度会为门收取冻结模型已经产生的错误，而位置的重新加权不会将其分离出来。可学习驱逐中的许多机制，从稀疏惩罚到离散决策的放松，都是围绕第一个障碍而不是消除它；通过将密集注意力置于门的范围之外并将密集模型的预测作为目标，可以消除这两者。在这两种情况下，能力永远不是缺失的要素：无论是更大的得分手，还是对过去的明确了解，还是可训练的骨干都没有帮助。这同样适用于驱逐不可避免地丢弃的内容，通过在同一 softmax 内部读取的无参数质心来恢复，其恢复效果比在其外部读取的任何内存要好得多，因为它们必须返回的质量是该标准化器的一部分，并且在其他地方不可用。在 75% KV 缓存压缩下，该门在 8K 的 RULER 上达到 90.14，在 Qwen3-8B 的 LongBench 上达到 46.03，比全缓存推理低 3.72 点和 1.36 点。

papers.title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.

papers.title_zh: TACT-KV：用于压缩医疗 VLM 中体积 KV 缓存的三轴余弦变换
papers.summary_zh: 应用于 3D 医学扫描的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 面临着结构性记忆墙。单个 CT 或 MRI 卷会生成数以万计的视觉标记，并且生成的键值 (KV) 缓存会随着批次和上下文线性扩展。现有的KV压缩方法对缓存的特征或令牌统计数据进行操作，或者应用一维和二维变换，从而使缓存中的三轴空间结构未被利用。我们提出了 TACT-KV（三轴余弦变换），这是一种免校准的 KV 压缩方法，它利用沿 3D 扫描的所有三个解剖轴的视觉 KV 状态中的强空间相关性。这种相关性将 KV 缓存能量集中在频域变换下。 TACT-KV 将可分离的 3D 离散余弦变换应用于 KV 缓存，通过反向注水（更多位分配给高能分量）跨频率仓分配每层比特预算，并使用固定标量码本量化每个仓。我们推导出一个紧密形式的关系：自适应位分配的失真减少主要由变换后的缓存的频谱集中度决定。在我们的主要比较中，在 6 个医学 VLM 和两个 3D CT 基准测试中，TACT-KV 在 12 个模型和数据集对中的 11 个上实现了最低的 1 位预测翻转率。在视频任务评估的四个通用 VLM 上再现了相同的优势，这表明利用三轴结构的好处可以推广到医学成像之外。在相同的高带宽内存 (HBM) 下，TACT-KV 将单个 GPU 上的解码批量大小最多扩展 8 倍。

papers.title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.summary: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO). In experiments deploying GLM-5.2 with multi-token prediction (MTP3) speculative decoding on an Ascend910C prefill--decode (PD)-disaggregated platform, FlashOffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38\(\times\) and decode throughput by up to 1.91\(\times\) under a 30 ms TPOT constraint. FlashOffloading is integrated into an open-source serving framework: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/tree/releases/v0.30.0.

papers.title_zh: FlashOffloading：用于长上下文 LLM 服务的低延迟 KV 缓存卸载
papers.summary_zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统中，键值（KV）缓存随着序列长度和并发度线性增长，因此长上下文推理很容易遇到高带宽内存（HBM）容量墙并导致低并发。将 KV 缓存卸载到主机动态随机存取存储器 (DRAM) 可释放 HBM 空间并提高并发性，但额外的缓存管理和主机到设备 (H2D) 负载开销会增加推理延迟，较高的并发性无法转化为有效吞吐量。我们提出了 FlashOffloading，这是一种以主机 DRAM 为中心的推理架构，可在预填充和解码阶段完全卸载 KV 缓存。 FlashOffloading 构建用于预填充的滚动 HBM 缓存、用于解码的热缓存、零额外未命中查找开销的反向稀疏索引以及计算负载重叠内核，优化整个管道中的 KV 卸载延迟，并在每个输出令牌时间 (TPOT) 服务级别目标 (SLO) 下提供吞吐量增益。在 Ascend910C 预填充解码 (PD) 分解平台上部署具有多令牌预测 (MTP3) 推测性解码的 GLM-5.2 的实验中，FlashOffloading 在 30 ms TPOT 约束下将预填充吞吐量提高了 1.38\(\times\)，将解码吞吐量提高了 1.91\(\times\)。 FlashOffloading 已集成到开源服务框架中：https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/tree/releases/v0.30.0。

papers.title: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4
papers.summary: Attention is a core building block of frontier models and often dominates compute-bound prefill at long context. FP8 matrix instructions offer twice the peak throughput of BF16, but they accelerate only matrix multiplication, and the softmax between the two matrix multiplications of attention runs on vector units that FP8 does not accelerate. On the AMD Instinct MI355X, the vendor's AITER kernels reach 39% of peak FP8 matrix throughput at 32K tokens, compared with 49% in BF16. Attention is also more numerically sensitive to quantization than feed-forward layers, and unlike NVIDIA's Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, the MI355X does not track the completion of matrix instructions in hardware, so overlapping the softmax with the matrix multiplications depends on instruction order. We present ZYFA, prefill kernels for the MI355X built on three techniques: (1) computing each FP8 probability directly from its score with a multiply-add and an integer conversion instead of an exponential; (2) a ping-pong schedule in which one group of threads computes its softmax while another executes its matrix multiplications; and (3) scaling each block of probabilities up by a power of two before rounding, and normalizing by the sum of the rounded probabilities. On attention inputs captured from three models and timed at sustained clock speeds, ZYFA achieves 1.16-1.76x the throughput of AITER. On the Gaussian inputs of kernel benchmarks at 32K tokens, it achieves 1.26-1.37x at head dimension 128 and 1.99x for DeepSeek-style multi-head latent attention. The sustained clock of the MI355X depends on operand values, so throughput on random inputs does not reliably predict throughput on real model activations. At head dimension 128, ZYFA's numerical error is within a few percent of that of Composable Kernel and Triton and 62-78% lower than that of AITER's. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zyphra/zyfa.

papers.title_zh: ZYFA：AMD CDNA4 上 FP8 FlashAttention 的速度和准确性
papers.summary_zh: 注意力是前沿模型的核心构建块，并且通常在长上下文中主导计算限制预填充。 FP8 矩阵指令提供的峰值吞吐量是 BF16 的两倍，但它们仅加速矩阵乘法，并且两个注意力矩阵乘法之间的 softmax 运行在 FP8 不加速的向量单元上。在 AMD Instinct MI355X 上，供应商的 AITER 内核在 32K 令牌时达到峰值 FP8 矩阵吞吐量的 39%，而 BF16 中为 49%。与前馈层相比，注意力对量化在数值上更加敏感，与 NVIDIA 的 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 不同，MI355X 不会跟踪硬件中矩阵指令的完成情况，因此将 softmax 与矩阵乘法重叠取决于指令顺序。我们提出了 ZYFA，用于 MI355X 的预填充内核，基于三种技术构建：（1）通过乘加和整数转换（而不是指数）直接根据分数计算每个 FP8 概率； (2) 乒乓调度，其中一组线程计算其 softmax，而另一组线程执行其矩阵乘法； (3) 在舍入之前将每个概率块按 2 的幂缩放，并通过舍入概率的总和进行归一化。在从三个模型捕获并以持续时钟速度计时的注意力输入上，ZYFA 的吞吐量是 AITER 的 1.16-1.76 倍。在 32K 标记的内核基准测试的高斯输入上，它在头维度 128 处实现了 1.26-1.37 倍，在 DeepSeek 式多头潜在注意力方面实现了 1.99 倍。 MI355X 的持续时钟取决于操作数值，因此随机输入的吞吐量不能可靠地预测实际模型激活的吞吐量。在头部尺寸 128 处，ZYFA 的数值误差与 Composable Kernel 和 Triton 相比在百分之几以内，比 AITER 的数值误差低 62-78%。源代码可在 https://github.com/Zyphra/zyfa 获取。

papers.title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
papers.summary: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. Across five QA benchmarks and two independent locally-run judges, CacheGraft improves answer quality over the text-only receiver baseline in 29 out of 30 comparisons, of which 17 of the 30 are statistically significant. Notably, these gains are zero-shot with respect to the fuser, which was never trained on retrieval data. These initial results suggest that latent-space document enrichment may be a promising avenue for enhancing the performance of RAG systems, particularly in compute-constrained settings where it is only feasible to deploy a small model at inference time.

cons: 实验显著性有限且缺关键对照与成本分析，难充分证明泛化与实用增益

papers.title_zh: CacheGraft：通过潜在空间文档丰富增强检索增强生成
papers.summary_zh: 机器学习领域的最新研究表明，基于 Transformer 的语言模型代理不仅可以通过文本传达状态，还可以通过键值 (KV) 缓存直接在潜在空间中传达状态。在本文中，我们认为这种缓存到缓存的转换可以提供超出实时代理通信的原始激励应用程序的实用性，并且可以用于检索增强生成（RAG）。基于缓存到缓存（C2C）融合框架，我们提出的系统 CacheGraft 将每个语料库通道离线编码为较大共享者模型（我们实验中的 4B 参数）和较小接收器模型（0.6B 参数）之间的融合 KV 缓存表示，以便该缓存可以在查询时注入接收器，而不需要更大的模型。在五个 QA 基准测试和两个独立的本地运行评委中，CacheGraft 在 30 次比较中的 29 次中比纯文本接收器基线提高了答案质量，其中 30 次中有 17 次具有统计显着性。值得注意的是，这些增益对于融合器来说是零样本，因为融合器从未接受过检索数据的训练。这些初步结果表明，潜在空间文档丰富可能是增强 RAG 系统性能的一个有前途的途径，特别是在计算受限的环境中，在推理时部署小型模型是可行的。

papers.title: HyFlash: A Prefix-Memory Prior for On-Device Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel block drafting accelerates speculative decoding by predicting multiple future positions in a single backbone pass, but on-device deployment constrains both drafter capacity and context storage. Under tight memory budgets, drafters must model long-range dependencies and fine-grained draft-position interactions without the growing KV-cache overhead of full-context attention. We propose HyFlash, a compact parallel drafter that introduces a prefix-memory prior to separate long-range context modeling from fine-grained draft-position interactions with limited capacity. Local attention captures recent context and draft-position interactions, while recurrent memory compresses historical target features into fixed-size states. This inductive bias enables effective local and long-range modeling with bounded draft-side memory. Experiments show that HyFlash achieves higher acceptance than full-context attention with substantially less KV storage and with larger gains for shallow drafters and long contexts.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向端侧瓶颈的思路扎实且有潜力
pros: 提出前缀记忆先验，将长程建模与草稿位交互解耦，设计针对性强
聚焦端侧内存约束，声称在长上下文与浅层drafter下具备实用增益
cons: 仅凭摘要仍缺关键证据：训练与推理开销、稳定性、跨模型泛化及与强基线公平对比

papers.title_zh: HyFlash：用于设备上推测解码的前缀内存先验
papers.summary_zh: 并行块起草通过预测单个骨干通道中的多个未来位置来加速推测解码，但设备上部署限制了起草器容量和上下文存储。在内存预算紧张的情况下，绘图人员必须对远程依赖关系和细粒度的绘图位置交互进行建模，而无需增加全上下文关注的 KV 缓存开销。我们提出了 HyFlash，这是一种紧凑的并行绘图器，它在将远程上下文建模与容量有限的细粒度绘图位置交互分开之前引入了前缀内存。局部注意力捕获最近的上下文和草稿位置交互，而循环记忆将历史目标特征压缩为固定大小的状态。这种归纳偏差可以利用有限的草稿侧内存进行有效的本地和远程建模。实验表明，HyFlash 比全上下文注意力获得了更高的接受度，并且 KV 存储显着减少，并且对于浅绘图者和长上下文来说获得了更大的收益。

papers.title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.summary: Sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. However, useful interactions differ in their precision requirements: some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. We therefore introduce TriAttention, which assigns query-key (QK) tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. To represent compactly, we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, keeping policy storage independent of context length. Offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. Using these measurements, a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. During prefill, the selected boundaries generate precision-grouped traversals for a fused kernel that skips omitted tiles and combines contributions from both QK precisions into one normalized attention output. The quantized keys and values prepared during prefill are then reused in a compressed key-value (KV) cache for decoding, reducing repeated reads of prompt data. Experiments show that TriAttention achieves end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over the Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline. Meanwhile, TriAttention maintains quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. These results show how a compact retention-and-precision policy translates local sensitivities into attention computation and repeated KV-cache access. The implementation is https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TriAttention.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且工程价值高，但证据链仍需加强
pros: 统一跳过/4bit/8bit三路注意力，较现有二元稀疏或单一量化更细粒度
策略以对角边界紧凑编码并结合共享预算分配，具备较强部署可行性
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融与稳健性细节，超高加速比的可复现性和泛化范围仍有不确定性
离线校准与硬件/模型依赖可能带来迁移成本，在线场景适应性尚未充分证明

papers.title_zh: TriAttention：用于长上下文 LLM 推理的统一稀疏混合精度注意力
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏性和量化通过跳过交互并降低保留的精度来降低注意力成本。然而，有用的交互在精度要求方面有所不同：有些可以容忍低精度分数，同时对删除保持敏感。因此，我们引入了 TriAttention，它将查询键 (QK) 块分配给跳过、4 位或 8 位计算，使用 4 位以较低的成本保留量化容忍交互。为了紧凑地表示，我们用两个对角距离边界对每个头的计算区域进行编码，保持策略存储独立于上下文长度。然后，离线校准使用归一化的预计输出误差和完整切片执行成本来评估候选边界对。使用这些测量值，模型范围的分配器选择每个头的边界，以最大限度地减少共享计算预算下的校准误差。在预填充期间，选定的边界会为融合内核生成精确分组的遍历，该融合内核会跳过省略的图块，并将两个 QK 精度的贡献合并到一个归一化注意力输出中。然后，预填充期间准备的量化键和值会在压缩键值 (KV) 缓存中重复使用以进行解码，从而减少提示数据的重复读取。实验表明，TriAttention 的端到端生成速度比 Torch Attention 提高了 7.88 倍，比 BF16 基线提高了 2.65 倍。同时，TriAttention 在通用和长上下文任务上保持了与原始模型相当的质量。这些结果显示了紧凑的保留和精度策略如何将局部敏感性转化为注意力计算和重复的 KV 缓存访问。实现是https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TriAttention。

papers.title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
papers.summary: At context lengths of about 1M tokens, dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding, and training typically relies on long documents, which become scarcer as the target length increases. Most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens, so their selection cost per query is $O(L)$ at context length $L$; hierarchical selection reduces it to $O(\log L)$, but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. We propose RecSA (Recursive Sparse Attention), which builds a tree over the KV cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. The keys come from one pooler per layer, shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. Each level above the tokens selects at most $k$ candidates, so each query has $O(\log L)$ selection cost and reads $O(\log L)$ entries; the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. Each entry's RoPE position is its index among the candidates of its level, so at any length every relative distance stays within the range seen during training. Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 方法有新意且实用，但证据仍需更全面验证。
pros: 递归树式稀疏注意力将选择与读取成本降至O(logL)，兼顾预填充与解码效率
仅用32K训练长度即在131K-2M长度上取得显著外推与RULER优势，工程加速结果亮眼
cons: 评估集中于RULER与单模型初始化，跨任务泛化、训练/推理稳定性及消融充分性仍待加强

papers.title_zh: 递归稀疏注意力：以对数成本进行百万令牌长度外推
papers.summary_zh: 在上下文长度约为 1M 令牌时，密集注意力在预填充和解码方面的成本很高，并且训练通常依赖于长文档，随着目标长度的增加，长文档变得越来越稀缺。大多数稀疏注意力方法对所有前面的块或标记进行评分，因此每次查询的选择成本为 $O(L)$，上下文长度为 $L$；分层选择将其减少到 $O(\log L)$，但先前的可训练分层方法仅在其训练长度内报告准确性。我们提出了 RecSA（递归稀疏注意力），它在 KV 缓存上构建一棵树，其中每个节点用一个键和一个平均池值总结其子树。密钥来自每层一个池化器，由所有级别共享，并从密集的注意力中提取出来。令牌之上的每个级别最多选择 $k$ 个候选者，因此每个查询都有 $O(\log L)$ 选择成本并读取 $O(\log L)$ 条目；未选定的候选者的摘要与确切的标记共享一个 softmax。每个条目的 RoPE 位置是其在其级别的候选者中的索引，因此在任何长度下，每个相对距离都保持在训练期间看到的范围内。 RecSA 从 Qwen3-4B 初始化，并在原始模型的 32K 训练长度上对 0.62B 令牌进行训练，在从 131K 到 2M 的每个长度上，RecSA 都优于 RULER 上的所有基线；在 1M 时，它的得分为 60.5，而最佳基线 Dense + DCA 的得分为 40.0。借助我们优化的内核，RecSA 在从 64K 到 2M 的端到端预填充和解码方面比密集注意力更快；在一个 H200 GPU 上以 524K 速度运行时，预填充速度提高了 3.2 倍，解码速度提高了 3.8 倍。

papers.title: Capability Gain from ISA to Shared Execution on AMD MI300A and MI250X
papers.summary: Each new GPU generation is showcased by its peak instruction rates, yet users hardly ever run instructions directly: they reach the hardware's performance through vendor libraries, applications and devices shared with other jobs. How much of a theoretical speedup survives these layers is rarely measured, so a team deciding whether to move to a new generation, or to adopt FP8 or 2:4 sparsity, lacks adequate guidance. AMD's MI300A (CDNA3) adds new FP8 matrix instructions and 2:4 structured-sparse instructions that the predecessor, the MI250X (CDNA2), does not have. We analyze this theoretical speedup gap on AMD's MI300A (CDNA3) against the MI250X (CDNA2) by defining a new metric, capability gain. Capability gain is the fraction of a feature's instruction-level speedup that it keeps at a higher level, such as a library, an application or a shared device. We trace it from ISA microbenchmarks through hipBLASLt and hipSPARSELt to LLM inference and mixed-precision HPL, and onto a device shared by up to eight concurrent streams. FP8 keeps most of its speedup through the library, completing an $8192^3$ GEMM \genCapPkgEndToEndGainEightK{} faster than the MI250X with FP16, but unfused quantization turns it into a per-layer slowdown in an LLM, and 2:4 sparsity keeps at most about half of its speedup in hipSPARSELt. Under queue sharing, FP8's GEMM capability gain rises above 1. How fairly streams share the device depends on the number of hardware queues, not on the numeric precision, yet shared LLM serving gains nothing from FP8.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但方法与证据仍需加强。
pros: 提出 capability gain 统一量化 ISA 到共享执行的性能折损，视角新且实用
覆盖微基准、库、LLM推理与共享队列，结论对采购与部署决策有直接价值
cons: 摘要显示主要为单厂商双代对比，外部可推广性有限
2:4 稀疏与LLM端收益偏弱，部分结论更像工程诊断而非通用规律

papers.title_zh: 从 ISA 到 AMD MI300A 和 MI250X 上共享执行的能力增益
papers.summary_zh: 每一代新的 GPU 都以其峰值指令速率来展示，但用户几乎不会直接运行指令：他们通过与其他作业共享的供应商库、应用程序和设备来达到硬件的性能。很少测量这些层的理论上的加速有多少，因此决定是否转向新一代、或采用 FP8 或 2:4 稀疏性的团队缺乏足够的指导。 AMD 的 MI300A (CDNA3) 添加了前代 MI250X (CDNA2) 所没有的新 FP8 矩阵指令和 2:4 结构化稀疏指令。我们通过定义新的指​​标“能力增益”来分析 AMD MI300A (CDNA3) 与 MI250X (CDNA2) 的理论加速差距。能力增益是指功能保持在较高水平的指令级加速的一部分，例如库、应用程序或共享设备。我们从 ISA 微基准测试到 hipBLASLt 和 hipSPARSELt，再到 LLM 推理和混合精度 HPL，并追踪到由最多 8 个并发流共享的设备。 FP8 通过库保留了大部分加速，比使用 FP16 的 MI250X 更快完成 $8192^3$ GEMM \genCapPkgEndToEndGainEightK{}，但未融合的量化将其变成 LLM 中的每层减速，并且 2:4 稀疏性最多在 hipSPARSELt 中保留其加速的一半左右。在队列共享下，FP8 的 GEMM 能力增益上升到 1 以上。流共享设备的公平程度取决于硬件队列的数量，而不是数字精度，但共享 LLM 服务不会从 FP8 中获得任何增益。

papers.title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
papers.summary: Attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) separates attention from the experts of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model and has been reported to raise decode throughput over colocated serving. Whether this advantage holds on rack-scale NVLink systems such as GB200 NVL72 remains unclear: prior results were obtained on other hardware, against narrower colocated baselines, or with analytical models, whereas production engines serve large MoE models on these systems with wide expert parallelism (wide EP). We build and tune FastAFD, an AFD engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps the MoE of one microbatch with the attention of the other, and compare it against the best vLLM wide EP setting. Experiments show that AFD has a throughput advantage of up to 1.17x over wide EP on Qwen3 and 1.16x on Qwen3.5, and matches it on MiniMax-M2.5. We derive an analytical model that predicts AFD throughput within 3% using only profiles of colocated vLLM, telling whether switching to AFD would pay off before deploying it. The model yields a concise insight: AFD's speedup factors into a batch gain (larger batches, since attention GPUs hold no expert weights), an overlap gain (shorter steps, since the MoE runs on the expert GPUs behind attention), and a disaggregation cost (the GPUs given to experts). AFD has the advantage when the two gains outweigh the cost. This view explains which models benefit from AFD, and shows that speculative decoding helps light-expert models most, where the enlarged overlap gain outweighs the larger disaggregation cost and adds a further 8% to AFD's advantage over wide EP. Looking ahead, serving the experts on accelerators that keep their weights in on-chip SRAM, such as the Groq LPX accelerators paired with Vera Rubin NVL72, would remove most of the disaggregation cost, raising the ideal speedup to 2.48x with speculative decoding. FastAFD is open source at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/FastAFD.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程扎实且有实用价值，但方法新意中等
pros: 在GB200 NVL72上做了面向生产基线（vLLM wide EP）的实证对比，结论更具现实参考性
提出可用少量profile预测AFD收益的解析模型，并给出“增益-成本”判据，指导部署决策
cons: 性能提升幅度整体有限且模型相关性强，泛化到更多MoE结构与负载形态仍待验证

papers.title_zh: FastAFD：Attention-FFN 分解何时在机架级 NVLink 上发挥作用？
papers.summary_zh: 注意力 FFN 分解 (AFD) 将注意力与专家混合 (MoE) 模型的专家分开，据报道可以提高共置服务的解码吞吐量。这一优势是否适用于 GB200 NVL72 等机架级 NVLink 系统仍不清楚：之前的结果是在其他硬件上针对较窄的共置基线或分析模型获得的，而生产引擎在这些系统上为具有广泛专家并行性（广泛 EP）的大型 MoE 模型提供服务。我们构建并调整了 FastAFD，这是一种适用于 GB200 NVL72 的 AFD 引擎，它将一个微批次的 MoE 与另一个微批次的注意力重叠，并将其与最佳 vLLM 宽 EP 设置进行比较。实验表明，AFD 在 Qwen3 上比宽 EP 具有高达 1.17 倍的吞吐量优势，在 Qwen3.5 上具有 1.16 倍的吞吐量优势，并且在 MiniMax-M2.5 上与之相当。我们得出了一个分析模型，该模型仅使用并置 vLLM 的配置文件来预测 AFD 吞吐量在 3% 以内，从而在部署之前判断切换到 AFD 是否会获得回报。该模型给出了一个简明的见解：AFD 的加速因素包括批次增益（较大批次，因为注意力 GPU 没有专家权重）、重叠增益（较短的步骤，因为 MoE 在注意力背后的专家 GPU 上运行）和分解成本（给予专家的 GPU）。当这两项收益超过成本时，AFD 具有优势。该视图解释了哪些模型受益于 AFD，并表明推测性解码对轻专家模型的帮助最大，其中扩大的重叠增益超过了更大的分解成本，并使 AFD 相对于宽 EP 的优势进一步增加了 8%。展望未来，为专家提供将其权重保留在片上 SRAM 中的加速器（例如与 Vera Rubin NVL72 搭配的 Groq LPX 加速器）将消除大部分分解成本，通过推测解码将理想加速提高到 2.48 倍。 FastAFD is open source at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/FastAFD.

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.summary: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 方向新颖且工程价值高，但证据完整性待验证
pros: 抓住键值结构不对称性，提出值预测加残差存储的互补压缩轴
方案可与量化和淘汰策略组合，兼顾高压缩率与解码吞吐提升
cons: 测试时拟合与重构选择机制可能带来额外开销和分布外退化，泛化与稳定性证据仍不足

papers.title_zh: LowRAM：测试时可组合 KV 缓存压缩的低等级键和摊余值
papers.summary_zh: 自回归解码依赖于 KV 缓存，其内存占用量随着上下文长度线性增长，并限制批量大小和吞吐量。现有的后训练方法利用令牌、层和特征维度之间的冗余，或较低的数值精度。我们确定了一个互补轴：在每个注意力头中，值在很大程度上可以根据其相应的键来预测。我们通过价值缓存摊销来利用这一点，它在测试时适合轻量级的每头预测器，并仅存储其重建最差的令牌的残差，从而提供 4\times$ 近乎无损的价值压缩。预测器可以通过元学习来初始化，以显着减少预填充开销，或者在允许一次性成本的设置中从头开始安装，例如多查询推理。我们将价值摊销与跨层低秩密钥压缩结合起来，生成 LowRAM，这是一种非对称压缩管道，在三个模型系列中都保持接近无损。通过在每个解码步骤中仅重建选定的 KV 对子集，LowRAM 可以将解码开销保持在最低限度，并在 4\times$ 压缩下实现高达 $5\times$ 的峰值解码吞吐量。 LowRAM 进一步结合量化和逐出，在长上下文中达到 $26.9\times$ 压缩，基准性能为 $94.5\%$。这些结果表明，将键和值视为结构上不同的键和值可以实现高效、积极且可组合的 KV 缓存压缩。

papers.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题新颖且实用，但证据链仍需加强。
pros: 提出面向智能体设计专用推理系统的基准，问题定义前沿且有现实价值

papers.title_zh: ServerBench：你们的编码代理如何设计专门的LLM服务系统？
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码代理通过实验开发软件，提供了设计支持其自身操作的服务系统的机会。有效的服务需要在会话依赖性、延迟约束和正确性要求下协调实施和操作决策。我们推出 ServerBench，这是完整、专业的 LLM 服务系统的代理设计基准。代理针对一个共同目标进行实验，即每美元的美元数：每美元 GPU 成本的延迟合格代币价值。状态重放保留会话依赖性，独立验证检查提交的系统。在 11 个编码代理模型和 3 个部署中，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上的每美元售价为 2.97 美元，vLLM 参考价为 4.87 美元\times$； 33 次运行中的 22 次产生了经过验证的系统，其中 13 次超过了最强基线。我们的分析确定了三个发现：高价值设计将容量改进与负载选择相协调；代理通过与工作负载相关的实验来解释绩效反馈；可靠的交付需要验证优化引入的执行路径。总体而言，ServerBench 支持对代理如何将服务目标和反馈转化为针对给定任务规范的有效、经过验证的服务系统的系统研究。

papers.title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
papers.summary: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新且实用，但证据链仍需更扎实。
pros: 将交错读写与全KV复用结合，直击流式推理效率痛点
提出Actor-Critic自增强策略学习，兼顾语义质量与时延优化

SOTA结论依赖基线与评测设定，跨语言与真实流式场景泛化风险未明

papers.title_zh: CRESiST：同步语音翻译的自我增强探索性策略学习
papers.summary_zh: 同步语音翻译 (SimulST) 需要平衡翻译质量和延迟。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 在离线翻译方面表现出色，但当前基于 LLM 的 SimulST 系统主要依赖于前缀增量生成。这种范例受到冗余键值缓存重新计算的影响，并且需要外部语音活动检测来处理无界流。为了克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了一个基于全模式法学硕士的端到端交错读写框架。通过交错语音块和文本标记，我们的架构实现了完全的 KV 缓存重用，原生支持无分段、无限长度推理。此外，为了在没有严格离线对齐的情况下学习最佳流媒体策略，我们引入了一种新颖的 Actor-Critic 自我增强管道。 RNN-T Actor 动态采样读写轨迹，而基于 LLM 的 Critic 通过内在语义和延迟奖励评估这些路径，将最佳策略提炼回 Actor。对句子级（FLEURS、CoVoST2）和文档级（MuST-C、ACL 60/60）基准的广泛实验表明，我们的模型建立了新的最先进的质量延迟帕累托前沿，大大优于现有的级联和静态对齐基线。

papers.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. D3D combines blockwise denoising with auxiliary autoregressive supervision to achieve long accepted prefixes without target hidden states. This independence lets D3D draft successor blocks during verification in one packed pass, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding. We progressively prune layers according to their effect on acceptance length to reduce the cost of packed drafting. Removing five of 36 layers retains over 99\% of mean acceptance length across three benchmarks with Qwen3-8B as the target. Across seven benchmarks, D3D averages 5.00$\times$ and 5.71$\times$ decoding speedup with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B targets, compared with 4.03$\times$ and 3.67$\times$ for DFlash. On GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, speedup reaches 7.48$\times$. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/D3D.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且提速显著，但严谨性仍待实证补强。
pros: 提出异步 speculative decoding，解除轮间依赖，方向价值高

papers.title_zh: D3D：用于异步推测解码的解耦扩散绘图
papers.summary_zh: 目标条件扩散起草者并行预测候选标记，但每个新块必须等待更新的目标模型隐藏状态。这迫使起草和验证按顺序运行，从而限制了加速，即使每个块都是在一次传递中生成的。我们引入了 D3D，这是一个独立的扩散绘图器，可以消除这种轮间依赖性。 D3D 将分块去噪与辅助自回归监督相结合，以实现长期接受的前缀，而无需目标隐藏状态。这种独立性允许 D3D 在一次打包过程中的验证过程中起草后继块，从而实现异步推测解码。我们根据层对接受长度的影响逐步修剪层，以降低打包起草的成本。在以 Qwen3-8B 为目标的三个基准测试中，删除 36 层中的 5 层保留了超过 99% 的平均接受长度。在七个基准测试中，D3D 使用 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 目标的平均解码速度为 5.00$\times$ 和 5.71$\times$，而 DFlash 的解码速度为 4.03$\times$ 和 3.67$\times$。在使用 Qwen3-32B 的 GSM8K 上，加速达到 7.48$\times$。代码可在 https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/D3D 上公开获取。

papers.title: Where Should a KV-Cache Repair Budget Go? Distractor Structure and Contextual Compatibility in Non-Prefix Reuse
papers.summary: Non-prefix KV-cache reuse encodes retrieved chunks independently and concatenates their caches. To find where a small repair budget should be spent, we vary the chunks around the answer-bearing one (the target) across three 7B-8B models and four datasets of dialogue memory, open-domain QA and API documentation. Reuse loses 19-100% of the context-dependent questions that full prefill answers, and it loses more when the other chunks are of the same kind as the target. Because the recoverable damage is spread over these other chunks, restoring a few of them recovers little, and the budget is better spent on the target. This works through contextual compatibility: recomputing the target against the reused cache beats inserting its full-prefill KV in all seven settings tested, although the recomputed KV stays far from the full-prefill KV. Question attention over reused caches, however, selects the target in at most 18.8% of development questions. A retriever finds it more often, and recomputing its top chunk after moving it next to the question significantly beats InfoFlow-style reordering at the same 5% budget in six of nine open-domain QA and API-documentation settings. On dialogue memory, though, recomputing chunks never significantly beats the token-level selector chosen for each setting.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害、证据较扎实，但外推仍受限。
pros: 聚焦非前缀KV复用中“修复预算投放”这一关键且实用的问题
跨3个7B-8B模型与4类任务系统对比，并给出显著性与失败边界

papers.title_zh: KV-Cache 修复预算应该花在哪里？非前缀重用中的干扰结构和上下文兼容性
papers.summary_zh: 无前缀 KV 缓存重用独立编码检索到的块并连接它们的缓存。为了找到应该在哪里花费少量的修复预算，我们在三个 7B-8B 模型和四个对话记忆数据集、开放域 QA 和 API 文档中改变了围绕答案承载块（目标）的块。重用会丢失 19-100% 完整预填充答案的上下文相关问题，并且当其他块与目标属于同一类型时，会丢失更多。由于可恢复的损坏分散在这些其他块上，因此恢复其中一些块几乎无法恢复，并且预算最好花在目标上。这是通过上下文兼容性实现的：根据重用的缓存重新计算目标胜过在测试的所有七个设置中插入其完全预填充 KV，尽管重新计算的 KV 与完全预填充 KV 相差甚远。然而，对重用缓存的问题关注最多在 18.8% 的开发问题中选择了目标。检索器更频繁地找到它，并且在将其移动到问题旁边后重新计算其顶部块，在 9 个开放域 QA 和 API 文档设置中的 6 个中以相同 5% 的预算显着优于 InfoFlow 式重新排序。然而，在对话记忆中，重新计算块永远不会显着优于为每个设置选择的标记级选择器。

papers.title: SafeStart: Mitigating the Overlooked Safety Cost of Active Expert Reduction in MoE LLM Serving
papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models send each token through a few of many expert subnetworks. Serving methods make these models faster by running even fewer experts per token, and they are validated on accuracy benchmarks. We show that these methods can weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and we introduce SafeStart, which largely restores refusal while keeping most of the speedup. In vLLM on one RTX A6000, keeping about two thirds of the selected experts speeds up offline decoding by 15 to 28% at batch size 8. We find that, at this setting, under a jailbreak that tells the model not to refuse, the share of harmful requests that the model answers rises by 18.4 percentage points on Qwen1.5-MoE, 9.5 on OLMoE, and 6.6 on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the three of nine models where it rises significantly, while MMLU accuracy drops by less than two points. We discover that most of this increase arises while the model processes the prompt and generates its first few tokens. SafeStart therefore runs all experts for the prompt and the first eight generated tokens, and the reduced set of experts afterwards, through a fused kernel in vLLM. With experts removed, SafeStart keeps at least 85% of the offline decode speedup at batch sizes 8 and 32 and brings the change under this jailbreak to between -2.1 and +1.3 points for three expert-reduction methods on these three models. On 889 held-out requests, in an analysis fixed before generation, truncation raises harmful compliance by 5.8 to 21.4 points, and SafeStart leaves a rise of 0.6 to 2.6 points, non-inferior to the original model on two of the three models. Our results show that faster MoE serving need not cost safety: a serving system can keep most of the gain from running fewer experts by running all of them at the start of each response, and it should test refusal, not only accuracy, before it enables such a method.

papers.title_zh: SafeStart：减轻教育部法学硕士服务中主动减少专家的被忽视的安全成本
papers.summary_zh: 专家混合 (MoE) 语言模型通过许多专家子网络中的几个发送每个令牌。服务方法通过每个令牌运行更少的专家来使这些模型更快，并且它们在准确性基准上进行了验证。我们证明这些方法可以削弱模型对有害请求的拒绝，并且我们引入了 SafeStart，它在很大程度上恢复了拒绝，同时保持了大部分加速。在一台 RTX A6000 上的 vLLM 中，保留大约三分之二的选定专家可以在批量大小为 8 时将离线解码速度提高 15% 到 28%。我们发现，在这种设置下，在告诉模型不要拒绝的越狱下，模型响应的有害请求的比例在 Qwen1.5-MoE 上上升了 18.4 个百分点，在 OLMoE 上上升了 9.5 个百分点，在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上上升了 6.6 个百分点，九个模型中的三个模型显着上升，而 MMLU 准确率下降了不到两点。我们发现，大部分增长是在模型处理提示并生成前几个标记时出现的。因此，SafeStart 通过 vLLM 中的融合内核运行提示和前 8 个生成令牌的所有专家，以及随后减少的专家集。移除专家后，SafeStart 在批量大小为 8 和 32 时保持至少 85% 的离线解码加速，并在这三个模型上使用三种专家缩减方法，将越狱后的变化带到 -2.1 到 +1.3 点之间。在生成前修复的分析中，对于 889 个保留的请求，截断将有害合规性提高了 5.8 至 21.4 个点，而 SafeStart 则提高了 0.6 至 2.6 个点，在三个模型中的两个上不逊色于原始模型。我们的结果表明，更快的 MoE 服务不需要牺牲安全性：服务系统可以通过在每次响应开始时运行所有专家来保留运行较少专家所带来的大部分收益，并且在启用这种方法之前，它应该测试拒绝，而不仅仅是准确性。

papers.title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM applications repeat most of their prompt tokens across requests, and serving engines reuse the cached state of shared prefixes. vLLM and SGLang reuse it at different granularities, and benchmarks of their default deployments report large performance gaps, usually credited to the cache. Such comparisons rarely control for other configuration differences. One of them, whether a long prompt is prefilled in chunks, is set by each engine's defaults from the hardware and the release, and it confounds the comparison. We built a reproducible testbed on Kubernetes and a seeded multi-agent workload generator, and compared the two engines under vendor defaults and with chunked prefill matched. SGLang's configuration is the same in both arms, which makes it an internal control across independently provisioned deployments. Under defaults, vLLM's median time to first token is up to 64x SGLang's. Matching one setting removes 78% of the capacity gap where that gap is largest and 30 to 67% of the latency gap. Near saturation the remaining latency gap reflects queue growth. A fluid queue model driven only by a 4.4% throughput shortfall reproduces it, and shows that such a gap scales with the length of the benchmark run. What survives matching is a tail-latency advantage of 2.4 to 6.4x at equal throughput, consistent with cache-aware ordering of waiting requests. We derive six recommendations for comparing serving engines.
