papers.title_zh: LLM 服务引擎中配置和缓存架构的受控实验评估
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 应用程序在请求中重复大部分提示令牌，并且服务引擎重用共享前缀的缓存状态。 vLLM 和 SGLang 以不同的粒度重用它，其默认部署的基准测试报告了巨大的性能差距，通常归因于缓存。此类比较很少控制其他配置差异。其中之一，长提示是否预先填充块，是由硬件和版本中每个引擎的默认设置设置的，它混淆了比较。我们在 Kubernetes 上构建了一个可重复的测试平台和一个种子多代理工作负载生成器，并在供应商默认值和分块预填充匹配的情况下比较了这两个引擎。 SGLang 的配置在两个分支中是相同的，这使其成为跨独立配置的部署的内部控制。默认情况下，vLLM 的第一个令牌的中值时间高达 SGLang 的 64 倍。匹配一种设置可以消除 78% 的容量差距（该差距最大）和 30% 到 67% 的延迟差距。接近饱和时，剩余的延迟间隙反映了队列的增长。仅由 4.4% 吞吐量缺口驱动的流体队列模型重现了这一情况，并表明这种差距随着基准测试运行的长度而变化。在匹配中幸存下来的是相同吞吐量下 2.4 至 6.4 倍的尾部延迟优势，与等待请求的缓存感知排序一致。我们得出了用于比较服务引擎的六项建议。

papers.title: Split-KV: Efficient Context Parallelism for Training Diffusion Drafters
papers.summary: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by denoising multiple draft tokens in parallel. Their training uses anchor sampling to construct compact draft queries and performs cross-attention with a block-sparse mask over a much longer context. We empirically show that acceptance length remains stable as context scales with a fixed query budget, while increasing the query budget yields diminishing quality gains, jointly establishing a practical regime with queries far shorter than the context. No existing context parallelism (CP) method jointly exploits this query--context asymmetry and meets the nonlinear, sample-dependent load-balancing requirement created by anchor sampling. We present Split-KV, an exact CP method that keeps key/value shards local and limits per-layer attention communication to query-sized tensors, making this communication independent of context length. Its global query view further enables a cost-aware longest-processing-time-first (LPT) strategy that balances context key/value chunks by their realized attention cost. At a CP size of 64, Split-KV retains 85--91\% weak-scaling efficiency and achieves up to $3.67\times$ speedup over the fastest available CP baseline. LPT achieves $<$1\% imbalance and plans three orders of magnitude faster than the best load-balancing baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/zxgx/verl.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法扎实但外延仍待验证。
pros: 抓住查询远短于上下文的关键不对称性，提出通信随查询规模而非上下文增长的精确CP思路
系统结果有竞争力：高CP规模下弱扩展效率较高，并显著优于现有CP基线且负载均衡开销极低
cons: 适用范围目前主要围绕diffusion drafter训练场景，跨模型与跨任务泛化、以及端到端收益稳定性证据仍不足

papers.title_zh: Split-KV：用于培训扩散绘图员的高效上下文并行性
papers.summary_zh: 扩散绘图器通过并行对多个草图标记进行去噪来加速推测解码。他们的训练使用锚点采样来构建紧凑的草稿查询，并在更长的上下文中使用块稀疏掩码执行交叉注意。我们凭经验表明，当上下文在固定查询预算下扩展时，接受长度保持稳定，而增加查询预算会导致质量增益递减，从而共同建立一个查询远短于上下文的实用机制。现有的上下文并行 (CP) 方法都没有联合利用此查询（上下文不对称性）并满足由锚点采样创建的非线性、依赖于样本的负载平衡要求。我们提出了 Split-KV，这是一种精确的 CP 方法，可以将键/值分片保持在本地，并将每层注意力通信限制为查询大小的张量，从而使这种通信独立于上下文长度。其全局查询视图进一步实现了成本感知的最长处理时间优先（LPT）策略，该策略通过实现的注意力成本来平衡上下文键/值块。在 CP 大小为 64 时，Split-KV 保留 85--91\% 的弱扩展效率，并比最快的可用 CP 基线实现高达 3.67\times$ 的加速。 LPT 实现了 $<$1\% 的不平衡，并且计划比最佳负载平衡基线快三个数量级。代码可在 https://github.com/zxgx/verl 获取。

papers.title: EchoKV: Self-Corrective KV Cache Eviction via Iterative Query Feedback
papers.summary: KV cache eviction is not merely a token-ranking problem: the workspace retained for generating eviction queries also determines the quality of those queries. Consequently, an early workspace error can distort later query observations and reinforce an incorrect final eviction decision, particularly when evidence is dispersed across a long context. We present EchoKV, which discovers and addresses this failure mode with iterative correction. It initializes a feedback-compatible bootstrap workspace using proposals at future decode positions, then uses early decode-generated queries to recover the workspace before the remaining lookahead steps. It uses the same number of workspace forward passes as LAQ while adding a tensor re-scoring operation for workspace repair. On LongBench (16 tasks, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), EchoKV shows notable improvements over LAQ on several tasks requiring dispersed evidence, including multi-hop cross-document QA and long single-document comprehension. Across budgets and backbones, EchoKV selectively improves evidence-intensive tasks while maintaining comparable performance on the remaining LongBench subsets. These results identify query--workspace coupling as a practical failure mode of query-driven KV eviction.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题洞察有价值，但证据链仍偏摘要级。
pros: 提出“查询-工作区耦合”失效模式，问题定义较新且贴近实践
在不增加前向步数前提下给出迭代自纠机制，效率-效果权衡有吸引力
cons: 摘要缺少统计显著性、开销分解与更强基线对比，泛化与稳健性说服力有限
改进似乎集中于证据密集子任务，整体收益边界与失败案例尚不清晰

papers.title_zh: EchoKV：通过迭代查询反馈进行自我纠正 KV 缓存驱逐
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存驱逐不仅仅是一个令牌排序问题：为生成驱逐查询而保留的工作空间也决定了这些查询的质量。因此，早期的工作空间错误可能会扭曲后来的查询观察结果，并强化错误的最终驱逐决策，特别是当证据分散在较长的上下文中时。我们推出了 EchoKV，它通过迭代修正发现并解决了这种故障模式。它使用未来解码位置的建议来初始化反馈兼容的引导工作区，然后使用早期解码生成的查询在剩余的前瞻步骤之前恢复工作区。它使用与 LAQ 相同数量的工作区前向传递，同时添加用于工作区修复的张量重新评分操作。在 LongBench（16 个任务、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上，EchoKV 在需要分散证据的多项任务上显示出比 LAQ 显着的改进，包括多跳跨文档 QA 和长单文档理解。在预算和骨干网中，EchoKV 有选择地改进证据密集型任务，同时在其余 LongBench 子集上保持可比较的性能。这些结果将查询-工作区耦合确定为查询驱动的 KV 驱逐的实际故障模式。

papers.title: RECAP: Context-Aware Prediction Recycling with Request-Local and Persistent Memories for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Recycling a target model's own predictions offers a training-free source of proposals for speculative decoding. In vision-language models, however, existing recycling indexes predictions by the last token alone, conflating predictions computed under different images and prefixes; we find that such reuse fails most often at image-sensitive decoding states. Longer keys reduce this aliasing but match fewer states. We introduce \method, which stores target predictions under one-, two-, and three-token keys: contextual memories live only for the current request and are thus implicitly conditioned on its image, while token-level memory persists across requests to retain coverage. At each lookup, entropy-confidence weighting fuses the retrieved predictions according to their key specificity and concentration. Best-first search composes the fused transitions into a candidate tree, supplemented by suffix-matched continuations, and one target pass verifies the tree under greedy decoding. Without training or an auxiliary draft model, \method\ achieves mean speedups over autoregressive decoding of $1.66\speed$ and $1.56\speed$ across seven single-turn benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.6-7B, exceeding the strongest training-free baseline, Token Recycling ($1.51\speed$ and $1.37\speed$). Our implementation is available in https://github.com/Senmo996/RECAP-official-code.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路务实有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 针对多模态回收别名冲突提出请求内/跨请求双记忆，问题刻画到位
无需训练与草稿模型即可稳定提速，且在两类7B VLM上超越强基线
cons: 方法主要是已知组件的工程化组合，核心算法新颖性有限
实验摘要未体现长上下文、多轮对话与分布外场景的稳健性及显存开销

papers.title_zh: RECAP：具有请求本地和持久存储器的上下文感知预测回收，用于多模态推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 回收目标模型自己的预测为推测性解码提供了免训练的建议来源。然而，在视觉语言模型中，现有的回收索引仅通过最后一个标记进行预测，合并了在不同图像和前缀下计算的预测；我们发现这种重用在图像敏感解码状态下最常失败。较长的密钥可以减少这种混叠，但匹配的状态较少。我们引入了 \method，它将目标预测存储在一个、两个和三个令牌键下：上下文记忆仅适用于当前请求，因此隐式地以其图像为条件，而令牌级内存在请求之间持续存在以保留覆盖范围。在每次查找时，熵置信度加权都会根据检索到的预测的关键特异性和浓度来融合它们。最佳优先搜索将融合转换组合成候选树，并辅以后缀匹配的延续，并且一个目标通道在贪婪解码下验证树。在没有训练或辅助草案模型的情况下，\method\ 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-1.6-7B 上的七个单轮基准测试中实现了 $1.66\speed$ 和 $1.56\speed$ 的自回归解码平均加速，超过了最强的无训练基线，令牌回收（$1.51\speed$ 和 $1.37\speed$）。我们的实现可以在 https://github.com/Senmo996/RECAP-official-code 中找到。

papers.title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference with a small drafter, whose per-guess acceptance rate determines the achievable speedup. Feature-level drafters share a design choice: every token, easy or hard, is drafted under a single forward pass. Many of the tokens the target rejects are ones the drafter is itself unsure about yet the target answers decisively. To address this, we introduce Parallel Reconsideration: guided by its own uncertainty, the drafter reconsiders its hesitant guesses with extra passes that run in parallel with the one-pass draft, adding negligible latency. A co-designed training recipe and serving-time drafting algorithm append these reconsidered guesses to the original draft tree as refined candidates. Across models and benchmarks, on average, Parallel Reconsideration improves over the baselines by 5.3% to 10.2% on acceptance length and by 3.5% to 9.2% on speedup.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用且有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 抓住 speculative decoding 的核心瓶颈，以不确定性驱动重考虑，工程动机强
训练与推理协同设计，且并行重考虑强调低额外时延，具部署吸引力
cons: 方法属于现有草稿-验证范式的增量改进，概念新颖性有限
摘要仅给出平均提升，缺少方差、显著性与最坏情形，稳健性证据不足

papers.title_zh: 给起草者第二次猜测的机会：推测性解码的并行重新考虑
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可以通过小型起草者加速大型语言模型推理，其每次猜测的接受率决定了可实现的加速。功能级起草者共享一个设计选择：每个令牌，无论简单还是困难，都是在单个前向传递下起草的。目标拒绝的许多标记是起草者本身不确定的，但目标却果断地回答。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了并行重新考虑：在其自身的不确定性的指导下，起草者通过与一次性草案并行运行的额外传递重新考虑其犹豫的猜测，从而增加了可以忽略不计的延迟。共同设计的训练配方和服务时间起草算法将这些重新考虑的猜测作为改进的候选者附加到原始草案树中。在所有模型和基准测试中，平均而言，并行重新考虑在接受长度方面比基线提高了 5.3% 到 10.2%，在加速方面提高了 3.5% 到 9.2%。

papers.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL). We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards. Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 系统设计新颖且结果亮眼，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 提出共享KV-DAG与五原语，较好统一多分支推理与训练
效率与效果同时提升，给出吞吐、显存与任务准确率多维收益
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融与统计显著性细节，因果归因仍不充分
与更强检索器、不同模型规模和长上下文预算的公平对比信息不足

papers.title_zh: Octopus：一个大脑，多个分支，用于潜在 KV 多智能体强化学习
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系统通过生成具有隔离上下文窗口的子代理来并行探索，而单代理系统将每个搜索和验证步骤附加到一个增长的轨迹中。然而，现有的多代理框架跨分支复制前缀 KV 缓存，通过重新预填充文本摘要来交换结果，并在强化学习 (RL) 期间压平或删除跨分支依赖关系。我们引入了 Octopus，一种单模型多代理 RL 框架，其中所有线程共享一个主干，并通过五个原语（fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit）在 KV 状态的 GPU 驻留有向无环图（DAG）上进行协调。 Octopus 结合了三种共同设计的机制：（1）零复制基数分叉，它在共享物理 KV 页面上以 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 光标视图的形式生成分支； (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting，将同级线程的终端 KV 块直接挂载到全注意力层中，同时绕过线性循环状态（Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2），将任务劫持减少 $21\times$（$57.9\% \to 2.7\%$），同时在零额外 KV 分配的情况下保留 $92.2\%$ 的全文互信息； (3) 一个打包的 DAG-GRPO 训练器，它将所有情节分支打包到一个块稀疏注意力通道中，并通过留一分支边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上使用 GRPO 在稀疏 BM25 语料库上进行端到端训练，Octopus 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 $49.6\%$ 准确率（在 143K 上下文中比单代理 GRPO 提高 $+17.5$ 点，在文本摘要多代理 RL 上提高 $+12.5$ 点），在 OpenResearcher 上达到 $51.2\%$ 准确率，优于密集检索代理最多增加 250 倍，同时训练吞吐量增加 3.3 倍，峰值 KV 内存减少 2.8 倍。

papers.title: Runway Characters: Serving a 57B Video Diffusion Transformer for Real-Time Conversation
papers.summary: Conversational video characters must generate video as fast as it plays, for one user at a time: at 24 fps, a sustained 166.7 ms per four-frame chunk at batch size one, with only a few chunks of buffering. We describe the system behind Runway Characters, which serves a $\approx$57B-parameter autoregressive video diffusion transformer (four denoising passes per chunk) at 704$\times$1088 and 24 fps on four H100 GPUs with a voice agent in the loop. Each chunk takes 240 attention calls, each reading a 5,788-slot KV cache in which only 757 tokens are new, and 29% of the original step was whole-cache work repeated in every call. We move that work to write time (a ring cache, RoPE and FP8 quantization applied once per write, and a delta rotation when positions reset), fuse the tensor-parallel all-reduce into the FP8 GEMM with in-switch reduction, and give the decoder that turns latents into video frames its own GPU. Without the fused kernel, our optimizations cut the diffusion step from 240.9 to 159.3 ms (1.51$\times$, 24.5 fps sustained) with no detected degradation in lip-sync scores; the fused kernel, rolled back once in production and since re-enabled, reaches 147.4 ms (1.63$\times$, 43% of FP8 peak). In seven weeks of production the worker averaged above 23.5 fps in 99.5% of sessions that streamed for at least a second, and our pipeline takes 0.49 s of a 2.1 s median conversational turn. On the same GPUs, the two open-source real-time video systems we benchmarked, at four denoising passes, miss real time or add over a second of latency (one by estimate), at a third to half of our resolution.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值极高，但学术严谨性仍需补强。
pros: 在57B视频扩散模型上实现接近实时对话级服务，系统贡献显著
优化链路完整且量化充分，含线上七周稳定性与时延数据
cons: 核心创新偏系统集成，消融与统计显著性、泛化对比及复现实证仍不足

papers.title_zh: Runway 角色：使用 57B 视频扩散变压器进行实时对话
papers.summary_zh: 会话视频角色必须以与播放一样快的速度生成视频，一次为一个用户提供：在 24 fps 下，批量大小为 1 时每四帧块持续 166.7 毫秒，只有几个缓冲块。我们描述了 Runway Characters 背后的系统，该系统在四个 H100 GPU 上以 704$\times$1088 和 24 fps 运行一个 $\approx$57B 参数的自回归视频扩散转换器（每个块四次去噪），并在循环中带有语音代理。每个块需要 240 个注意力调用，每次读取 5,788 个槽位的 KV 缓存，其中只有 757 个令牌是新的，并且原始步骤的 29% 是在每次调用中重复的整个缓存工作。我们将这项工作移至写入时间（环形缓存、每次写入应用一次的 RoPE 和 FP8 量化，以及位置重置时的增量旋转），将张量并行全归约融合到具有开关内归约的 FP8 GEMM 中，并为将潜在数据转换为视频帧的解码器提供自己的 GPU。如果没有融合内核，我们的优化将扩散步骤从 240.9 毫秒减少到 159.3 毫秒（1.51$\times$，持续 24.5 fps），并且没有检测到唇同步分数的下降；融合内核在生产中回滚一次并重新启用后，达到 147.4 毫秒（1.63$\times$，FP8 峰值的 43%）。在七周的生产过程中，工作人员在 99.5% 的至少传输一秒的会话中平均帧率高于 23.5 fps，而我们的管道在中值 2.1 秒的对话轮次中需要 0.49 秒。在相同的 GPU 上，我们对两个开源实时视频系统进行了基准测试，在四次降噪过程中，在我们的分辨率的三分之一到一半的情况下，会错过实时时间或增加超过一秒的延迟（据估计为一秒）。

papers.title: Hybrid Spark: Adaptive Speculative Decoding That Lets the Content Choose the Drafter
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) speeds up large language model (LLM) serving, but its gain depends on the workload's \emph{shape}, such as batch size and context length, and on its \emph{content}. A model-based drafter proposes a short block on any content, while a model-free drafter such as n-gram lookup proposes long copies at almost no cost when the output repeats its input, as in code editing. Adaptive verification spends a batch-wide verification budget on the draft tokens most likely to be accepted, but it supports only one model-based drafter. Model-free drafters provide no per-token confidence, so they cannot take part in budget allocation, and deployments must either fix one drafter or split their GPUs between drafters. We present \sys, a framework that runs a model-based and a model-free drafter on every step and gives each request the better of their chains, within adaptive verification and entirely on the GPU, which keeps asynchronous scheduling intact. The key idea is a price per verified draft token: the goodput that slot would earn elsewhere in the batch. Once the model-free drafter's tokens carry calibrated acceptance estimates, fit once on general text, this price puts both drafters' chains on one scale. Instantiated with \dspark and an n-gram drafter in vLLM, \sys achieves 1.10--1.62\x the output throughput of \dspark on code editing at batch size~4 and 1.04--1.27\x at batch size~128, while staying at 0.97--1.01\x of it on chat at temperature~0. A single deployment can therefore serve both workloads.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用但证据尚不够扎实
pros: 统一模型式与无模型起草器并纳入同一预算分配，设计有新意
面向异构负载给出稳定吞吐提升，工程落地价值明确
cons: 核心“校准一次可泛化”与跨任务稳健性论证偏弱，当前结果主要集中在特定场景与温度设置

papers.title_zh: Hybrid Spark：自适应推测解码，让内容选择起草者
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 可以加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务，但其增益取决于工作负载的 \emph{shape}（例如批量大小和上下文长度）及其 \emph{content}。基于模型的起草者建议对任何内容使用短块，而无模型起草者（例如 n-gram 查找）则在输出重复其输入（如代码编辑中）时几乎免费提出长副本。自适应验证将批次范围的验证预算花费在最有可能被接受的草稿令牌上，但它仅支持一个基于模型的起草者。无模型起草者不提供每个代币的置信度，因此它们无法参与预算分配，并且部署必须修复一个起草者或在起草者之间分配 GPU。我们提出了 \sys，一个框架，它在每个步骤上运行基于模型和无模型的绘图器，并在自适应验证内并完全在 GPU 上为每个请求提供更好的链，从而保持异步调度完好无损。关键思想是每个经过验证的草稿代币的价格：该插槽将在批次中的其他地方赚取的产出。一旦无模型起草者的代币带有经过校准的接受估计，并在一般文本上拟合一次，该价格就会使两个起草者的链处于同一比例。使用 \dspark 和 vLLM 中的 n-gram 起草器进行实例化，\sys 在批量大小约为 4 的代码编辑中实现了 \dspark 的 1.10--1.62\x 输出吞吐量，在批量大小约为 128 时实现了 1.04--1.27\x，而在温度约为 0 的聊天中保持在 0.97--1.01\x。因此，单个部署可以同时服务这两种工作负载。

papers.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
papers.summary: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 观点新颖且潜在影响大，但证据链仍偏薄。
pros: 将 speculative decoding 从加速机制扩展为“精度分配器”，问题定义有新意
面向长程 agent 推理误差累积提出可操作训练策略，参数改动比例小、部署吸引力强
cons: 摘要中关键因果链（噪声增长→分布偏移→成功率提升）缺少定量与统计显著性信息，严谨性不足
“不改变输出分布”与“可影响后续分布/准确率”表述存在张力，理论边界尚不清晰

papers.title_zh: 对抗性推测推理改善了长视野智能体
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码纯粹被视为一种系统优化，可以在不改变模型行为的情况下加速大型语言模型解码。根据这种观点，越来越多的训练更好选秀模型的努力仅仅集中在接受率上。我们认为，这种观点对于长期代理推理来说并不成立。使用不同的推测性解码方法测量复杂代理任务上的前沿开放权重模型，我们发现数值噪声在验证窗口内增长，并且思维过程的草稿接受结果可以在 30 个步骤后改变模型的输出分布，从而显着影响长视野代理在随机方向上的推理准确性。在这项工作中，我们通过控制此类噪声来提高目标模型的推理能力。虽然我们无法改变目标模型验证的整体令牌分布，但我们可以通过训练要拒绝的草稿模型来以最高精度编码关键推理。我们在代理追踪中识别这些点，并训练草稿模型以支持对抗性偏好。在推理时，经过训练的草稿和目标在这些决策点精确分开，验证重新启动，以便从目标模型中采样批判性思维标记，并在其噪声最小的条件下进行编码。这种方法使批判性推理能够更好地建立索引，并且从长远来看更持久。在复杂的代理编码基准上，我们的方法提高了端到端的成功率，而不改变目标模型或其输出分布。我们的结果将推测性解码机制从纯粹的加速器改造成上下文精度的主动分配器，通过训练 0.06% 到 0.28% 的托管参数来提高长视野代理的准确性。

papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但证据仍待补强。
pros: 抓住 looped Transformer 的KV缓存主瓶颈并利用跨loop冗余，方法针对性强
在极低比特下报告了精度与吞吐双收益，且已在SGLang实现，工程价值高
cons: 摘要未交代训练/微调开销、稳定性与统计显著性，泛化到更多模型与硬件的证据不足

papers.title_zh: LoopVQ：循环变压器的亚 1 位 KV 缓存量化
papers.summary_zh: 循环变压器是语言建模标准变压器的参数高效替代方案。通过在多个循环步骤中重新应用相同的层，最近的循环语言模型的性能可与非循环模型的性能相媲美数倍。虽然这种架构有效地减少了参数内存，但每个循环步骤仍然存储自己的键和值，因此键值（KV）缓存随着循环步骤的数量线性增长，并成为主内存瓶颈。我们观察到循环模型的 KV 缓存沿循环轴高度冗余，并且循环步骤对量化的敏感度差异很大。基于这些观察，我们提出了 $\textbf{LoopVQ}$，一种用于循环变压器的 KV 缓存矢量量化方法，它对多个循环步骤的通道进行联合编码，并对码本进行微调以匹配全精度模型的输出。在每个元素 0.5 位的情况下，LoopVQ 在通用、长思想链推理以及使用 Ouro 和 Huginn 模型的长上下文检索任务方面优于标准 LLM 的现有 KV 缓存矢量量化方法。它的设计与这些方法正交，并与 TaSQ 相结合，即使在每个元素 0.25 位的情况下，它也保留了大部分 BF16 精度。我们还在 SGLang 中实现了 LoopVQ，与 BF16 基线相比，它在 32K 令牌上下文中将解码延迟几乎减半，并将 1.4B 和 2.6B Ouro 模型的峰值服务吞吐量提高了 4.3\times$ 和 6.1\times$。

papers.title: Asymptotic Optimality of $cμ$-Rule for LLM Inference Scheduling under Memory Constraint
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference, the process by which a pre-trained model receives an input prompt and generates output tokens sequentially, has become increasingly important with the widespread deployment of LLM-based applications. As inference workloads continue to scale, GPU memory has emerged as a critical bottleneck: the long input prompts and generation sequences common in agentic and reasoning workloads lead to substantial key-value (KV) cache usage. In this paper, we study the resulting online scheduling problem from a queueing perspective. Requests arrive stochastically with heterogeneous prompt and output lengths, undergo prefill and autoregressive decode, and compete for a finite KV-cache capacity. Unlike classical queueing models, the duration of a processing step depends on both prefill computation and KV-cache I/O, so service capacity is jointly determined by computation, memory access, and memory occupancy. We develop a fluid model that reduces the system to a multiclass single-server queue with effective service rates capturing computation, memory access, and memory capacity. This fluid analysis yields a $cμ$ priority rule, where the effective service rate $μ$ is jointly determined by computational speed, memory bandwidth, and memory capacity. We prove that this rule minimizes cumulative holding cost in the fluid model and, for a finite workload, also minimizes completion time and maximizes full-run output-token throughput. We then construct a feasible scheduling policy for the original finite system and prove that its scaled dynamics converge to the optimal fluid policy. Finally, experiments on a real LLM serving engine using an NVIDIA H800 show that practical implementations of the proposed priority rule substantially reduce average latency while maintaining high throughput relative to existing scheduling policies.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，理论扎实但方法增量偏强。
pros: 聚焦KV缓存受限调度这一LLM推理核心瓶颈，问题重要性高。
从流体模型到可实现策略再到H800实证，形成较完整理论-系统闭环。
cons: 核心结论基于经典cμ框架延展，原创性主要在建模细化与工程映射，潜在边界条件与泛化性仍需更充分验证。

papers.title_zh: 内存约束下LLM推理调度$cμ$规则的渐近最优性
papers.summary_zh: 随着基于 LLM 的应用程序的广泛部署，大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理（预训练模型接收输入提示并顺序生成输出标记的过程）变得越来越重要。随着推理工作负载不断扩展，GPU 内存已成为关键瓶颈：代理和推理工作负载中常见的长输入提示和生成序列导致大量键值 (KV) 缓存使用。在本文中，我们从排队的角度研究由此产生的在线调度问题。请求以异构提示和输出长度随机到达，进行预填充和自回归解码，并竞争有限的 KV 缓存容量。与经典排队模型不同，处理步骤的持续时间取决于预填充计算和 KV-cache I/O，因此服务容量由计算、内存访问和内存占用共同决定。我们开发了一种流体模型，可将系统简化为多类单服务器队列，并具有捕获计算、内存访问和内存容量的有效服务率。这种流体分析产生 $cμ$ 优先级规则，其中有效服务速率 $μ$ 由计算速度、内存带宽和内存容量共同确定。我们证明，该规则最大限度地减少了流体模型中的累积持有成本，并且对于有限的工作负载，还最大限度地减少了完成时间并最大化了完整运行的输出令牌吞吐量。然后，我们为原始有限系统构建了可行的调度策略，并证明其缩放动态收敛于最优流体策略。最后，使用 NVIDIA H800 在真实的 LLM 服务引擎上进行的实验表明，所提出的优先级规则的实际实现大大减少了平均延迟，同时保持了相对于现有调度策略的高吞吐量。

papers.title: LeanSparse: Memory-Efficient Serving for Native Sparse-Attention LLMs
papers.summary: Sparse attention limits the history read by each query, but serving long contexts still requires substantial GPU memory. Existing KV offloading systems retain the full history of indexer keys on GPU, limiting decode concurrency. Prefill's temporary memory demand can further delay admission even when enough memory remains for the same request's subsequent decode. We present LeanSparse, a serving system that reduces both decode's persistent memory use and prefill's temporary memory demand. Our design exploits two observations: prefill consumes historical data one layer at a time, and decode can identify promising candidates before comparing their original indexer scores. During prefill, LeanSparse streams layer histories through two reusable GPU buffers, overlapping next-layer loading with ongoing model computation. During decode, coarse-to-fine indexing searches compact representations and retrieves original indexer keys only for candidate refinement. Separate indexer key and KV caches reuse data across generation steps. We implement LeanSparse in SGLang and evaluate it on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. At 950K context length, LeanSparse supports 2.95$\times$ as many concurrent requests and achieves 2.14$\times$ decode throughput over HiSparse. On multi-turn Open-SWE traces, it reduces median time to first token from 21.6 to 0.6s and median session completion time by 17.7% relative to ECHO.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但方法与证据仍需更扎实
pros: 同时优化prefill临时显存与decode常驻显存，问题切中长上下文服务瓶颈
给出高并发与吞吐提升及真实多轮轨迹收益，系统实用性较强
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融、精度代价与跨模型泛化细节，严谨性与可复现性仍有风险

papers.title_zh: LeanSparse：原生稀疏注意力 LLM 的内存高效服务
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏注意力限制了每个查询读取的历史记录，但服务长上下文仍然需要大量 GPU 内存。现有的 KV 卸载系统保留 GPU 上索引器键的完整历史记录，从而限制了解码并发性。即使有足够的内存用于同一请求的后续解码，预填充的临时内存需求也会进一步延迟准入。我们推出 LeanSparse，这是一个服务系统，可以减少解码的持久内存使用和预填充的临时内存需求。我们的设计利用了两个观察结果：预填充一次消耗一层历史数据，而解码可以在比较原始索引器分数之前识别有希望的候选者。在预填充期间，LeanSparse 通过两个可重用的 GPU 缓冲区流式传输层历史记录，将下一层加载与正在进行的模型计算重叠。在解码期间，从粗到细的索引搜索紧凑表示并检索原始索引器键，仅用于候选细化。单独的索引器键和 KV 缓存可跨生成步骤重用数据。我们在 SGLang 中实现 LeanSparse 并在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上对其进行评估。在 950K 上下文长度下，LeanSparse 支持 2.95$\time$ 的并发请求，并实现比 HiSparse 2.14$\times$ 的解码吞吐量。在多轮 Open-SWE 跟踪中，相对于 ECHO，它将第一个令牌的中值时间从 21.6 秒减少到 0.6 秒，并将会话完成时间中值减少 17.7%。

papers.title: Formalizing PTX in Lean to Prove GPU Kernel Correctness
papers.summary: We present an approach to mathematically formalizing PTX, an approach that allows modeling and reasoning about patterns common in GPU kernels for Deep Learning, including acquire-release, tensor cores, proxies, async operations, multi-kernel pipelines and data-dependent control flow. We implement it in Lean and use it to prove the correctness of simple implementations of a WGMMA GEMM kernel, FlashAttention, and a 3-kernel MoE pipeline.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且方法扎实，但证据范围仍偏有限。
pros: 将PTX在Lean中形式化，覆盖GPU内核关键并发与异步语义
以WGMMA/FlashAttention/MoE管线示例验证方法具备现实相关性
cons: 摘要未说明形式化边界、自动化程度与证明规模，外部可复现性和通用性风险较高
案例看似代表性强但可能仍属简化实现，离生产级内核正确性证明尚有距离

papers.title_zh: 在 Lean 中形式化 PTX 以证明 GPU 内核的正确性
papers.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种以数学形式化 PTX 的方法，该方法允许对深度学习 GPU 内核中常见的模式进行建模和推理，包括获取-释放、张量核心、代理、异步操作、多内核管道和数据相关控制流。我们在 Lean 中实现它，并用它来证明 WGMMA GEMM 内核、FlashAttention 和 3 内核 MoE 管道的简单实现的正确性。

papers.title: Beyond Compression Ratio: High-Throughput KV Compression for Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.summary: KV cache compression reduces the communication volume of disaggregated large language model serving, but its practical benefit depends not only on compression ratio and model quality, but also on how efficiently the compression pipeline executes. This requirement becomes increasingly important as modern serving systems adopt high-bandwidth interconnects, where inefficient compression can offset a substantial portion of the saved communication time. This paper presents FastKVComp, a high-throughput KV cache compression data path built on top of KVServe. FastKVComp improves compression execution in two complementary ways. First, it fuses the distribution transformation and low-bit quantization stages into a KVaware TileLang kernel, eliminating intermediate tensor materialization and redundant memory accesses. Second, it replaces the original lossless compression backend with an open, extensible, and searchable backend based on LC, enabling high-performance compression operator pipelines. The fused kernel achieves up to 5.9x speedup, while the new lossless backend increases compression throughput from below 90 GB/s to over 500 GB/s. Across the evaluated workloads, FastKVComp reduces job completion time by up to 2.04x. End-to-end evaluation shows that these optimizations allow KV compression to retain meaningful communication benefits under modern high-bandwidth network.
papers.comment: Accepted by The 22nd Annual IFIP International Conference on Network and Parallel Computing (NPC 2026)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但方法新颖性中等且证据仍需补强
pros: 问题定位准确，抓住高带宽互连下压缩执行开销瓶颈

papers.title_zh: 超越压缩比：用于分类 LLM 服务的高吞吐量 KV 压缩
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存压缩减少了分解的大型语言模型服务的通信量，但其实际效益不仅取决于压缩率和模型质量，还取决于压缩管道的执行效率。随着现代服务系统采用高带宽互连，这一要求变得越来越重要，其中低效的压缩可能会抵消大部分节省的通信时间。本文介绍了 \system，一个构建在 \kvserve 之上的高吞吐量 KV 缓存压缩数据路径。 \system 以两种互补的方式改进压缩执行。首先，它将分布变换和低位量化阶段融合到 KV 感知的 \tilelang 内核中，消除了中间张量物化和冗余内存访问。其次，它用基于 \lc 的开放、可扩展、可搜索的后端取代了原来的无损压缩后端，从而实现了高性能的压缩运算符管道。融合内核实现了高达 5.9\times$ 的加速，而新的无损后端将压缩吞吐量从低于 90~GB/s 提高到超过 500~GB/s。在评估的工作负载中，\system 将作业完成时间减少了高达 $2.04\times$。端到端评估表明，这些优化允许 KV 压缩在现代高带宽网络下保留有意义的通信优势。

papers.title: What Remains in Sight? Autoregressive Video Decoding as Representation-Guided Context Rewriting
papers.summary: Long-horizon video generation is increasingly moving toward autoregressive rollout, where each newly generated segment becomes part of the evidence used for future prediction. Recent causal decoders, long-context training, and KV-cache mechanisms have extended feasible duration, but most inference pipelines still decide the visible past implicitly through recent windows, compressed caches, or external memory. This raises a direct question: \textbf{can the choice of which past frames or segments to show to the decoder be treated as an explicit test-time decision?} We answer this question with \textsc{ReCR}, a training-free method that formulates autoregressive video decoding as representation-guided context rewriting. At each step, \textsc{ReCR} builds a selected visible context from the generated history by using internal decoder representations to favor context units that match the global rollout state, avoid redundancy with the recent continuation, preserve temporal boundary coverage, and widen the range of spatial layouts in view. The selected units are then mapped onto a compact causal axis before decoding the next block. Across long-horizon text-to-video benchmarks, \textsc{ReCR} consistently improves multiple autoregressive backbones under matched visible-token budgets. Empirical analyses such as representation-space diagnostics and transition-count prompt switching further show that improving what remains visible is an effective path toward more stable long-video decoding.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据链仍需更扎实

cons: 摘要未交代计算开销、选择稳定性与失败案例，因果归因和泛化边界仍存不确定性

papers.title_zh: 眼前还剩下什么？自回归视频解码作为表示引导的上下文重写
papers.summary_zh: 长视野视频生成越来越倾向于自回归部署，其中每个新生成的片段都成为用于未来预测的证据的一部分。最近的因果解码器、长上下文训练和 KV 缓存机制延长了可行的持续时间，但大多数推理管道仍然通过最近的窗口、压缩缓存或外部存储器隐式地决定可见的过去。这就提出了一个直接的问题：\textbf{选择向解码器显示哪些过去的帧或片段可以被视为显式的测试时间决策吗？}我们用 \textsc{ReCR} 回答这个问题，这是一种免训练的方法，它将自回归视频解码制定为表示引导的上下文重写。在每一步中，\textsc{ReCR} 通过使用内部解码器表示来从生成的历史中构建选定的可见上下文，以支持与全局推出状态匹配的上下文单元，避免与最近的延续出现冗余，保留时间边界覆盖范围，并扩大视图中的空间布局范围。然后，在解码下一个块之前，将选定的单元映射到紧凑的因果轴上。在长期文本到视频基准测试中， \textsc{ReCR} 在匹配的可见标记预算下持续改进多个自回归骨干网。表示空间诊断和转换计数提示切换等实证分析进一步表明，改善可见性是实现更稳定的长视频解码的有效途径。

papers.title: HyPAIC: Personal AI Computer with High Bandwidth Flash for High Performance Trillion-Parameter LLM Inference
papers.summary: LLMs have rapidly expanded from simple chatbots to agentic AI, where models directly use tools to solve complex problems. To improve problem solving, most frontier LLMs adopt an MoE architecture, pushing model sizes into the trillion-parameter regime. While cloud services have dominated large-scale LLM inference, cost and security concerns drive demand for on-premises deployment. Thus, GPU manufacturers have introduced personal AI computers (PAICs). However, existing PAICs with LPDDR-based unified main memory suffer from severe capacity limitations, restricting hostable LLM size on a single device. If most memory holds model weights, little remains for the KV cache, reducing supported context length. In this paper, we propose HyPAIC, a PAIC architecture incorporating HBF to overcome these memory constraints. HyPAIC stores read-only model weights in HBF and mutable runtime data in LPDDR. HBF offers over 10x the capacity of HBM with comparable TB/s-scale bandwidth. HyPAIC addresses HBF's access latency, limited write endurance, and page-level access granularity through prefetching, read-only weight placement, and coarse-grained weight accesses, respectively; power and cooling remain significant implementation challenges. Through simulation-based evaluation, we show that a single HyPAIC improves end-to-end system throughput by up to 1.04x and TDP-normalized throughput by up to 3.59x during 1T-parameter MoE inference versus the aggregate of eight baseline systems without HBF, one HyPAIC thus approaches the raw performance of eight baselines with far superior power efficiency. For small model inference, HyPAIC increases the maximum number of concurrent tasks sustaining at least 50 decode TPS per task by up to 4x, enhancing user experience and productivity. Although HBF specifications are still evolving, this study demonstrates strong architectural synergy between HBF and PAICs.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 选题重要但证据链偏弱，结论需谨慎解读。
pros: 聚焦PAIC内存瓶颈与超大MoE本地部署痛点，问题价值高
提出HBF放权重、LPDDR放可变数据的分层思路，架构直观且有工程可行性
cons: 核心结果主要基于仿真，缺少原型或真实系统实测支撑
“单机接近八机性能”与仅1.04x吞吐提升表述张力较大，基线与指标口径需更严谨

papers.title_zh: HyPAIC：具有高带宽闪存的个人人工智能计算机，用于高性能万亿参数 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 法学硕士已从简单的聊天机器人迅速扩展到代理人工智能，其中模型直接使用工具来解决复杂问题。为了提高问题解决能力，大多数前沿法学硕士都采用 MoE 架构，将模型规模推向万亿参数水平。虽然云服务在大规模 LLM 推理中占据主导地位，但成本和安全问题推动了对本地部署的需求。因此，GPU制造商推出了个人人工智能计算机（PAIC）。然而，现有的具有基于 LPDDR 的统一主存储器的 PAIC 受到严重的容量限制，限制了单个设备上可托管的 LLM 大小。如果大多数内存保存模型权重，那么 KV 缓存就只剩下很少的内存，从而减少支持的上下文长度。在本文中，我们提出了 HyPAIC，这是一种结合 HBF 的 PAIC 架构，以克服这些内存限制。 HyPAIC 将只读模型权重存储在 HBF 中，将可变运行时数据存储在 LPDDR 中。 HBF 提供的容量是 HBM 的 10 倍以上，且带宽具有相当的 TB/s 规模。 HyPAIC分别通过预取、只读权重放置和粗粒度权重访问来解决HBF的访问延迟、有限的写入耐久性和页级访问粒度；电力和冷却仍然是重大的实施挑战。通过基于仿真的评估，我们表明，与没有 HBF 的八个基线系统的总和相比，单个 HyPAIC 在 1T 参数 MoE 推理期间将端到端系统吞吐量提高了高达 1.04 倍，TDP 归一化吞吐量提高了高达 3.59 倍，因此，一个 HyPAIC 可以以远远优越的功效接近八个基线的原始性能。对于小型模型推理，HyPAIC 将每个任务维持至少 50 个解码 TPS 的最大并发任务数量提高了 4 倍，从而增强了用户体验和生产力。尽管 HBF 规范仍在不断发展，但本研究证明了 HBF 和 PAIC 之间强大的架构协同作用。

papers.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped transformers apply a shared block several times per token to improve accuracy without adding parameters. For models such as Ouro that keep a separate key-value (KV) cache per loop, cache memory limits the batch size that amortizes repeated weight reads. Uniform-bit quantization and fixed rules per loop do not allocate precision according to each layer's sensitivity in each loop. Measurements on Ouro show that quantization sensitivity varies across (loop, layer) cells, and the sum of individual cell damages approximates the overall output damage. Sharing damage also varies by cell, with later loops generally tolerating sharing better. Skipping low-attention values to save reads produces errors that compound across loops. LoopKV uses a one-time offline profile to choose 4-bit storage, 2-bit storage or reuse of the final loop's KV for each cell. The planner minimizes reads under budgets for predicted damage and storage. During decoding, each loop reads the high 2 bits of each 4-bit value and fetches the low bits only where its own attention weights require 4-bit precision. A single fused kernel in vLLM executes the plan. Serving Ouro-1.4B on one RTX PRO 6000, the memory-optimized LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than uniform 4-bit quantization (KIVI-4) on the same fused kernel and CUDA graph. It sustains 1.7-2.2x KIVI-4's goodput under a latency service-level objective with a 16K-token maximum length. None of its averages on six public benchmarks falls significantly below BF16's.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用且效果有说服力。
pros: 针对(loop, layer)异质敏感度做细粒度规划，较固定量化更有新意
在统一内核与同图设置下显著提升goodput并降低KV占用
cons: 主要验证集中于Ouro-1.4B与单卡场景，跨模型与多GPU泛化仍需更强证据

papers.title_zh: LoopKV：用于服务循环变压器的循环感知 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 循环变压器对每个令牌多次应用共享块，以提高准确性，而无需添加参数。对于像 Ouro 这样每个循环保留单独的键值 (KV) 缓存的模型，缓存内存限制了分摊重复权重读取的批量大小。统一位量化和每个循环的固定规则不会根据每个循环中每个层的敏感度来分配精度。 Ouro 上的测量结果表明，量化灵敏度在（循环、层）细胞之间存在差异，并且单个细胞损伤的总和近似于总体输出损伤。共享损坏也因单元而异，后面的循环通常可以更好地容忍共享。跳过低注意力值来保存读取会产生跨循环复合的错误。 LoopKV 使用一次性离线配置文件来选择 4 位存储、2 位存储或重复使用每个单元的最终循环的 KV。规划器将预测损坏和存储的读取量降到最低。在解码期间，每个循环读取每个 4 位值的高 2 位，并仅在其自身的注意力权重需要 4 位精度的情况下获取低位。 vLLM 中的单个融合内核执行该计划。在一台 RTX PRO 6000 上为 Ouro-1.4B 提供服务，内存优化的 LoopKV-M 计划在相同的融合内核和 CUDA 图上存储的 KV 比统一 4 位量化 (KIVI-4) 少 35%。在最大长度为 16K 令牌的延迟服务级别目标下，它可维持 KIVI-4 的 1.7-2.2 倍的吞吐量。六个公共基准的平均值均未显着低于 BF16。

papers.title: HybridSpec: Throughput-Aware Speculative Decoding for Hybrid GDN-MoE Models
papers.summary: In speculative decoding, parallel drafters such as DFlash make drafting cheap, so target verification dominates each round. A central choice is the verification length, the number of tokens that the target processes in each round. Verifying more draft tokens can accept more of them, but work after the first rejection is wasted. For hybrid target models that combine Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers, verification time grows much faster with this length than for dense models. In a single-request profile of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with DFlash, it grew by 71% from length 4 to 16, almost entirely in GDN and MoE layers, compared with 4%-6% for a dense Qwen3-4B target. Each GDN layer must update a recurrent state at every token and recover it at the end of the accepted prefix. The MoE cost depends on the experts that the tokens activate, which are known only once verification runs. We present HybridSpec, which selects the verification length on the GPU from draft-side acceptance estimates and measured target latency. Verification then runs this length plus one extra token up to the first MoE router, before any expert runs. There, a lightweight routing correction uses the observed expert assignments to decide whether to keep that token. The rest of verification runs only on the selected tokens. Block-parallel GDN kernels avoid storing a state after every token and reconstruct the accepted state of every GDN layer in one launch. In isolated benchmarks at verification lengths 4 to 16 with every draft token accepted, these kernels, including accepted-state reconstruction, are $1.54\times$-$4.04\times$ faster than the default kernels. With three GDN-MoE target models in single-request greedy decoding, HybridSpec is $1.75\times$-$1.88\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding and $1.30\times$-$1.33\times$ faster than DFlash.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准且工程价值高，但证据仍偏窄。
pros: 针对GDN-MoE验证瓶颈提出长度自适应与路由纠偏，机制设计有新意
给出内核级优化并在多模型上相对DFlash与AR取得稳定加速
cons: 实验主要为单请求贪心场景，缺少多并发、长上下文与采样解码下的泛化与端到端成本分析
与更强基线和消融不够充分，难以完全归因各模块贡献

papers.title_zh: HybridSpec：混合 GDN-MoE 模型的吞吐量感知推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 在推测性解码中，DFlash 等并行起草器使起草成本降低，因此目标验证在每一轮中占据主导地位。一个核心选​​择是验证长度，即目标在每轮中处理的令牌数量。验证更多的草稿令牌可以接受更多的草稿令牌，但第一次拒绝后的工作就被浪费了。对于结合了门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 和混合专家 (MoE) 层的混合目标模型，在这个长度下验证时间的增长速度比密集模型快得多。在带有 DFlash 的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的单请求配置文件中，它从长度 4 增长到 16，几乎完全在 GDN 和 MoE 层中增长了 71%，而密集的 Qwen3-4B 目标增长了 4%-6%。每个 GDN 层必须更新每个令牌的循环状态，并在接受的前缀末尾恢复它。 MoE 成本取决于代币激活的专家，只有在验证运行后才知道。我们提出了 HybridSpec，它根据草稿侧验收估计和测量的目标延迟来选择 GPU 上的验证长度。然后，在任何专家运行之前，验证会运行此长度加上一个额外的令牌，直到第一个 MoE 路由器。在那里，轻量级路由修正使用观察到的专家分配来决定是否保留该令牌。其余验证仅在选定的令牌上运行。块并行 GDN 内核避免在每个令牌之后存储状态，并在一次启动中重建每个 GDN 层的接受状态。在验证长度为 4 到 16 的独立基准测试中，每个草案令牌都被接受，这些内核（包括接受状态重建）比默认内核快 $1.54\times$-$4.04\times$。在单请求贪婪解码中使用三个 GDN-MoE 目标模型，HybridSpec 比自回归解码快 $1.75\times$-$1.88\times$，比 DFlash 快 $1.30\times$-$1.33\times$。

papers.title: Testing Processor Contracts in Speculative Decoding Engines
papers.summary: Speculative sampling can accelerate decoding without changing the target distribution. Its standard guarantee assumes that logits processors, which enforce constraints or modify token scores, receive the appropriate token prefix and state at each verification position. We formalize this processor-prefix contract and present BADC (branch-aware differential conformance testing). BADC combines enumerated references on tiny random models, checks of processor inputs and state, and simultaneous confidence bounds on output-event probabilities. Preregistered, source-informed experiments on selected Transformers and llama-cpp-python releases confirm two causes: processors read unverified drafts or advance state without rollback. For one pilot-selected prompt on a trained checkpoint, fresh samples give a 60.26-percentage-point lower bound on the difference in the probability of a predefined first-token event between ordinary and prompt-lookup decoding, with nominal simultaneous 95% coverage under within-arm i.i.d. sampling. Controlled comparisons establish no cause-recovery advantage of directed selection over random selection, while permutation testing detects each tested family at least as often as BADC. These findings connect processor-interface failures to observable decoding differences without establishing diagnostic superiority or workload prevalence.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，证据扎实但外推价值有限。
pros: 提出处理器-前缀契约并给出分支感知一致性测试框架，问题定义清晰
采用预注册与同时置信界等统计设计，能将接口失配与可观测分布差异建立联系
cons: 实验覆盖面与工作负载代表性不足，尚不能支持普遍影响规模判断
作者已承认在诊断优越性上无优势，方法相对现有检验的增量价值受限

papers.title_zh: 在推测解码引擎中测试处理器合约
papers.summary_zh: 推测采样可以在不改变目标分布的情况下加速解码。其标准保证假设强制约束或修改令牌分数的 logits 处理器在每个验证位置接收适当的令牌前缀和状态。我们正式确定了这个处理器前缀合同并提出了 BADC（分支感知差分一致性测试）。 BADC 结合了微小随机模型的枚举参考、处理器输入和状态的检查以及输出事件概率的同时置信界限。对选定的 Transformer 和 llama-cpp-python 版本进行的预注册、来源知情的实验证实了两个原因：处理器读取未经验证的草稿或提前状态而不回滚。对于训练检查点上的一个飞行员选择的提示，新样本给出了普通解码和提示查找解码之间预定义第一个令牌事件的概率差异的 60.26 个百分点的下限，在臂内 i.i.d 下标称同时覆盖率为 95%。采样。受控比较表明定向选择相对于随机选择没有原因恢复优势，而排列测试检测每个测试家族的频率至少与 BADC 一样。这些发现将处理器接口故障与可观察到的解码差异联系起来，但没有建立诊断优势或工作负载普遍性。

papers.title: ROCm InferaSim: Cut LLM Serving Trial Costs and Deploy the Best Configuration
papers.summary: Serving an LLM efficiently depends on the engine, how the model is split across GPUs, precision, scheduler settings, speculative decoding, KV-cache management, and prefill-decode disaggregation. The best configuration depends on the model, hardware, workload, and objective. Operators usually find it by trial and error. Exhaustively measuring the candidates in our study would take about 25,000 GPU-hours. ROCm InferaSim predicts serving performance from a few short measurements. Choices such as batch size, prompt length, and GPU count change the amount of work per GPU without changing the kernels. ROCm InferaSim benchmarks each distinct set of kernels once, on at most one node. We call this measurement an anchor. Analytical laws carry that anchor to other deployments that run the same kernels. For multi-node deployments, ROCm InferaSim reduces the configuration to a single-node equivalent, measures it, and scales the result analytically. A simulator replays multi-turn traffic, and a tuning agent searches configurations using the predictions. On AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs with vLLM, SGLang, and ATOM, 11 anchors took 9.1 GPU-hours, against 204 GPU-hours to measure the 226 fixed-length configurations they cover. On 172 configurations, time per output token has 8.1% median error. On a multi-turn coding workload, throughput is within 8%. For 159 disaggregated deployments, none used as an anchor, throughput is within 5.5%. A five-candidate short list contains a deployment within 12% of the best feasible pairing of model and latency target.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法实用，但创新深度与验证边界一般。
pros: 直击LLM部署调参成本痛点，GPU小时节省量级有说服力
提出anchor+解析外推+流量回放调优的完整闭环，工程可落地性强
cons: 核心思想更偏系统建模与缩放工程整合，算法新颖性与跨平台泛化证据仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: ROCm InferaSim：降低 LLM 服务试用成本并部署最佳配置
papers.summary_zh: 有效地为 LLM 提供服务取决于引擎、模型如何在 GPU 之间分割、精度、调度程序设置、推测解码、KV 缓存管理和预填充解码分解。最佳配置取决于型号、硬件、工作负载和目标。操作员通常通过反复试验来找到它。彻底衡量我们研究中的候选者大约需要 25,000 个 GPU 小时。 ROCm InferaSim 通过一些简短的测量来预测服务性能。批处理大小、提示长度和 GPU 计数等选择会更改每个 GPU 的工作量，而无需更改内核。 ROCm InferaSim 最多在一个节点上对每组不同的内核进行一次基准测试。我们称这种测量为锚点。分析定律将该锚点应用于运行相同内核的其他部署。对于多节点部署，ROCm InferaSim 将配置减少为单节点等效配置，对其进行测量，并通过分析扩展结果。模拟器重播多轮流量，调整代理使用预测来搜索配置。在具有 vLLM、SGLang 和 ATOM 的 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 上，11 个锚点需要 9.1 个 GPU 小时，而测量它们所覆盖的 226 个固定长度配置需要 204 个 GPU 小时。在 172 个配置中，每个输出令牌的时间中值误差为 8.1%。在多轮编码工作负载上，吞吐量在 8% 以内。对于 159 个分类部署（没有一个用作锚点），吞吐量在 5.5% 以内。五个候选者的短名单包含与模型和延迟目标的最佳可行配对相差 12% 以内的部署。

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.summary: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且有新意，但实证严谨性仍待加强
pros: 弹性深度的循环架构可按预算伸缩推理计算，工程价值高
同时强调精度提升、长上下文与KV缓存开销控制，系统视角较完整
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与公平性信息（训练/推理成本、统计显著性、对照设置），对“优于更大模型”结论支撑不足

papers.title_zh: Dory1.0-4B：循环标准化 GPT
papers.summary_zh: 我们引入了 Dory1.0-4B，这是一个具有弹性深度的 40 亿参数循环（潜在循环）语言模型：单个检查点服务于不同的推理计算预算。 Dory1.0-4B 构建在归一化 Transformer (nGPT) 主干上，具有交错的滑动窗口和全注意力层，组织为输入块、共享循环块和输出块。据推断，循环块可以应用可变次数。我们用 6 万亿个代币对 Dory1.0-4B 进行了预训练。前 4.5 万亿个令牌在 NVFP4 中进行训练，然后额外的预训练将上下文长度扩展到 256K 个令牌。接下来，我们使用监督微调（SFT）和具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对模型进行后训练，并使用难度感知循环课程将较难的提示路由到更深的循环。增加循环计数可以提高准确性，在编码、代理和长上下文基准测试中获得最大收益。通过两个或更多循环，Dory1.0-4B 在 12 个基准测试中的平均性能优于 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B 和 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 等较大模型。循环还使 Dory1.0-4B 在代理基准上更具令牌效率：使用四个循环，它生成的令牌比使用一个循环少 1.3-2.5 倍，因为额外的计算花费在潜在空间而不是较长的输出上。为了减少循环期间的内存，Dory1.0-4B 仅缓存最后一个循环的键和值，在任何循环计数下使其 KV 缓存占用量与非循环模型的占用量相同，同时保留大部分精度增益。我们开源了 BF16、MXFP8、NVFP4 和 GGUF 量化检查点。

papers.title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches
papers.summary: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1 mean by +0.4 to +1.9 points on the three of four models where 2-bit KIVI loses accuracy. It also lowers the error of 4-bit integer and FP4 caches.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，思路新颖实用，但证据仍需更全面。
pros: 抓住“旋转并非总收益”的关键反例，提出选择性旋转机制有新意
方法与量化轴对齐（per-head/per-key）并考虑工程落地，vLLM插件验证增强实用价值
cons: 摘要仅给出部分基线与模型覆盖，缺少开销、稳定性与极端场景的系统性消融
提升幅度在部分基准上偏中等，泛化到更多架构与更长上下文的说服力仍有限

papers.title_zh: FlagRot：低位 KV 缓存的选择性轮换
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文推理受到 KV 缓存的约束，如果错误得到控制，2 位代码可以缩小约六倍。通常的补救措施是在量化之前旋转关键点，假设旋转总是有帮助的。然而，我们观察到事实并非如此：旋转使键的尖峰部分变平，但可以给平的部分一个新的峰值，并且两者共存于一个键内。因此，我们提出 FlagRot，它存储每个旋转的 32 通道片段或按原样存储，以校准注意误差较小者为准，并在读取时旋转查询。我们进一步表明，决定的频率遵循量化轴：每通道缓存（例如 KIVI）需要每个头一个决定，而无需写入成本，而每令牌缓存决定每个键，并将选择存储在现有符号位中。在每个值 2.5 位的情况下，FlagRot 将 KIVI 的 12 个模型 KL 散度从 18.7 降低到 12.4 x 10^-3，在 12 个模型中的 9 个上低于 RotateKV。作为 vLLM 插件，它在 128k 代币的 RULER 上提高了 +2.9 点，在 2 位 KIVI 失去准确性的四个模型中的三个模型上，LongBench v1 平均值提高了 +0.4 到 +1.9 点。它还降低了 4 位整数和 FP4 缓存的错误。

papers.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
papers.summary: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. Both respond to hard targets by equipping the agent with more: parsed profiler output, disassembly analysis, retrieval over documentation and libraries, and stores of lessons. We argue that both lack direction, a hypothesis about where the remaining gap is, and that a short question asked at the right moment supplies it without narrowing what the agent may do next. We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a general-purpose coding agent, a minimal harness that enforces a verifiable goal, and questions at decision points, first from a human, then from a bank the agent applies to itself. On the same task, evaluator, hardware, and week, a tool-rich autonomous agent built in the prevailing style plateaued at 0.50x FlashAttention-3 after 133 model-driven steps; KernelSeek reached 1.13x. It then produced dependency-free FlashAttention forward kernels for Hopper and Blackwell, single CUDA files with no CUTLASS, CuTe, cuBLAS, or cuDNN, correct on all 182 scenarios per architecture and 1.16x FlashAttention-3 and 1.46x FlashAttention-4 (geometric mean). Across 162 human messages and 11.5K agent tool calls, every large gain followed a question that moved the agent to a different layer of the system or rejected a claimed limit, never one that supplied information. We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且结果亮眼，但证据链仍偏单薄。
pros: 提出“问题驱动”代理范式，较好切中现有脚本化与开放式方法的方向性缺口
在高价值GPU内核优化任务上报告了显著速度收益，并承诺公开轨迹与工件
cons: 实验覆盖面窄，核心结论主要来自单一任务与有限对照，外部可推广性不足
因果归因不够严谨，尚难排除模型能力、工程迭代与人工介入强度等混杂因素

papers.title_zh: 询问，不要装备：用于深度内核优化的问题驱动编码代理
papers.summary_zh: 用于 GPU 内核优化的 LLM 代理位于结构自由权衡的两端。脚本化代理通过学习策略、优化菜单或固定角色来修复模型在每个步骤中执行的操作，并且在适用配方的地方具有样本效率，在不适用配方的地方则停滞不前。开放式智能体让自我导向的模型改变一群内核，并为试验中的自由付出代价：数千次评估、重复编辑和错误的候选者。两者都通过为代理配备更多功能来响应硬目标：解析分析器输出、反汇编分析、文档和库检索以及课程存储。我们认为两者都缺乏方向，即对剩余差距在哪里的假设，并且在正确的时刻提出一个简短的问题可以提供方向，而不会缩小智能体下一步可能做什么。我们提出了 KernelSeek，一个问题驱动的代理，它使现有的 CUDA 内核更快，无需特定于操作员的知识，也无需模仿更快的实现：通用编码代理，强制执行可验证目标的最小工具，以及决策点的问题，首先来自人类，然后来自代理应用于自身的银行。在相同的任务、评估器、硬件和周内，以流行风格构建的工具丰富的自主代理在 133 个模型驱动步骤后稳定在 0.50x FlashAttention-3； KernelSeek 达到 1.13 倍。然后，它为 Hopper 和 Blackwell 生成了无依赖性的 FlashAttention 前向内核、没有 CUTLASS、CuTe、cuBLAS 或 cuDNN 的单个 CUDA 文件，在每个架构的所有 182 个场景上都正确，并且是 1.16 倍的 FlashAttention-3 和 1.46 倍的 FlashAttention-4（几何平均值）。在 162 条人工消息和 11,500 次代理工具调用中，每一次重大收获都伴随着一个问题，该问题将代理移至系统的不同层或拒绝声称的限制，但从未提供信息。我们发布了内核、工具、问题库和所有痕迹。

papers.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
papers.summary: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering MHA and GQA, and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3x relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0x relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost (-93%), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8x more.
papers.comment: Submitted to Future Generation Computer Systems

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果亮眼，但泛化与因果验证仍不足
pros: 提出可解释的四参数解析律，区分prefill与decode关键能耗项
跨13个LLM在H100上取得较强预测精度，并给出对GQA与推理预算的实用洞见

未见误差分解与统计显著性细节，11.97% MAPE在高波动在线负载下可能仍偏高

papers.title_zh: LLM 推理能源成本的简单法则
papers.summary_zh: 生成式人工智能按代币计费，但代币并不同样昂贵。每个令牌进入 KV 缓存并提高后续令牌的成本，因此能量沿着令牌看起来相同的序列非线性增长。没有分析模型说明代币的成本，最准确的 SOTA 模型是一个拟合，而不是一个定律：它将架构吸收到拟合系数中，需要每个 LLM 拟合。我们根据架构超参数推导了 LLM 推理的计算和内存访问复杂性的封闭式表达式，涵盖 MHA 和 GQA，并比较了一系列粒度递增的分析模型。由此，我们获得了预测 LLM 能量的简单推理模型 (SIMPLE)，这是一个四参数定律，将预填充与解码分开，并解码为 KV 缓存成本和下一个令牌计算。在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对来自 6 个系列的 13 个密集 LLM 进行跟踪后，它获得了 R2 = 0.969 和 11.97% MAPE，比 SOTA 低 3.1-3.5 倍，无需进行每个 LLM 校准。 SIMPLE 定律解释并预测：预填充能量随隐藏维度呈二次方增长，因此较大的 LLM 受到长输入的影响最大；与标准 MHA 相比，更积极的 GQA KV 分组可将每个代币的能量降低多达 3 倍。增加推理代币预算使输出长度超出分析得出的能量最小值，推动超线性能量增长；虽然准确性随着预算的增加而增加，但能量的增长速度更快，因此每焦耳智能在中间预算时达到峰值，并在 4.0 倍推理预算范围内下降最多 3.14 倍。由于预填充和 KV 缓存项随输入长度的增长，代理服务相对于非代理服务将每个请求的能量提高了 13.0 倍；虽然前缀缓存消除了大部分预填充成本 (-93%)，但 KV 缓存项不受影响，因此即使是缓存的代理请求，成本也会增加 4.8 倍。

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.summary: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.
papers.comment: 20 pages (8 pages main text), 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta, December 12, 2026. Code: https://github.com/ArjunKrishnak/dsa-multi-layer-indexer

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但证据链仍偏系统优化层面。
pros: 抓住DSA解码瓶颈并用跨层重叠并行化，思路实用且可部署

papers.title_zh: 多层索引器：DeepSeek稀疏注意力中的重叠选择和注意力
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏注意力通过使注意力矩阵稀疏来降低长上下文推理的成本：每个查询仅关注序列的一个子集，由固定模式选择，或者在最近的生产法学硕士中，每个查询都学习。在 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力 (DSA)、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5 系列的注意力中，每一层之前都有一个闪电索引器，该索引器对整个缓存进行评分，并保留 k=2048 个最高得分令牌供该层参与。在长上下文中，解码时间花在索引器扫描上，而不是它所提供的稀疏注意力上。但相邻层选择几乎相同的标记，因此层可以参与前一个索引器层的选择，而不是自己的选择。这消除了依赖性：每个索引器然后与其层的注意力同时运行。由此产生的多层索引器 (MLI) 不需要重新训练，也不需要新的权重。它的默认实现不改变内核，在 SGLang 的生产解码图中运行；可选的融合解码内核可在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上进一步加速。 MLI 与 IndexCache 组合（跨层重用 GLM-5.2 作为 IndexShare 提供）：IndexCache 从某些层删除索引器，MLI 隐藏其余层的扫描。我们在 IndexCache 协议下提供 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5，保留量为 1/2 到 1/32（保留索引器的层的分数），上下文为 10K 到 195K。在保留相同的情况下，该组合的解码速度比 IndexCache 更快：在 1/2 时，DeepSeek-V3.2 上快了 14.5%，在 GLM-5 上快了 9.8%，在 1/4 时分别快了 7.9% 和 5.1%，其中 IndexCache 保留了最多的索引器，并随着上下文而增长。在保留 1/r 时，它仍然比 IndexCache 在 1/(2r) 时更快，同时保留两倍的新鲜选择：在 128K 时，它达到未修改模型解码吞吐量的 1.32 倍（1/4 时），高于 IndexCache 1/8 时的 1.28 倍。它的 LongBench、RULER 和 LongBench v2 准确度与 IndexCache 的准确度相差几个百分点。

papers.title: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
papers.summary: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.

papers.title_zh: DepthGraft：通过分层跨层 KV 重建进行结构正则化
papers.summary_zh: 扩展深度是实现更强大的大型语言模型的关键途径，但 Pre-LN 架构经常遭受深度信息稀释，限制了深层的有效使用。虽然跨层连接已被证明可以有效缓解此问题，但现有设计通常会引入额外的计算或内存访问。我们重新审视跨层 KV 共享作为这种连接的有效形式。除了缓存压缩之外，每个 KV 重用边缘都会创建从深层到源 KV 投影的直接梯度路径，将 KV 共享转变为 KV 表示几何的隐式结构正则化器。我们对该机制进行了系统分析，表明适当的共享拓扑可以在丰富价值内容子空间的同时锐化关键检索方向，而现有的相邻或全局锚设计并没有充分利用这种效果。受此启发，我们提出了 DepthGraft，一种分层 KV 共享架构，它从跨步对齐的浅层中间源对重建深层 KV。 DepthGraft 在源层之间分配非局部梯度流，同时保留预填充的早期完成并将 KV 缓存减少大约三分之一。对从 0.5B 到 16B 参数的密集模型和 MoE 模型进行的实验表明，GQA 和 MLA 下下游的改进一致。值得注意的是，在 16B MoE 模型上，DepthGraft 比 MMLU-Pro 实现了 7.0% 的绝对改进，在 CMMLU 上实现了 6.6% 的增益，在 C3 上实现了 6.4% 的增益。这些结果验证了 DepthGraft 作为大规模预训练的可扩展设计的潜力。项目页面位于https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft。

papers.title: Introducing Cluster Efficiency to LLM Serving: Pooling Economical Accelerators over Fast Interconnects
papers.summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) serving places substantial demands on compute, memory capacity, and memory bandwidth. Economical accelerators can offer these resources at lower cost, but their limited per-device capacity requires pooling across devices, making communication overhead critical. We study cluster efficiency, measured in tokens per dollar and per joule, and show how low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnects enable economical accelerators to retain their cost advantage. Guided by a characterization of coding-agent workloads and accelerator scaling, we realize this design on the Tenstorrent Galaxy, a cluster of Blackhole chips. The serving stack combines integrated communication engines, pipelined ring transfers, communication-computation overlap, and device-side decode replay to reduce collective overhead. Across three dense models in BF16 and 8-bit configurations with 8K-256K-token contexts, the Galaxy achieves 1.07-2.24$\times$ the tokens per dollar of an eight-GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell server under a three-year acquisition-and-electricity cost model. Emulating TCP-class communication on the same chips reduces throughput by 23.5-67.4% and eliminates the cost advantage in every evaluated configuration. These results demonstrate how fast interconnects translate the per-dollar resource advantages of economical accelerators into cost-efficient long-context LLM serving.

papers.title_zh: 将集群效率引入 LLM 服务：通过快速互连汇集经济型加速器
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 服务对计算、内存容量和内存带宽提出了很高的要求。经济型加速器可以以较低的成本提供这些资源，但其每台设备的容量有限，需要跨设备进行池化，这使得通信开销变得至关重要。我们研究以每美元和每焦耳的代币衡量的集群效率，并展示低延迟、高带宽互连如何使经济型加速器保持其成本优势。在编码代理工作负载和加速器扩展特性的指导下，我们在 Tenstorrent Galaxy（黑洞芯片集群）上实现了这一设计。服务堆栈结合了集成通信引擎、流水线环传输、通信计算重叠和设备端解码重放，以减少集体开销。在具有 8K-256K 代币环境的 BF16 和 8 位配置的三种密集模型中，在三年购置和电力成本模型下，Galaxy 实现了 8 GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器每美元 1.07-2.24$\times$ 的代币成本。在相同芯片上模拟 TCP 级通信可将吞吐量降低 23.5-67.4%，并消除每个评估配置的成本优势。这些结果表明，快速互连如何将经济型加速器的单位美元资源优势转化为经济高效的长上下文法学硕士服务。

papers.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by reducing the sequential cost of token-by-token generation. Advanced SD methods reduce proposal cost with parallel drafters that predict entire blocks in one forward pass, but overall speedup still depends on acceptance length. On-policy distillation (OPD) can push well-trained drafters beyond acceptance-length plateaus, yet conventional pipelines collect supervision through sequential draft-and-verify rollouts. Our key insight is that on-policy supervision need not inherit these dependencies: a draft block can be supervised using only its reference prefix and draft-sampled history. We propose SpecOPD, a branch-parallel OPD framework that parallelizes draft sampling and target supervision across independent branches drawn from the evolving drafter policy at reference anchors. We pack these branches into proposal trees to share target-prefix computation, using tree masks for full attention, branch-consistent indexer groups for sparse attention, and indexed state replay for linear attention to preserve each branch's history. We train the drafter with an E2E-TV surrogate that directly targets acceptance length. Our study spans 8B full-attention (GQA), 27B full-linear (GQA--GDN), and 125B sparse-linear (QSA--GDN) targets, three parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark, and DFlash V2), and four task domains (dialogue, coding, mathematics, and agentic). SpecOPD achieves up to 41.45% higher mean acceptance length, $16.09\times$ supervised-token throughput over sequential-rollout OPD under native configurations, and up to $3.56\times$ generation speedup over autoregressive decoding.

papers.title_zh: SpecOPD：用于推测解码的分支并行同策略蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过减少逐个令牌生成的顺序成本来加速大型语言模型推理。先进的 SD 方法通过并行绘图器在一次前向传递中预测整个块来降低提案成本，但总体加速仍然取决于接受长度。按政策蒸馏 (OPD) 可以推动训练有素的起草人员超越验收长度平台，而传统管道通过顺序起草和验证推出来收集监督。我们的主要见解是，在策略监督不需要继承这些依赖关系：可以仅使用其参考前缀和草稿采样历史记录来监督草稿块。我们提出了 SpecOPD，这是一个分支并行的 OPD 框架，它可以并行地跨独立分支进行草稿采样和目标监督，这些独立分支是从参考锚点不断发展的起草者策略中得出的。我们将这些分支打包到提议树中以共享目标前缀计算，使用树掩码进行充分注意，使用分支一致的索引器组进行稀疏注意，并使用索引状态重放进行线性注意以保留每个分支的历史记录。我们使用直接针对接受长度的 E2E-TV 代理来培训起草者。我们的研究涵盖 8B 全注意力 (GQA)、27B 全线性 (GQA--GDN) 和 125B 稀疏线性 (QSA--GDN) 目标、三个并行草案架构（DFlash、DSpark 和 DFlash V2）以及四个任务域（对话、编码、数学和代理）。与本机配置下的顺序推出 OPD 相比，SpecOPD 的平均接受长度提高了 41.45%，监督令牌吞吐量提高了 16.09 美元倍，生成速度比自回归解码提高了 3.56 倍。

papers.title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants built on multi-scale causal EMA-attention and GRU-based recurrent modules. Its design also accounts for the execution characteristics of LLM serving frameworks, such as SGLang, optimizing computation and data access to minimize additional runtime and synchronization overhead. As a result, PGuard incurs only 0.82-2.26% end-to-end overhead on the hundred-billion-parameter backbone Qwen3.5-122B-A10B served by SGLang. Extensive evaluations across more than 30 benchmarks spanning text and multimodal safety, jailbreaks, cyber and CBRN risks, multilingual scenarios, and real-world traffic demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among native guardrails. On text queries with Qwen3.5-9B, PGuard achieves an average F1 score of 0.836, approaching dedicated external guardrails, while supporting deployment-time configuration of category-specific thresholds and enforcement actions.

papers.title_zh: PGuard：用于多模式大型语言模型的本机、流式传输和插件护栏
papers.summary_zh: 随着流式生成成为纯文本和多模式大语言模型的主要服务范例，确保整个生成过程的安全性已成为一项关键挑战。我们引入了 PGuard，这是一种原生的、流式的、插件式的护栏，它将安全监控从外部服务依赖转变为骨干模型的集成功能。 PGuard 直接利用主干的中间表示进行令牌级安全检测，而不改变其原始推理路径或生成行为。具体来说，动态层选通有选择地聚合跨层的残余流表示，以在预填充和自回归解码期间提取与安全相关的信号。为了平衡检测精度和计算效率，PGuard 支持多种表示建模架构，包括基于多尺度因果 EMA-attention 和基于 GRU 的循环模块构建的轻量级无状态变体和序列感知变体。其设计还考虑了 LLM 服务框架（例如 SGLang）的执行特性，优化计算和数据访问以最大限度地减少额外的运行时和同步开销。因此，PGuard 在 SGLang 服务的千亿参数主干 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上仅产生 0.82-2.26% 的端到端开销。对 30 多个基准的广泛评估涵盖文本和多模式安全、越狱、网络和 CBRN 风险、多语言场景和现实世界交通，展示了本机护栏中最先进的性能。在使用 Qwen3.5-9B 进行文本查询时，PGuard 的平均 F1 分数为 0.836，接近专用外部护栏，同时支持特定类别阈值和强制操作的部署时配置。

papers.title: Parallelism-Aligned Pruning and Round-Aware Context Reuse for On-Device Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: On-device multimodal agents are limited by two deployment mismatches: pretrained attention structures may not divide evenly across the compute cores of an edge accelerator, causing irregular partitions; and standard prefix caching keeps historical visual tokens in the persistent KV cache, whose capacity grows with the number of rounds. We present PARC, which combines parallelism-aligned structured pruning with lifetime-aware KV-cache reorganization. At the model level, it uses first-order Taylor importance and grouped-query-attention-aware selection to make attention dimensions divisible by the target core count while preserving the query-to-key/value ratio and head dimension. At runtime, it separates the system prompt, persistent text history, and transient visual observations by lifetime, updating text history during tool execution so that historical images leave the persistent cache and more interaction rounds fit a fixed budget. On 2,062 GUI actions, the incremental interface shows no accuracy regression, and task-aware recovery training restores 98.7% of the action-type accuracy gap and the coordinate hit rate to the original level. Under seven-core deployment, hardware-aligned pruning reduces vision-encoder latency by 11.4%, improves decoding throughput by 23.8%, and lowers per-heap high-water memory by 12.7%; a parameter-matched control confirms that the speedup stems mainly from core alignment rather than parameter reduction.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但方法新意与证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 设备上多模式代理的并行对齐修剪和循环感知上下文重用
papers.summary_zh: 设备上的多模式代理受到两个部署不匹配的限制：预训练的注意力结构可能无法均匀地分布在边缘加速器的计算核心上，从而导致不规则的分区；标准前缀缓存将历史视觉令牌保存在持久的 KV 缓存中，其容量随着轮数的增加而增长。我们提出了 PARC，它将并行对齐的结构化修剪与生命周期感知的 KV 缓存重组相结合。在模型层面，它使用一阶泰勒重要性和分组查询注意力感知选择，使注意力维度可被目标核心数整除，同时保留查询与键/值的比率和头部维度。在运行时，它将系统提示、持久文本历史记录和瞬态视觉观察按生命周期分开，在工具执行期间更新文本历史记录，以便历史图像离开持久缓存，并且更多交互轮次适合固定预算。在2062个GUI动作上，增量界面没有表现出精度回归，任务感知恢复训练将98.7%的动作类型精度差距和坐标命中率恢复到原来的水平。在七核部署下，硬件对齐剪枝可将视觉编码器延迟降低 11.4%，将解码吞吐量提高 23.8%，并将每堆高水位内存降低 12.7%；参数匹配控制证实加速主要源于核心对齐而不是参数减少。

papers.title: BasisKV: Value Latents for Communication and Key Routing
papers.summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the cost of maintaining an ever-growing KV-cache. Low-rank K/V projections provide a promising way to compress the KV-cache with minimal quality loss, but prior work has largely optimized KV-cache compression in isolation, leaving distributed inference, especially with tensor parallelism where attention computation is partitioned across multiple GPUs, largely underexplored. We make two observations: (i) tensor-parallel communication is an important cost when deploying low-rank KV-cache compression in distributed inference; and (ii) Value compression can be associated with the output projection, allowing the same low-rank Value representation to reduce both Value-cache width and tensor-parallel communication. Based on these observations, we propose BasisKV, a low-rank KV-cache compression method for communication-intensive, long-context LLM inference. BasisKV jointly optimizes the low-rank factors across per-GPU attention partitions against the complete attention output, rather than fitting each partition in isolation. The compressed Value cache is further reused to help identify which Key pages should be accessed: it predicts part of the Key information needed for routing, while a Key-specific residual stores what cannot be recovered from Value. The original Keys are then retrieved only for the selected pages to compute exact QK scores. Across multiple LLM families and system settings, BasisKV achieves a better quality--efficiency tradeoff than existing low-rank baselines, reaching up to 1.42x end-to-end speedup under 8-GPU tensor-parallel inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/alexz949/BasisKV

papers.title_zh: BasisKV：通信和关键路由的潜在价值
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 推理越来越受到维护不断增长的 KV 缓存成本的限制。低秩 K/V 投影提供了一种以最小质量损失压缩 KV 缓存的有前途的方法，但之前的工作在很大程度上单独优化了 KV 缓存压缩，留下了分布式推理，特别是在张量并行性中，注意力计算被划分到多个 GPU 上，很大程度上尚未得到充分探索。我们提出两个观察结果：（i）在分布式推理中部署低秩 KV 缓存压缩时，张量并行通信是一个重要的成本； (ii) 值压缩可以与输出投影相关联，允许相同的低秩值表示来减少值缓存宽度和张量并行通信。基于这些观察，我们提出了 BasisKV，一种用于通信密集型、长上下文 LLM 推理的低秩 KV 缓存压缩方法。 BasisKV 针对完整的注意力输出联合优化每个 GPU 注意力分区的低秩因子，而不是单独拟合每个分区。压缩后的 Value 缓存被进一步重用，以帮助识别应该访问哪些 Key 页面：它预测路由所需的部分 Key 信息，而特定于 Key 的残差存储无法从 Value 中恢复的内容。然后仅检索所选页面的原始密钥以计算准确的 QK 分数。在多个 LLM 系列和系统设置中，BasisKV 实现了比现有低秩基线更好的质量-效率权衡，在 8-GPU 张量并行推理下达到高达 1.42 倍的端到端加速。我们的代码位于 https://github.com/alexz949/BasisKV

papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

papers.title_zh: SpecPilot：推测解码的自主算法发现和系统优化
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过轻量级起草器加速内存限制的 LLM 解码，而并行起草器通过在一次前向传递中起草整个块来扩展这种加速。然而，目前尚不清楚他们发布的系统（库存）是否达到了并行起草允许的全部加速。我们确定了三个挑战。首先，通过一个请求，每个步骤接受很少的令牌，但读取每个目标权重。其次，通过批处理，每个请求的验证工作比自回归 (AR) 解码的速度大约减半。第三，推测性解码是特定于部署的，并且没有适合每个服务机制、起草者、目标模型和 GPU 的通用优化。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 SpecPilot，这是一个自主代理循环，可以发现每个部署的算法和系统优化。在每一轮中，成本模型都会找出当前系统与其上限之间的最大差距。并行代理探索方向并整合成功的方向。代币强制根据库存检查每个输出代币，以检测奖励黑客行为。结构化内存将经过验证的机制带到新的回合和部署中。 SpecPilot 发现了通用的无损 12 位权重格式、混合循环目标的树验证、两级验证和三种批处理机制。我们通过四个目标模型、三个绘图器、两个 GPU 平台和五个基准对其进行评估。在没有训练或质量损失的情况下，它通过一个请求将 AR 的加速比从库存的 4.46$\times$ 提高到 10.87$\times$，通过批处理从 1.94$\times$ 提高到 3.93$\times$。

papers.title: Turbo-GMM: FlashAttention-Inspired GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Mixture Model
papers.summary: Expectation-maximization (EM) for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) requires scoring $N$ data points against $K$ mixture components. Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components. For larger configurations, Turbo-GMM employs a two-pass fallback following the established fused design. We establish algebraic equivalence to standard EM in real arithmetic and evaluate sixteen configurations on an NVIDIA A100. Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a median $2.15\times$ speedup over the evaluated Flash-GMM implementation and up to $5.3\times$ and $9.9\times$ over PyTorch and \texttt{scikit-learn}, respectively. The results demonstrate the potential of single-sweep component traversal while identifying on-chip resource constraints as the principal limitation of this approach.
