papers.title_zh: Turbo-GMM：受 FlashAttention 启发的 GPU 加速高斯混合模型
papers.summary_zh: 高斯混合模型 (GMM) 的期望最大化 (EM) 需要针对 $K$ 混合分量对 $N$ 数据点进行评分。 Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components.对于较大的配置，Turbo-GMM 采用遵循既定融合设计的两遍回退。我们在实际算术中建立了与标准 EM 的代数等价性，并在 NVIDIA A100 上评估了 16 种配置。 Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a median $2.15\times$ speedup over the evaluated Flash-GMM implementation and up to $5.3\times$ and $9.9\times$ over PyTorch and \texttt{scikit-learn}, respectively. The results demonstrate the potential of single-sweep component traversal while identifying on-chip resource constraints as the principal limitation of this approach.

papers.title: EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. Code is available at https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但外推证据仍偏有限。
pros: 提出共享校准+证据状态分解，能在部署前预测RAG净收益并给出置信下界

papers.title_zh: EviCast：通过共享响应校准预测检索增益
papers.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）利用外部证据扩展了大型语言模型，但相关证据并不能确保生成器可以使用它。不加区别的检索会降低任务性能，同时增加检索和长上下文推理成本。现有方法既不能在大规模执行之前确定生成器、任务分配和检索器配置是否值得部署，也不能在共享预算下诊断多个候选检索器。我们引入了 EviCast，一个通过介入性证据状态分解来预测检索价值的框架。 EviCast 测量生成器对受控证据状态的响应一次，并将此共享配置文件与每个候选检索器的离线证据状态分布相结合，产生端到端网络效用及其 95% 的置信下限，而无需执行每个 RAG 配置。状态细化分析的特征是其二进制和拓扑感知实例何时准确，以及共享校准在统计上比每个检索器校准更有效。在冻结评估中，EviCast 正确决定了所有 14 个 HotpotQA 检索配置，预测误差为 2.75 F1 点，同时将诊断生成调用减少了 80%，并且在低预算制度下的七个预测器中实现了最低的预测误差。其拓扑感知实例化 EviCast-T 捕获了终端和桥证据之间的互补性，正确判定 MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 上的所有 16 个配置，以及在预期传输到第三个数据集后的 24 个配置中的 23 个。这些结果表明，检索部署取决于证据可用性和生成器将证据结构转换为稳定净效用的能力。代码可在 https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast 获取。

papers.title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM serving by drafting tokens that the target model verifies in one pass, and its gain grows with the drafts the target accepts. Structured outputs should be an ideal case, because much of a record follows from relations among its fields: an itinerary's days follow from its cities' stays and flights. Serving engines, however, draft such text by proposing it from the prompt or a learned head, and their grammar masks enforce only syntax, so the model must satisfy the relations, which it violates: on NATURAL PLAN's trip problems, Qwen3-8B writes a valid itinerary for 10%, and retries that name the violated relation raise this to 14%. We present FactorSpec, which serves exact relational constraints as speculative drafts. FactorSpec compiles a JSON Schema and its relations into a factor graph with an exact feasibility check, drafts every token the constraint determines as certain, verifies each request at a width chosen for it, and computes the masks in worker processes outside the scheduler while the GPU runs. In SGLang, its drafts yield up to 10.5 tokens per verify step, up to 1.9x those of the fastest n-gram drafter, and it decodes up to 1.43x faster than speculators tuned per load, at a grammar mask's cost; it also leads in vLLM. Because every record is also valid, it serves up to 13.9x the valid records per GPU-second of syntax-only baselines.

papers.title_zh: FactorSpec：作为推测草案提供精确的关系约束
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过起草目标模型一次性验证的令牌来加速 LLM 服务，并且其增益随着目标接受的草案而增长。结构化输出应该是一个理想的情况，因为大部分记录都来自其领域之间的关系：行程的天数取决于其城市的停留和航班。然而，服务引擎通过从提示或学习头中提议来起草此类文本，并且它们的语法掩码仅强制执行语法，因此模型必须满足它所违反的关系：在 NATURAL PLAN 的行程问题上，Qwen3-8B 编写了 10% 的有效行程，并重试命名违反的关系，将其提高到 14%。我们提出 FactorSpec，它作为投机草案提供精确的关系约束。 FactorSpec 通过精确的可行性检查将 JSON 模式及其关系编译成因子图，起草约束确定为确定的每个标记，以为其选择的宽度验证每个请求，并在 GPU 运行时计算调度程序外部工作进程中的掩码。在 SGLang 中，其草稿每个验证步骤最多可产生 10.5 个令牌，是最快的 n-gram 草稿器的 1.9 倍，并且其解码速度比每次加载调整的投机器快 1.43 倍，而代价是语法掩码；它在 vLLM 领域也处于领先地位。由于每条记录也是有效的，因此每 GPU 秒提供的有效记录数是纯语法基线的 13.9 倍。

papers.title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
papers.summary: Key-value (KV) cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention scores, and each layer scores its own cache. To our knowledge, no eviction method asks which layer should score. We find, across twenty-one models, that the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality. On the eighteen models with per-layer caches, spanning 0.5B to 109B, long-context retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks between 0.4 and 0.75 of depth, and degrades at the last layer. The curve arises because a layer judges tokens well only once it has used the question to find the answer, which takes several layers. Modeling eviction as a top-$k$ cut, we compute answer survival probability from prefill attention and reproduce the measured curves. This approach selects the scoring layer using calibration prompts with known answers, and the selected layer is the best layer measured on most models and never significantly below it. It improves on the own-layer default on sixteen of the eighteen models, with significant gains on seven, all at 14B or below, while on larger models the default is already close to the best mid-depth layer. Scoring every cache from the selected layer while keeping one set of tokens for all heads also beats per-head SnapKV by 18 to 43 points on five models up to 14B under tight budgets. This gain carries over to financial filings at 32K context, all at the same memory budget, with no extra forward pass. The same curve explains a penalty in shared-cache models, where several layers read one cache and the layer that writes it scores by default. On Gemma-4-E2B the writer is shallow and loses 28 points to a mid-depth reader at a 10% budget. We also find that in open-book question answering (LongBench) no mid-depth layer beats the own-layer default.

papers.title_zh: 谁应该对缓存进行评分？中深度层是 KV 缓存驱逐的最佳判断者
papers.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存驱逐方法根据注意力分数对令牌进行排名，并且每个层对自己的缓存进行评分。据我们所知，没有驱逐方法询问哪一层应该评分。我们发现，在 21 个模型中，评分层的深度决定驱逐质量。在具有每层缓存（范围从 0.5B 到 109B）的 18 个模型上，长上下文检索精度在浅层处崩溃，在深度 0.4 到 0.75 之间达到峰值，并在最后一层下降。之所以出现这条曲线，是因为一层只有在使用问题找到答案后才能很好地判断标记，这需要几个层。将驱逐建模为 top-$k$ 削减，我们从预填充注意力中计算答案生存概率并重现测量的曲线。此方法使用具有已知答案的校准提示来选择评分层，并且所选层是在大多数模型上测量的最佳层，并且绝不会明显低于它。它改进了 18 个模型中 16 个模型的自层默认值，其中 7 个模型有显着提升，全部为 14B 或更低，而在较大模型上，默认值已经接近最佳中深度层。对所选层的每个缓存进行评分，同时为所有头保留一组令牌，在预算紧张的情况下，在高达 14B 的 5 个模型上，每头 SnapKV 也比每头 SnapKV 好 18 到 43 点。这种增益可以延续到 32K 环境下的财务归档，所有这些都具有相同的内存预算，没有额外的前向传递。同一条曲线解释了共享缓存模型中的惩罚，其中多个层读取一个缓存，而写入该缓存的层默认得分。在 Gemma-4-E2B 上，作者很浅薄，在 10% 的预算下比中等深度的读者损失了 28 分。我们还发现，在开卷问答（LongBench）中，没有任何中间深度层能够击败本层默认层。

papers.title: Fairway: Load-Aware KV Cache Reuse for LLM Prefill Scheduling
papers.summary: LLM-based applications often employ agentic workflows and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which build long prompts from shared context. When prefixes are shared across requests, serving engines reuse the key-value (KV) cache to skip parts of the prefill computation. Reuse is typically graded: the uncached work of requests in a queue can differ by up to 100x. In this setting, the order of scheduling determines the time-to-first-token (TTFT) for the queued requests. KV reuse-first scheduling, which prioritizes the requests with the longest KV cache hit, gives the lowest median TTFT but starves expensive requests under load spikes; first-come-first-served (FCFS) scheduling bounds the tail but raises the median TTFT. We present Fairway, a prefill scheduler built on adaptive reuse prioritization: it favors KV cache reuse while queues are short, and shifts toward fair allocation as requests wait longer relative to their own prefill time. Fairway employs a virtual dual lane model: a KV reuse-first Fast lane and a Fair lane atop the serving engine's waiting queue that enables speeding up of cheap reuse requests without starving expensive ones. This model automatically adapts to the workload without any per-workload tuning. Fairway lowers the tail TTFT at no cost to the median in transient overload. Across workloads and load levels, Fairway matches or beats the best baseline, with a p99 TTFT up to 8.6x lower than prior prefix-aware schedulers. During load spikes, it keeps the tail of FCFS at a 6x lower median TTFT.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用但创新幅度中等。
pros: 针对KV复用下TTFT中位数与长尾冲突提出自适应折中，工程价值高

papers.title_zh: Fairway：用于 LLM 预填充调度的负载感知 KV 缓存重用
papers.summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的应用程序通常采用代理工作流程和检索增强生成 (RAG)，从共享上下文构建长提示。当前缀在请求之间共享时，服务引擎会重用键值 (KV) 缓存来跳过部分预填充计算。重用通常是分级的：队列中请求的未缓存工作最多可能相差 100 倍。在此设置中，调度顺序决定了排队请求的首次令牌时间 (TTFT)。 KV 重用优先调度，优先考虑具有最长 KV 缓存命中的请求，提供最低的中值 TTFT，但在负载峰值时会导致昂贵的请求匮乏；先来先服务 (FCFS) 调度限制了尾部，但提高了 TTFT 中值。我们提出了 Fairway，一个基于自适应重用优先级构建的预填充调度程序：当队列较短时，它有利于 KV 缓存重用，并且当请求相对于其预填充时间等待更长的时间时，它会转向公平分配。 Fairway 采用虚拟双通道模型：KV 重用优先的快速通道和位于服务引擎等待队列顶部的公平通道，可以加速廉价的重用请求，而不会饿死昂贵的请求。该模型会自动适应工作负载，无需针对每个工作负载进行任何调整。 Fairway 在瞬态过载时免费将尾部 TTFT 降低至中值。在工作负载和负载级别上，Fairway 匹配或超越了最佳基线，p99 TTFT 比之前的前缀感知调度程序低 8.6 倍。在负载峰值期间，它将 FCFS 的尾部保持在中值 TTFT 的 6 倍以下。

papers.title: LARK: Lean-Assisted Reasoning for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.summary: Efficient GPU kernels are typically low-level and hardware-specific, and LLM agents can now generate them faster than experts can verify. Existing approaches rely on testing, which provides evidence but not a guarantee of correctness. We introduce LARK, an agentic framework that automatically and formally verifies GPU kernels against their PyTorch reference implementations. LARK proves equivalence in functional and memory behavior under exact arithmetic and establishes a new trust boundary: human effort is only needed to verify operator-level Lean semantics ahead of kernel generation time, instead of checking every single line of generated code. LARK formalizes the GPU machine model and the semantics of each operation in Lean 4 once per target language, and the Lean 4 semantics of any incoming kernel is derived from these pre-built definitions. LLM agents then automate the proof in two steps. First, an agent decomposes the whole kernel semantics into smaller segments and Lean 4 verifies this segmentation, which addresses the intractability of proving equivalence for large kernels directly. Second, agents write Lean proofs that each kernel segment matches its high-level PyTorch counterpart. Together, the two steps give whole-program equivalence. We demonstrate that LARK can be used 1) to ensure correctness in existing code-generation agents and 2) to automatically verify human-written kernel libraries. On the KernelCraft GPU tasks, combined with a simple ReAct agent, LARK enables GLM 5.3 to fully verify 10 of 12 Level-1 kernels and Opus 5.5 all 5 Level-2 kernels. Moreover, over 10 production kernels randomly sampled from popular open-source LLM serving frameworks, LARK verifies 9 and identifies a new data race bug in the tenth. We believe LARK represents a significant step toward verifiable code generation in the agentic era.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 方向新颖且潜力大，但可信度仍依赖补充细节。
pros: 把GPU内核形式化验证与LLM代码生成深度结合，问题切中痛点且有明确新意
提出可扩展的分段证明流程，并在基准与真实生产内核上展示了较强实证价值

papers.title_zh: LARK：LLM 生成的 GPU 内核的精益辅助推理
papers.summary_zh: 高效的 GPU 内核通常是低级且特定于硬件的，LLM 代理现在可以比专家验证的速度更快地生成它们。现有的方法依赖于测试，测试提供了证据，但不能保证正确性。我们引入 LARK，这是一个代理框架，可以根据 PyTorch 参考实现自动正式验证 GPU 内核。 LARK 证明了精确算术下功能和内存行为的等效性，并建立了新的信任边界：只需在内核生成时间之前验证操作员级精益语义，而不需要检查生成的每一行代码。 LARK 将 GPU 机器模型和 Lean 4 中每个操作的语义形式化为每种目标语言一次，任何传入内核的 Lean 4 语义都源自这些预构建的定义。然后，LLM 代理分两步自动完成证明。首先，代理将整个内核语义分解为更小的片段，Lean 4 验证此分段，这解决了直接证明大内核等效性的棘手问题。其次，代理编写精益证明，证明每个内核段与其高级 PyTorch 对应部分相匹配。这两个步骤一起提供了整个程序的等效性。我们证明 LARK 可用于 1) 确保现有代码生成代理的正确性，2) 自动验证人工编写的内核库。在 KernelCraft GPU 任务上，结合简单的 ReAct 代理，LARK 使 GLM 5.3 能够完全验证 12 个 Level-1 内核中的 10 个，以及 Opus 5.5 完全验证所有 5 个 Level-2 内核。此外，从流行的开源 LLM 服务框架中随机抽取的 10 多个生产内核，LARK 验证了 9 个，并在第 10 个中识别出新的数据竞争错误。我们相信 LARK 代表了代理时代向可验证代码生成迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: MedPsy: State-of-the-Art Small Medical Language Models for Efficient Edge Deployment
papers.summary: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.

高度依赖合成数据与大教师链路，潜在数据泄漏/蒸馏偏置及可复现性风险未在摘要中充分消解

papers.title_zh: MedPsy：用于高效边缘部署的最先进的小型医学语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 医学语言模型承诺提供专家临床支持，但最强大的开源法学硕士对于私有边缘设备部署来说仍然太大，而紧凑的医学模型在知识密集型和现实世界的医疗保健任务方面仍然远远落后。适合边缘内存预算的推理模型可能会产生长推理轨迹，从而增加顺序解码、端到端延迟、能耗和 KV 缓存内存压力。我们推出了 MedPsy，这是一系列纯文本 1.7B 和 4B 医学语言模型，专为边缘部署而设计，旨在实现准确性、生成效率和效率之间的权衡。我们的配方将生物学、医学和健康种子的综合医学数据管道与 235B 医学专业法学硕士老师的思想链目标结合起来；四阶段的后培训课程，包括两个 SFT 阶段和两个带有硬样本挖掘的 RL 阶段；以及跨多个 GGUF 量化变体的边缘部署评估以及笔记本电脑和智能手机硬件上的真实设备推理。在七个封闭式医疗基准中，MedPsy-4B 超过 MedGemma-1.5-4B 19.34 分，与 MedGemma-27B 相当，但尺寸小 6.75 倍；尽管尺寸还不到 MedGemma-1.5-4B 的一半，但 MedPsy-1.7B 的性能仍比 MedGemma-1.5-4B 高出 11.42 分。在 HealthBench-Hard 上，MedPsy-4B 超过 MedGemma-27B 15.33 分，而 MedPsy-1.7B 尽管尺寸小约 16 倍，但仍超过 MedPsy-1.7B 11.66 分。除了准确性之外，与 Qwen3 主干相比，MedPsy 将平均响应长度缩短了 1.7 倍 (1.7B) 和 3.2 倍 (4B)，而 Q4_K_M 量化将总得分保持在 BF16 的 1 分以内，磁盘占用空间减少了约 69%。在真实设备推理中，MedPsy-4B 的更短代数意味着，在匹配量化条件下，中位端到端延迟和每个答案的估计能量比其 Qwen3 主干网低 75%，而在我们测试的笔记本电脑和智能手机配置中，峰值 RAM 仍低于 5 GB。

papers.title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
papers.summary: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. Second, intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode, where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from KV cache quantization. We instantiate our findings as LoReS, a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude, decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels, and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. Across Qwen-3.5 9B, Nemotron-H 8B, and Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B, LoReS supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. We implement LoReS in vLLM and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但理论边界待补强
pros: 将循环模型量化拆分为 extra-state 与 intra-state 两类，问题定义清晰且有洞见
提出 LoReS 并在多种主流线性递归大模型与 vLLM 中验证，具备较强工程价值
cons: 摘要强调实证效果但缺少误差传播与稳定性理论刻画，跨任务与超长上下文泛化风险仍需更多证据

papers.title_zh: 量化循环语言模型比您想象的要容易
papers.summary_zh: 线性递归正在成为大型语言模型中越来越常见的构建块，用可实现高效解码的固定大小的递归状态取代了 softmax 注意力不断增长的 KV 缓存。然而，量化堆栈主要是围绕 softmax Transformer 开发的，其数值属性和推理状态与循环模型不同。我们的目标是了解这些差异并研究循环模型的量化方法的设计空间。在我们的分析中，我们区分了两个目标。首先，状态外量化涉及循环状态之外的权重和激活，其分布在训练期间由序列混合器间接塑造。在受控 1.3B 参数模型中，我们发现衰减循环产生比 softmax 注意力更弱的残差异常值通道，因此更容易在不进行不相干处理的情况下进行量化。其次，状态内量化涉及解码期间的循环状态本身，其中重复更新会产生与 KV 缓存量化不同的数值问题。我们将我们的发现实例化为 LoReS，这是一种状态量化管道，结合了值轴尺度分组以匹配输出通道幅度、基于衰减的混合精度以保护缓慢衰减的磁头或通道，以及随机舍入以限制重复重新量化下的误差累积。在 Qwen-3.5 9B、Nemotron-H 8B 和 Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B 中，LoReS 支持强大的 8 位状态量化和较短解码范围内的较低有效精度。我们在 vLLM 中实现 LoReS 并演示端到端解码加速。

papers.title: CacheWeave: Learning to Recompute for Efficient Position-Independent KV Caching
papers.summary: Position-independent caching reuses chunk KV caches across positions and requests. Independent encoding, however, omits cross-chunk interactions and can degrade accuracy. In our study, neither PIC training nor rule-based recomputation, alone or combined, consistently recovers full-prefill accuracy. Oracle-guided recomputation on PIC-trained models improves accuracy at the same budget, motivating better selection. We present CacheWeave, which adapts the full backbone to PIC, then freezes it and trains a model-native block selector on the adapted model's oracles. The selector uses compact cached chunk features and question hidden states without extracting backbone attention scores. It selects contiguous token blocks aligned with KV blocks to support efficient recomputation and limit copy-on-write amplification. Its runtime, CacheWeave-Serve, supports private and shared KV caches, keeps selection and recomputation on the GPU, and stages sliding-window KV for hybrid attention models. Across three models and four tasks, CacheWeave outperforms CacheBlend and ProphetKV by 7.2 and 3.5 percentage points on average at a 5% recomputation budget, with a mean relative accuracy loss of 1.6% to full prefill. With 32-token blocks, CacheWeave-Serve cuts single-request TTFT by up to 16.1x over full prefill and 1.7x over ProphetKV, and raises SLO goodput under load by up to 7.8x.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但严谨性仍需更强实证支撑
pros: 将PIC适配、学习式重算选择与服务系统协同设计，端到端思路完整
在低重算预算下同时给出精度与TTFT/吞吐改进，实用性和部署意义较强
cons: 摘要未充分交代统计显著性、长上下文与分布外场景稳定性，泛化与复现风险仍在

papers.title_zh: CacheWeave：学习重新计算以实现高效的位置无关的 KV 缓存
papers.summary_zh: Position-independent caching reuses chunk KV caches across positions and requests.然而，独立编码忽略了跨块交互，并且会降低准确性。在我们的研究中，无论是 PIC 训练还是基于规则的重新计算，无论是单独还是组合，都无法始终如一地恢复完全预填充的准确性。 Oracle-guided recomputation on PIC-trained models improves accuracy at the same budget, motivating better selection.我们提出了 CacheWeave，它使整个骨干网适应 PIC，然后冻结它并在适应模型的预言机上训练模型本机块选择器。 The selector uses compact cached chunk features and question hidden states without extracting backbone attention scores. It selects contiguous token blocks aligned with KV blocks to support efficient recomputation and limit copy-on-write amplification.其运行时 CacheWeave-Serve 支持私有和共享 KV 缓存，在 GPU 上保留选择和重新计算，并为混合注意力模型分级滑动窗口 KV。在三个模型和四个任务中，在 5% 的重新计算预算下，CacheWeave 的性能平均优于 CacheBlend 和 ProphetKV 7.2 和 3.5 个百分点，完全预填充的平均相对准确度损失为 1.6%。凭借 32 个令牌块，CacheWeave-Serve 将单请求 TTFT 比完全预填充减少了 16.1 倍，比 ProphetKV 减少了 1.7 倍，并将负载下的 SLO 吞吐量提高了 7.8 倍。

papers.title: EarlySelectKV: Anticipatory KV Selection via Cross-Layer Query Proxies
papers.summary: Query-conditioned sparse KV selection reduces long-context inference cost by attending to a subset of historical KV entries at each decoding step. Existing selectors must wait for the target-layer query before scoring candidates and generating indices, placing routing on the immediate pre-attention path. We introduce EarlySelectKV, a training-free transformation that uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute selected KV indices while retaining the real target-layer query for final attention. Tests with RocketKV, Quest, and Loki show no consistent pattern of quality degradation across the evaluated settings. In the primary RocketKV evaluation, ES-RocketKV differs by +0.018 points on LongBench, approximately -0.01 points on RULER, and +0.25 percentage points on representative NIAH/Passkey settings. In a TensorRT-LLM deployment with CPU-offloaded routing, ES-RocketKV improves end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% and reduces GPU-resident memory by 11.1% of the combined KV/K-summary pool. This makes routing timing an explicit optimization target alongside KV subset selection in sparse long-context decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pp. 5272-5291 (2026)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值明确，但学术说服力仍偏弱
pros: 将KV路由从目标层查询依赖中前移，聚焦了长期被忽视的关键路径时序优化
在TensorRT-LLM与CPU offload场景报告了可感知的端到端吞吐和显存收益，且质量基本持平
cons: 质量增益幅度很小且“无一致退化”表述偏弱，缺少更严格的统计显著性与最坏案例分析

papers.title_zh: EarlySelectKV：通过跨层查询代理进行预期 KV 选择
papers.summary_zh: 查询条件稀疏 KV 选择通过在每个解码步骤关注历史 KV 条目的子集来减少长上下文推理成本。现有选择器必须等待目标层查询，然后才能对候选者进行评分并生成索引，将路由置于直接预注意路径上。我们引入了 EarlySelectKV，这是一种免训练的转换，它使用来自早期隐藏状态的代理查询来预先计算选定的 KV 索引，同时保留真正的目标层查询以进行最终关注。 RocketKV、Quest 和 Loki 的测试显示，在评估的设置中没有一致的质量下降模式。在主要的 RocketKV 评估中，ES-RocketKV 在 LongBench 上相差 +0.018 个百分点，在 RULER 上相差约 -0.01 个百分点，在代表性 NIAH/Passkey 设置上相差 +0.25 个百分点。在具有 CPU 卸载路由的 TensorRT-LLM 部署中，ES-RocketKV 将端到端输出吞吐量提高了 12.4%，并将组合 KV/K-summary 池的 GPU 驻留内存减少了 11.1%。这使得路由时序成为稀疏长上下文解码中 KV 子集选择的显式优化目标。代码可在 https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV 获取。

papers.title: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary: We present Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for Physical AI. It models and generates causal physical evolution in the real world, and unifies heterogeneous conditioning inputs for view-consistent generation. The architecture integrates View-Temporal Attention (VTA) to capture cross-view spatial dependencies and temporal dynamics, together with Multi-view Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) to encode positional relationships across views and time. WorldRec 2.0 reconstructs static and dynamic 3D Gaussians from multi-view, multi-temporal observations in a single forward pass and uses their renderings as explicit scene context to preserve geometry and appearance during long-horizon generation. Conditioning inputs are fused through VAE latent concatenation in a shared representation space. We incorporate Gated Linear Attention (GLA) into the temporal layers of VTA for efficient streaming inference, reducing computation and KV-cache memory during multi-view rollouts. A physical-interaction data pipeline covers diverse interactions and long-tailed events. From Pre-train onward, these data are combined with large-scale videos and heterogeneous visual modalities to learn visual, geometric, and dynamic priors. During Mid-train, training across diverse view configurations further improves the model's ability to capture how actions and object states shape subsequent scene evolution. After distillation-based Post-train, we apply the model to closed-loop simulation, closed-loop training, and World Action Model (WAM) applications. These applications generate physically consistent future states and support world-state prediction, policy learning, and action generation for Physical AI.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且系统完整，但证据不足支撑高分主张。
pros: 提出统一流式因果世界模型，覆盖多视角时空建模与长时生成
将GLA用于时序层并强调KV缓存与算力优化，具备serving价值
cons: 摘要缺少关键定量结果、对比基线与消融，难判断真实增益

papers.title_zh: 小米汽车世界模型2.0：现实世界驾驶和具身智能的因果世界模型
papers.summary_zh: We present Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for Physical AI.它建模并生成现实世界中的因果物理演化，并统一异构条件输入以实现视图一致的生成。该架构集成了视图时间注意力（VTA）来捕获跨视图空间依赖性和时间动态，以及多视图旋转位置编码（RoPE）来编码跨视图和时间的位置关系。 WorldRec 2.0 在一次前向传递中根据多视图、多时间观测重建静态和动态 3D 高斯，并使用它们的渲染作为显式场景上下文，以在长视野生成过程中保留几何结构和外观。 Conditioning inputs are fused through VAE latent concatenation in a shared representation space.我们将门控线性注意 (GLA) 合并到 VTA 的时间层中，以实现高效的流式推理，减少多视图推出期间的计算和 KV 缓存。 A physical-interaction data pipeline covers diverse interactions and long-tailed events.从预训练开始，这些数据与大规模视频和异构视觉模式相结合，以学习视觉、几何和动态先验。在中间训练期间，跨不同视图配置的训练进一步提高了模型捕获动作和对象状态如何塑造后续场景演化的能力。经过基于蒸馏的 Post-train 之后，我们将模型应用于闭环仿真、闭环训练和世界动作模型（WAM）应用。这些应用程序生成物理上一致的未来状态，并支持物理人工智能的世界状态预测、策略学习和行动生成。

papers.title: dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache
papers.summary: A causal video generator produces two key--value (KV) states for every segment: the KV it uses while denoising that segment, and the KV it writes into the cache for later segments to read. In a pretrained generator the two already differ substantially, later segments attend to them differently, and replacing the written KV with the generation KV degrades the continuation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV) to learn a dedicated memory representation from its future use: a writer-specific low-rank residual on the shared backbone separates memory writing from generation and is trained through the future reads of what it writes. Learning a write from its future use needs gradients through the cache, which the mutable cache in common use cannot provide. dKV Forcing replaces the training-time cache by persistent differentiable pages with local rematerialization and, in one temporal traversal, computes exactly the gradient that a two-pass reconstruction of the same objective computes. One traversal computes the full memory gradient at $7\%$ generator-update overhead over detached-write training, with $28\%$ less resident memory and $20.8\%$ shorter training cycles than the two-pass reconstruction. Over Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), the same objective trained with the same traversal, writer adaptation raises VBench-Long aesthetic quality by $6.6$ points at 60\,s and $8.5$ points at 240\,s with the highest subject and background consistency, and rollout dropout of the residual keeps most of this gain while restoring the motion of training without write gradients.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中长时视频生成痛点，方法有新意但证据仍待补强。
pros: 提出将生成与记忆写入显式解耦，并通过可微KV缓存学习写入表示，思路新颖且契合机制。
训练系统层设计（可微页面+局部重计算+单次遍历）兼顾梯度正确性与效率，工程价值较高。

papers.title_zh: dKV 强制：通过可微分的 KV 缓存分离生成和内存表示
papers.summary_zh: 因果视频生成器为每个片段生成两个键值 (KV) 状态：在对该片段进行去噪时使用的 KV，以及写入缓存以供后续片段读取的 KV。在预训练的生成器中，两者已经存在很大差异，后面的片段以不同的方式处理它们，并且用生成的 KV 替换写入的 KV 会降低延续性。我们提出 dKV 强制（dKV 表示可微分 KV）来从其未来的使用中学习专用的内存表示：共享主干上特定于写入者的低秩残差将内存写入与生成分开，并通过未来读取其写入内容进行训练。从未来的使用中学习写入需要通过缓存进行梯度，这是常用的可变缓存无法提供的。 dKV 强制通过具有局部重物化的持久可微页面取代训练时缓存，并且在一次时间遍历中精确计算同一目标的两遍重建所计算的梯度。与分离写入训练相比，一次遍历以 $7\%$ 生成器更新开销计算完整内存梯度，与两遍重建相比，驻留内存少 $28\%$，训练周期短 $20.8\%$。通过自梯度强制 (SGF)，使用相同的遍历训练相同的目标，写入器适应将 VBench-Long 美学质量在 60 秒时提高了 6.6 美元点，在 240 秒时提高了 8.5 美元点，具有最高的主题和背景一致性，并且残差的 rollout dropout 保留了大部分增益，同时在不写入梯度的情况下恢复训练的运动。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters, Verifying What Pays: Load-Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法完整且实用价值高。
pros: 提出负载自适应验证分配，将系统负载显式纳入推理优化决策

cons: 摘要未交代训练与在线选择的额外工程复杂度及最坏情形收益下界，部署成本风险仍需量化

papers.title_zh: 看到什么重要，验证什么值得：视觉语言模型的负载自适应推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可在不改变输出分布的情况下加速视觉语言模型 (VLM) 推理，但有两个因素限制了其增益。现有的起草者要么缺乏视觉基础标记所需的图像证据，要么为每个视觉标记进行条件付费，尽管短草稿块通常仅依赖于几个图像区域。此外，验证额外候选者的价值随 GPU 负载的不同而变化，因此没有固定的验证结构在服务条件下是有效的。我们提出了 Uni-LaSpec，这是一个解决这两个因素的块并行推测解码框架。为了提高草案质量，Uni-LaSpec 重用了验证者自己的注意力：从前面的验证中保留的查询对缓存的 int8 量化视觉键进行排名，并且跨层投票选择起草者通过门控交叉注意力融合的一些视觉标记。接受感知训练进一步根据每个选秀位置对接受前缀的贡献来加权。为了分配验证，边际成本标准选择每个请求和每轮的结构：草稿树在轻负载下利用空闲验证器容量，而动态头在重负载下截断线性草稿。在来自三个模型系列的 6 个 VLM 以及 17 个文本和多模式基准中，选择 8 个视觉标记保留了以亚毫秒选择成本从完整图像获得的至少 98.6% 的接受度。通过在并发数为 1 时进行贪婪解码，Uni-LaSpec 可实现比自回归解码高达 5.11 倍的文本吞吐量和 3.24 倍的多模式吞吐量。在六个负载级别和三种 GPU 类型中，它在每个设置中都优于自回归解码，并且在 144 个设置中的 123 个设置中匹配或超过了最佳固定验证策略；在突发到达情况下，相对于线性验证，平均端到端延迟降低了 47.6%。

papers.title: Serving Agentic Robot Fleets: Workload Characterization, KV-Cache Thrashing, and Admission Control
papers.summary: Agentic robots combine a vision-language brain, a tool-using harness, and a vision-language-action (VLA) policy. Serving a fleet of these agents introduces two coupled resource constraints: the brain repeatedly revisits long, growing key-value (KV) cache states, while the VLA executes action chunks under tight control deadlines. We characterize 80 LIBERO-PRO episodes generated by GPT-6-Astra, RPent, and pi0.5 (1,862 brain turns and 1,582 VLA inference chunks), profile both layers on H800 graphics processing units (GPUs), and replay the resulting agent programs on a vLLM serving engine. Brain contexts reach 215k tokens; the median Astra request takes 7.78 s, while the intervening environment-step gap is only 1.0 s. Under a 0.25 s action-chunk deadline, one VLA GPU meets the 1% starvation target for one robot; under a 1.0 s deadline, its measured capacity reaches at least 32. In sustained brain replay, increasing concurrency from 20 to 32 robots reduces throughput from about 2.4 to 0.6 requests/s as repetitive prefill displaces generation. A static active-episode cap restores 2.24-2.25 requests/s and raises completed trace-program throughput from 1.30 to 5.00-5.55 episodes/min. Our measurements expose the workload-dependent shift between action deadlines and brain KV residency, and establish practical principles for capacity planning and admission in sustained agentic robot fleets.

papers.title_zh: 服务代理机器人队列：工作负载特征、KV 缓存抖动和准入控制
papers.summary_zh: 代理机器人结合了视觉语言大脑、工具使用线束和视觉语言动作（VLA）策略。为这些代理群提供服务会引入两个耦合的资源限制：大脑反复重新访问长期且不断增长的键值 (KV) 缓存状态，而 VLA 在严格的控制期限内执行操作块。我们描述了由 GPT-6-Astra、RPent 和 pi0.5 生成的 80 个 LIBERO-PRO 片段（1,862 个大脑转动和 1,582 个 VLA 推理块）的特征，在 H800 图形处理单元 (GPU) 上分析两个层，并在 vLLM 服务引擎上重播生成的代理程序。大脑上下文达到 215k 个令牌； Astra 请求的中位数需要 7.78 秒，而干预环境步长差距仅为 1.0 秒。在 0.25 秒的动作块截止时间下，一个 VLA GPU 可以满足一个机器人 1% 的饥饿目标；在 1.0 秒的截止时间下，其测得的容量至少达到 32。在持续的大脑重放中，并发性从 20 个机器人增加到 32 个机器人，由于重复的预填充取代了生成，吞吐量从大约 2.4 请求/秒降低到 0.6 个请求/秒。静态活动剧集上限可恢复 2.24-2.25 个请求/秒，并将完成的跟踪节目吞吐量从 1.30 提高到 5.00-5.55 个剧集/分钟。我们的测量揭示了行动截止日期和大脑 KV 驻留之间依赖于工作负载的转变，并为持续代理机器人车队的容量规划和准入建立了实用原则。

papers.title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

papers.title_zh: Step-dLLM：自适应步进感知稀疏注意力，实现高效扩散 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代去噪并行生成标记，但它们的双向注意力阻止了自回归模型使用的 KV 缓存，并在每一步重新计算完整的注意力图，从而产生二次的每步成本。现有的 dLLM 稀疏注意力方法在初始全注意力预热后构建稀疏掩码，并将其重用于剩余步骤，同时在各个头之间均匀分配稀疏预算。我们认为，这两种选择都忽略了 dLLM 中注意力的关键结构特性：从经验来看，注意力模式仅在各个步骤之间局部一致，并在某些转变时突然发生变化，并且不同的头将其注意力集中到非常不同的程度。为此，我们设计了Step-dLLM，它沿着去噪轨迹在锚步处定期刷新块稀疏掩模，并在每个局部一致的间隔内重用它，同时采用头部自适应全局预算，更积极地压缩集中注意力的头部。在用于块稀疏注意力的融合 IO 感知 Triton 内核的支持下，Step-dLLM 无需重新训练即可应用于预训练的 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream-7B-Instruct，在 8K 环境下，LLaDA-1.5 上的密集 FlashAttention 实现了 2.78 倍的端到端加速，具有 256 个去噪步骤和 90% 的稀疏性，同时比之前的方法提高了准确性与延迟权衡稀疏注意力方法。

papers.title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
papers.summary: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义扎实，实证充分，但外部效度待验证。

覆盖20模型与多语言多模态输入，指标分解与消融设计较系统

papers.title_zh: 法学硕士小说中的人物名称集中度：测量位移和减少重复
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）小说中的角色名称集中在少数反复出现的名称上，例如“Elara”和“Elias”，这是人工智能垃圾的可测量面孔。现有的修复要么需要 logit 访问或重新训练，要么根据请求进行操作，并且无法控制语料库的集中度。即时策略会在多大程度上降低注意力，以及自然性的代价有多大，尚未得到系统测量。我们提出了跨八种策略的名称集中控制的实证研究，并引入了推测命名，这是一种无需微调的方法，它采用了从标记到名称的推测解码的草稿-验证-拒绝范式。该方法通过言语采样请求候选名称集，根据 SlopTracker 对它们进行评分，SlopTracker 将每个模型的指纹与运行时计数器相结合，并通过温度控制规则或其严格变体 (HARD) 进行选择。我们使用 20 个法学硕士从文本和视觉刺激（88,919 个命名字符）生成四种语言的 44,782 个故事，并使用分解为已知和紧急组件的无列表碰撞度量（斜率比，SR）来测量浓度。基于名单的策略并不能消除混乱：静态的禁令名单将注意力集中在新出现的名字上，并将经过验证的真实姓名的份额减少了一半以上。推测性命名消除了这一点：仅采样支架就将 SR 平均降低了 89%，动态跟踪器将总体降低到 95%，平均碰撞概率从 7.3% 下降到 0.4%，已知名称碰撞保持为零，而自然度保持接近基线（通过语言证明 42-69%），故事内碰撞从 4.3% 下降到 0.2%。策略排名在不同语言、模型系列和名字计数约定中保持稳定。因此，名称集中度可以在语料库级别进行控制，无需 Logit 访问或再培训；除了命名之外更广泛的创意多样性仍然开放。

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.summary: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8$\times$ faster and uses 2.4$\times$ less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，若实验证据完备可冲顶会。
pros: 聚焦相对位置注意力长期存在的内存与带宽瓶颈，问题重要且现实
提出与FlashAttention兼容的“精确”算法并覆盖前后向，速度与显存收益幅度大
cons: 摘要虽宣称统一与精确，但缺少对数值稳定性、泛化边界和跨硬件复现实证的细节

papers.title_zh: 通过结构感知内核快速准确的相对位置注意力
papers.summary_zh: 相对位置注意力机制为跨各种变压器架构的 RoPE 提供了令人信服的替代方案，在音频等领域提供卓越的性能。这些机制通常通过添加内容位置或偏见位置术语来修改注意力分数。与 RoPE 不同，RoPE 直接在查询和键上通过每个令牌旋转来编码位置，相对位置项通常需要成对的偏移相关计算或查找，这使得它们与融合注意力内核的集成变得复杂，并随着序列规模的扩展引入严重的内存、带宽和计算开销。为了解决这个瓶颈，我们提出了一种精确注意算法，它将附加相对位置项合并到 FlashAttention 式平铺计算中。我们的方法（1）使用偏移感知平铺来避免冗余索引和内存访问，（2）仅计算必要的键/查询关系产品，并在前向和后向传递中跨令牌对重用它们，（3）使用基于偏移的梯度分片和聚合，消除原子争用。我们在不同的相对位置注意力机制中提供统一、高效的 Triton 实现，并根据简单和专门的实现对其进行评估。对于 8K 令牌序列，我们的方法将前向（后向）传递速度加快 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$)，并将峰值内存减少至 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$)，超过每种机制的最强基线，从而实现长上下文端到端转录，速度提高 1.8$\times$，并使用内存减少 2.4$\time$。因此，我们的方法为缩放相对位置注意力变换器提供了一种直接的、硬件高效的解决方案。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
papers.summary: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

quality.verdict: 方法务实且实证扎实，但总体收益受限

papers.title_zh: TRIAGE：与语义证据法官一起服务的两级法学硕士的可靠性和负载条件升级
papers.summary_zh: 两层 LLM 服务将选定的请求从小模型升级到大模型，但基于提示的路由器无法查看检索到的证据是否支持答案，并且它们将升级的 GPU 成本视为恒定。我们研究了 TRIAGE，它以新一代可靠性状态和负载相关的 GPU 价格为升级条件，并报告了在 VLLM 下服务于 Qwen2.5-7B 和 32B (AWQ) 的一台 A40 上保持和不保持的情况。升级成本从 1 个请求/秒上升到 10 个请求/秒，但没有表现出对 KV 缓存余量的单调依赖性，并且预先注册的可靠性状态检测到损坏证据 (AUROC>=0.70) 的声明被伪造为 0.571，尽管任何仅提示路由器的构建得分恰好为 0.500。事后，语义证据法官将检测率提高到 0.846（从未提供过的项目为 0.926），并在 RGB 和三个 RouterBench 模型对上预测错误的小模型答案为 AUROC 0.90-0.96；由此产生的级联保持在 GPT-4 的约 3 pp 范围内，GPT-3.5->GPT-4 的 API 成本降低了 79.5%，但低于开放模型对的随机路由，价格比为 2-3 倍。从头到尾，7B->32B 对仅显示 +2.88 pp 的保留差距，因此分配器正确地拒绝升级，并且标题是一个小的预启动门未能暴露的空值。

papers.title: Capacity Planning for Resource-Constrained Clinical LLM Serving
papers.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) under a fixed accelerator budget requires jointly deciding how computational capacity is allocated across model sizes and how incoming requests are routed across that capacity. Although prior work has extensively studied LLM routing and serving efficiency, the relative importance of fleet composition and routing under resource constraints remains less understood. We investigate this question using a controlled four-GPU serving environment with heterogeneous clinical NLP workloads spanning short factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization. We systematically vary fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load while holding the workload trace and hardware budget fixed. Across 24 configurations, descriptive main-effect shares attribute more variation to fleet composition than to the evaluated routing policies in time to first token, latency, and long-context coverage. All-small fleets provide the best responsiveness and throughput but substantially lower long-context coverage, whereas larger-model capacity improves coverage at the cost of serving efficiency. Heterogeneous fleets provide intermediate operating points but can introduce strong-model bottlenecks when large-model capacity is scarce. In a focused evaluation of this bottleneck, capacity-aware routing reduces mean latency and increases throughput while incurring a small reduction in long-context coverage. Within this measured regime, the results support prioritizing capacity allocation, with routing managing demand within the provisioned capacity.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 9th Special Session on Healthcare Data at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)

cons: 实验规模仅四GPU且为特定工作负载，统计方法偏描述性，缺少更强因果与跨平台泛化证据

papers.title_zh: 资源有限的临床法学硕士服务的能力规划
papers.summary_zh: 在固定加速器预算下部署大型语言模型 (LLM) 需要共同决定如何跨模型大小分配计算能力以及如何跨该能力路由传入请求。尽管之前的工作已经广泛研究了 LLM 航线和服务效率，但资源限制下车队组成和航线的相对重要性仍然知之甚少。我们使用受控的四 GPU 服务环境来研究这个问题，该环境具有异构临床 NLP 工作负载，涵盖短事实验证、生物医学语义匹配和长上下文临床总结。我们系统地改变机群组成、路由策略和提供的负载，同时保持工作负载跟踪和硬件预算固定。在 24 种配置中，描述性主效应份额将更多的变化归因于车队组成，而不是评估的路由策略在首次令牌时间、延迟和长上下文覆盖方面的变化。全小型机队可提供最佳的响应能力和吞吐量，但长上下文覆盖范围却大大降低，而较大的模型容量则以服务效率为代价来提高覆盖范围。异构机群提供中间操作点，但在大型模型容量稀缺时可能会引入强模型瓶颈。在对此瓶颈的集中评估中，容量感知路由减少了平均延迟并增加了吞吐量，同时导致长上下文覆盖范围小幅减少。在此测量范围内，结果支持对容量分配进行优先级排序，并在所配置的容量内路由管理需求。

papers.title: Multi-Turn Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
papers.summary: Semantic caching lowers the cost of serving large language models (LLMs) by reusing stored responses for similar requests. In multi-turn conversations, whether a cached response is acceptable depends on both conversations' histories, which embedding similarity of requests and histories predicts poorly (AUC 0.62--0.74 on five workloads). We therefore learn the \emph{reuse risk}, the probability that a cached response is unacceptable, from judge feedback, and choose a budgeted set of conversation states to cache by weighing the generation cost a reuse avoids against a price for unacceptable reuse. We propose CUCB-SC-MT, which learns a cache from logged conversations with a suboptimality guarantee, and CLCB-LS-MT, which learns online and has $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ regret over $N$ requests when conversation states recur. On math-tutoring (SocraTeach) and movie-ticketing (Taskmaster-3) conversations, both achieve lower loss than prior semantic caching approaches: ContextCache, multi-turn variants of ElastiCache and vCache, and single-turn semantic caching at every cache budget. With 1,000 cache entries, CLCB-LS-MT avoids 35--41\% of the generation cost through acceptable reuses, against at most 22--25\% for the baselines, and lowers estimated serving latency by 19--35\%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法完整且结果有说服力。
pros: 将多轮语义缓存建模为可学习复用风险，较现有相似度范式有实质推进
同时给出离线与在线算法及理论保证，并在多预算下显著优于强基线
cons: 实验场景与任务覆盖仍偏窄，且延迟收益多为估算，真实线上泛化与稳定性仍需验证

papers.title_zh: 用于低成本 LLM 服务的多轮语义缓存
papers.summary_zh: 语义缓存通过重用存储的类似请求响应来降低服务大型语言模型 (LLM) 的成本。在多轮对话中，缓存的响应是否可接受取决于两个对话的历史记录，嵌入请求和历史记录的相似性预测效果很差（五个工作负载上的 AUC 0.62--0.74）。因此，我们从判断反馈中了解\emph{重用风险}，即缓存的响应不可接受的概率，并通过权衡重用避免的生成成本与不可接受的重用的价格来选择一组预算的对话状态进行缓存。我们提出了 CUCB-SC-MT，它从记录的对话中学习缓存，并保证次优；以及 CLCB-LS-MT，它在线学习，并且当对话状态重复出现时，对 $N$ 请求有 $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ 遗憾。在数学辅导 (SocraTeach) 和电影票务 (Taskmaster-3) 对话中，两者都比以前的语义缓存方法实现了更低的损失：ContextCache、ElastiCache 和 vCache 的多轮变体，以及每个缓存预算的单轮语义缓存。凭借 1,000 个缓存条目，CLCB-LS-MT 通过可接受的重用可避免 35--41\% 的生成成本，而基线最多为 22--25\%，并将估计服务延迟降低 19--35\%。

papers.title: Jet-QSparse: Accelerating Agentic LLM Inference with 4-Bit Sparse Attention
papers.summary: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但学术新颖性与证据强度中等。
pros: 面向长上下文与Agentic场景，性能收益与容量提升指标具体且有实用意义。
分层精度设计（FP4/FP16/FP32）与块级稀疏策略结合，兼顾吞吐与精度保持。
cons: 方法高度依赖Blackwell与特定低精度路径，跨硬件泛化、统计显著性与长期稳健性证据仍不足。

papers.title_zh: Jet-QSparse：利用 4 位稀疏注意力加速代理 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 长视野推理和代理工作负载对 KV 缓存容量和解码注意力吞吐量造成压力。我们提出了 Jet-QSparse，这是一种免训练方法，它将紧凑的 NVFP4 缓存存储与 Blackwell 张量核心上的本机 FP4 查询键计算相结合。密集扫描对完整的密钥历史记录进行评分，并选择 128 个令牌块进行稀疏 FP16 值聚合和 FP32 累积，从而在输出形成步骤中保持更高的精度，同时启用连续的切片加载。校准键居中，每个序列最多两个 BF16 页和层地址量化误差； FP8 预填充使用临时区域，而持久缓存则直接从 BF16 激活中打包。在四个混合 LLM 中，每个 KV 头 128 个块的预算显示在评估的数学推理、编码和代理基准上没有检测到准确性损失，尽管一些较小的预算会产生损失。凭借 64 个块，Qwen3.8-27B 在 1 GB300 上以 128K 上下文和批量大小 16 的方式实现了比密集 BF16 1.94\times$ 的端到端解码加速，并且测量的 Qwen KV 池提供 2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16 的代币容量。

papers.title: AI Data Analysis: A New Approach - Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis
papers.summary: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. This paper proposes a combination mechanism, named Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, that fills a still-open gap - the multi-engine joint context: the data context is embedded into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves only as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer (not computation) and connects four engines through the 1M context window - Python and R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, Cypher over graph databases - yielding two multiplications, "semantics and precise computation" and "relational and graph", under enterprise-grade governance. The novelty is a four-dimensional coordinate system: horizontal (engine kinds), vertical (state flow - the watershed), spatial (business generalization), temporal (iterative convergence); a deterministic grounding method (one-shot injection of schema.json + notes.md, M+S) carries the spatial and temporal dimensions. Empirically, all four dimensions are substantiated: horizontally, four engines are quantified - SQL, Cypher (96.5% on CypherBench movie), ML in Python and R (TabReD weather); vertically, state flows across engines and grounding is reused across kernels; spatially, SQL generalizes across three business databases - AdventureWorks 91.3%, financial 95.3%, formula_1 94.6% (average), about 20-23 points above single-shot SOTA 74.45%; temporally, accuracy converges monotonically as notes accumulate. The core invariant - the separation of semantics from computation plus a cross-data-domain persistent context - does not expire as LLMs and agents evolve or engine forms change.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程整合价值较高，但学术证据不足。
pros: 提出语义与计算解耦并联接多引擎的统一框架，面向企业场景有现实意义
覆盖SQL/Cypher/Python/R并报告跨库泛化与迭代收敛，实验范围较广
cons: 核心贡献更像系统集成与提示工程，理论新颖性边界不清
评测基线与设置信息不足（数据划分、统计显著性、消融、成本/时延），难支撑强结论

papers.title_zh: AI数据分析：一种新方法——多引擎联合状态数据分析
papers.summary_zh: 如今的人工智能数据分析是三个支离破碎的世界：法学硕士理解语义但无法计算；法学硕士理解语义但无法计算； BI精确聚合但无状态；机器学习在有状态内核上处理大规模数据，但缺乏语义。本文提出了一种名为多引擎联合状态数据分析的组合机制，填补了一个仍然存在的空白——多引擎联合上下文：数据上下文嵌入到LLM会话分析中，其中LLM仅充当语义、推理和编排层（而不是计算），并通过1M上下文窗口连接四个引擎——Python和R ML内核、关系数据库上的SQL、图数据库上的Cypher——产生两个乘法，“语义和精确计算”和企业级治理下的“关系与图”。新颖的是四维坐标系：水平（引擎种类）、垂直（状态流-分水岭）、空间（业务泛化）、时间（迭代收敛）；确定性的基础方法（schema.json +notes.md、M+S 的一次性注入）承载空间和时间维度。从经验上看，所有四个维度都得到了证实：横向，量化了四个引擎——SQL、Cypher（CypherBench 电影中的 96.5%）、Python 中的 ML 和 R（TabReD 天气）；垂直方向，状态在引擎之间流动，并且接地在内核之间重用；在空间上，SQL 泛化于三个业务数据库 - AdventureWorks 91.3%、财务 95.3%、formula_1 94.6%（平均），比单次 SOTA 74.45% 高出约 20-23 个点；随着音符的积累，准确性在时间上单调收敛。核心不变性——语义与计算的分离加上跨数据域持久上下文——不会随着法学硕士和代理的发展或引擎形式的变化而过期。

papers.title: Inference First, Training Underneath: Layer-Granular LoRA Co-Serving with LayerLoom
papers.summary: Serving and fine-tuning a large language model on the same GPUs can turn the idle capacity between inference bursts into training progress, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) makes this co-location cheap because both workloads read a single frozen copy of the base weights. The difficulty lies in the fine-tuning backward pass, which has no counterpart in inference. Current co-serving systems schedule backward work per serving iteration: each iteration carries a fixed backward budget, and requests that arrive in the meantime wait for it to finish, so fine-tuning dictates inference latency whenever load spikes. We observe that the backward pass of a LoRA microbatch decomposes into per-layer tasks over the same weights that the inference forward pass visits, which allows backward work to be scheduled at layer rather than iteration granularity. Building on this observation, LayerLoom attaches same-layer backward tasks to the inference forward pass and, at each layer, runs only as many of them as the latency slack of in-flight requests permits. To keep a ready task at every layer, LayerLoom maintains a wavefront of fine-tuning microbatches staggered across layers, and it bounds the wavefront's activation memory by offloading microbatch state to host memory and prefetching it ahead of the layer where the scheduler plans to use it. A fused kernel serves the paired forward and backward GEMMs from a single read of each base weight. Because all backward work of an iteration finishes within its forward pass, new requests join the next iteration as in continuous batching. On an RTX 4090 GPU running Llama-3.1-8B under a bursty production trace, LayerLoom raises joint SLO attainment by 13.5-21.8 points over prior works with fine-tuning throughput that is comparable or up to 12% higher, and it reaches the same training losses.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 将LoRA反向按层细粒度调度，精准利用推理时延余量
系统设计完整（波前调度、内存卸载、融合核）且端到端收益明确
cons: 实验主要在单卡RTX 4090与特定模型/轨迹，跨硬件与大规模多租户泛化证据不足

papers.title_zh: 推理优先，底层训练：层粒度 LoRA 与 LayerLoom 协同服务
papers.summary_zh: 在相同 GPU 上服务和微调大型语言模型可以将推理爆发之间的空闲容量转化为训练进度，而低秩适应 (LoRA) 使这种共置成本低廉，因为两个工作负载都读取基本权重的单个冻结副本。困难在于微调反向传递，它在推理中没有对应的部分。当前的协同服务系统在每个服务迭代中安排向后工作：每次迭代都带有固定的向后预算，同时到达的请求会等待其完成，因此只要负载峰值，微调就会决定推理延迟。我们观察到 LoRA 微批次的后向传递分解为每层任务，其权重与推理前向传递访问的权重相同，这允许在层而不是迭代粒度上安排后向工作。在此观察的基础上，LayerLoom 将同层后向任务附加到推理前向传递中，并且在每一层仅在运行中请求的延迟裕度允许的情况下运行尽可能多的任务。为了在每一层保持就绪任务，LayerLoom 维护了跨层交错的微调微批次的波前，并且通过将微批次状态卸载到主机内存并在调度程序计划使用它的层之前预取它来限制波前的激活内存。融合内核通过读取每个基本权重来为配对的前向和后向 GEMM 提供服务。由于迭代的所有后向工作都在其前向传递中完成，因此新请求会像连续批处理一样加入下一次迭代。在突发生产跟踪下运行 Llama-3.1-8B 的 RTX 4090 GPU 上，LayerLoom 将联合 SLO 成绩比之前的作品提高了 13.5-21.8 点，微调吞吐量相当或高出 12%，并且达到了相同的训练损失。

papers.title: TopoQuant: Topological Framework to Characterize Behavioral Shifts in Quantized Large Language Models
papers.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the com putational cost of large language models (LLMs), but it can introduce internal structural and behavioral changes that are not captured by traditional metrics such as accuracy and per plexity. We present TopoQuant, a topological framework that uses topological data analysis (TDA) to quantify structural drift in self-attention weights and relate it to behavioral changes in quantized LLMs. Across four LLM families and multiple quantization levels, we show that topological drift remains stable at moderate compression levels but increases sharply below 4 bit precision, closely tracking declines in attention agreement. Our results reveal a strong relationship between topological drift and attention agreement, indicating that structural changes in model parameters closely reflect behavioral degradation under quantization. We further demonstrate that topological features can accurately predict attention consistency using lightweight machine learning models, achieving R2 scores of up to 0.85. Predicting attention agreement enables efficient assessment of be havioral consistency in quantized LLMs, allowing quantization induced degradation to be detected without running expensive downstream tasks. The results indicate that topological drift pro vides an efficient early-warning signal for quantization-induced degradation and can help identify safe compression limits without extensive downstream evaluation.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路有新意但证据链仍偏相关性
pros: 将TDA引入量化LLM退化分析，视角较新
提出可提前预警的轻量指标，具工程实用潜力
cons: 核心结论主要是相关性，缺少因果与机制验证
评价指标偏间接，未充分证明可替代下游任务评测

papers.title_zh: TopoQuant：表征量化大型语言模型中行为变化的拓扑框架
papers.summary_zh: 训练后量化 (PTQ) 降低了大型语言模型 (LLM) 的计算成本，但它可能会引入传统指标（例如准确性和复杂性）无法捕获的内部结构和行为变化。我们提出了 TopoQuant，一个拓扑框架，它使用拓扑数据分析（TDA）来量化自注意力权重的结构漂移，并将其与量化法学硕士的行为变化联系起来。在四个 LLM 系列和多个量化级别中，我们发现拓扑漂移在中等压缩级别下保持稳定，但在 4 位精度以下急剧增加，密切跟踪注意力一致性的下降。我们的结果揭示了拓扑漂移和注意力一致性之间的密切关系，表明模型参数的结构变化密切反映了量化下的行为退化。我们进一步证明，拓扑特征可以使用轻量级机器学习模型准确预测注意力一致性，实现高达 0.85 的 R2 分数。预测注意力一致性可以有效评估量化 LLM 中的行为一致性，从而无需运行昂贵的下游任务即可检测量化引起的退化。结果表明，拓扑漂移为量化引起的退化提供了有效的预警信号，并且可以帮助识别安全压缩限制，而无需进行广泛的下游评估。

papers.title: TVP: TV is Almost All You Need for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference with a drafter whose proposed tokens are verified by the target model in parallel. Under lossless speculative sampling, a draft token is accepted with probability one minus the total variation (TV) distance between the target and draft distributions, yet drafters are often trained with cross-entropy (CE) or KL. We first show that under matched and well-tuned training, TV matches or surpasses several published draft-training objectives when fine-tuning, and a fixed TV and KL mixture does the same when training from scratch. We identify two remaining problems, TV's vanishing gradients on undercovered tokens and the prefix products that starve later positions in acceptance-length objectives. To address both, we derive TVP, a loss family based on expected acceptance length, whose power parameter interpolates between coverage and acceptance oriented objectives. Annealing the power from zero to one gives the highest or tied-highest acceptance length across three drafter architectures and three target models, including longer drafts and block verification. TVP improves acceptance length over CE by 9.8% when fine-tuning, and over the public DFlash2 training recipes by 6.2 to 12.9%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法有新意但证据尚不充分
pros: 将TV与接受率理论直接对齐，目标设计动机扎实
提出可退火的TVP损失家族，跨模型与验证设置显示稳定增益
cons: 摘要未交代统计显著性、训练/推理开销与鲁棒性边界，实证说服力仍有限

papers.title_zh: TVP：电视几乎是推理解码所需要的一切
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可加速 LLM 推理，起草者提出的标记由目标模型并行验证。在无损推测采样下，草案标记被接受的概率为一减去目标分布和草案分布之间的总变异（TV）距离，但起草者通常接受交叉熵（CE）或KL的训练。我们首先表明，在匹配和精心调整的训练下，电视在微调时匹配或超过了几个已发布的草稿训练目标，而固定电视和 KL 混合在从头开始训练时也有同样的效果。我们确定了两个剩余的问题，电视在未发现的代币上梯度消失以及前缀产品在接受长度目标中导致后期位置匮乏。为了解决这两个问题，我们推导出 TVP，这是一个基于预期接受长度的损失族，其功率参数在覆盖范围和接受导向目标之间进行插值。将功率从零退火到一可在三种绘图器架构和三种目标模型中提供最高或最高的接受长度，包括更长的绘图和块验证。微调时，TVP 的接受长度比 CE 提高了 9.8%，比公共 DFlash2 训练方案提高了 6.2% 到 12.9%。

papers.title: BitLLM: Efficient Low-Bit, Conversion-Hiding LLM Decoding on Mobile GPUs
papers.summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has unlocked remarkable capabilities across various domains. However, deploying LLMs on mobile devices remains challenging because of their high computational and memory requirements. Low-bit quantization (e.g., 4-bit weights, 8-bit activations) can reduce model size while preserving accuracy, but its practical efficacy on mobile GPUs has been limited so far. In this paper, we identify that the performance gap stems primarily from frequent data type conversions between quantized and floating-point values, and dynamic and inefficient memory access patterns caused by the growing Key-Value (KV) cache during autoregressive decoding. We introduce BitLLM, a mobile inference engine that addresses type conversion overhead and suboptimal memory accesses in quantized LLMs. Our approach features an adaptive layout and packing strategy for the KV cache that ensures efficient memory access throughout LLM decoding. This is coupled with an integer-native execution pipeline that defers and overlaps type conversion outside the compute hot path, keeping the critical MatMul stages in the integer domain. Implemented on off-the-shelf mobile GPUs, BitLLM outperforms leading engines, i.e., LLAMA.CPP, MNN-LLM, LiteRT-LM, and MLC-LLM, achieving average speedups of 1.78$\times$, 1.73$\times$, 1.58$\times$, and 1.47$\times$, respectively, across various models and quantization levels. Under long-context generation, BitLLM reduces average energy consumption (per token) by up to 88.9%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但学术新意与证据仍偏中等。
pros: 精准定位移动端量化推理瓶颈，提出转化隐藏与整数主路径方案
在多引擎对比中给出稳定加速，并强调长上下文能效收益
cons: 核心方法更偏系统优化整合，算法层面新颖性有限
摘要未体现统计显著性、消融完整度与跨芯片泛化证据，严谨性待验证

papers.title_zh: BitLLM：移动 GPU 上的高效低位、转换隐藏 LLM 解码
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的快速扩展释放了跨各个领域的卓越功能。然而，由于计算和内存要求较高，在移动设备上部署法学硕士仍然具有挑战性。低位量化（例如 4 位权重、8 位激活）可以在保持精度的同时减小模型大小，但迄今为止其在移动 GPU 上的实际效果有限。在本文中，我们发现性能差距主要源于量化和浮点值之间频繁的数据类型转换，以及自回归解码期间不断增长的键值（KV）缓存导致的动态和低效的内存访问模式。我们引入了 BitLLM，这是一种移动推理引擎，可解决量化 LLM 中的类型转换开销和次优内存访问问题。我们的方法具有 KV 缓存的自适应布局和打包策略，可确保整个 LLM 解码过程中的高效内存访问。这与整数本机执行管道相结合，该管道在计算热路径之外推迟并重叠类型转换，从而将关键的 MatMul 阶段保持在整数域中。 BitLLM 在现成的移动 GPU 上实现，其性能优于领先引擎，即 LLAMA.CPP、MNN-LLM、LiteRT-LM 和 MLC-LLM，在各种模型和量化级别上分别实现了 1.78$\times$、1.73$\times$、1.58$\times$ 和 1.47$\times$ 的平均加速。在长上下文生成下，BitLLM 将平均能耗（每个代币）降低高达 88.9%。

papers.title: Weights That Stay: On-Chip Megakernels for Serial Heads in Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel speculative drafters use a lightweight serial head to recover token dependencies within a block generated in parallel. Each head step updates only a small state, yet projects that state through the same vocabulary-sized matrix. Step-wise execution repeatedly transfers this large, immutable projection, making the head a meaningful source of latency despite its low arithmetic cost. We present Weights That Stay, an execution design that keeps projection shards on chip for the entire serial draft walk. A persistent megakernel couples weight residency with GPU-side token selection and state advancement, reusing resident weights while exchanging only compact state between steps. The design supports full or partial residency and accommodates both Markov and recurrent heads on H100 and B200. Integrated into SGLang, Weights That Stay improves throughput for Markov drafting on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, with gains of up to 12.3%. At the head level, the DSpark walk is up to 11.6$\times$ faster than the fastest measured SGLang reference path. These results show that aligning weight residency with the full draft walk translates cross-step reuse into end-to-end serving gains.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程洞察扎实，但泛化与严谨性仍待加强
pros: 抓住串行 head 的带宽瓶颈，提出常驻权重 megakernel 设计，方向明确且有新意
给出端到端吞吐提升与内核级大幅加速，并覆盖 H100/B200 与不同 head 形式

papers.title_zh: 保留的权重：推测解码中串行头的片上巨型内核
papers.summary_zh: 并行推测起草者使用轻量级串行头来恢复并行生成的块内的令牌依赖性。每个头步骤仅更新一个小状态，但通过相同的词汇大小矩阵来投影该状态。逐步执行重复传输这个大的、不可变的投影，使得头部成为有意义的延迟源，尽管它的算术成本很低。我们推出了 Weights That Stay，这是一种执行设计，可以在整个串行选秀过程中将投影碎片保留在芯片上。持久性巨型内核将权重驻留与 GPU 端令牌选择和状态提升结合起来，重用驻留权重，同时在步骤之间仅交换紧凑状态。该设计支持全部或部分驻留，并适应 H100 和 B200 上的马尔可夫头和循环头。 Weights That Stay 集成到 SGLang 中，提高了 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上马尔可夫绘图的吞吐量，增益高达 12.3%。在头部层面，DSpark 行走比最快测量的 SGLang 参考路径快 11.6$\times$。这些结果表明，将体重驻留与完整的选秀步行相结合，可以将跨步重用转化为端到端的发球收益。

papers.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.summary: Key-value (KV) caches impose substantial memory pressure on large language model serving systems, requiring cache eviction when capacity is insufficient. Existing mechanisms typically evict KV from the ends of cached sequences to preserve prefix sharing across requests. However, agent workloads repeatedly reuse long histories across successive turns. Recomputing the KV cache for tokens near the end of a sequence is substantially more expensive than for earlier tokens because their attention computation involves longer histories. To address this problem, we propose preserving shared prefixes and evicting the KV cache from the beginning of the remaining history while retaining the cached suffix. We build Penelope around this strategy by co-designing the eviction policy, KV recomputation, and unified GPU-CPU cache management. Returning requests reuse the KV cache retained in GPU or CPU memory and recompute only missing segments while preserving reuse of the cached suffix. We implement Penelope in SGLang and evaluate it on three Qwen3 model sizes using real agent traces. Compared with SGLang, Penelope reduces mean time to first token by up to 60% and job completion time by up to 37% with a GPU-only cache, and by up to 76% and 60% with a two-tier GPU-CPU cache.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用但证据仍需补强。

papers.title_zh: 重新思考代理 LLM 服务的 KV 缓存驱逐
papers.summary_zh: 键值 (KV) 缓存给大型语言模型服务系统带来巨大的内存压力，当容量不足时需要清除缓存。现有的机制通常会从缓存序列的末尾逐出 KV，以保留跨请求的前缀共享。然而，代理工作负载在连续轮次中反复重用长历史记录。在序列末尾附近重新计算令牌的 KV 缓存比早期令牌的成本要高得多，因为它们的注意力计算涉及更长的历史记录。为了解决这个问题，我们建议保留共享前缀并从剩余历史记录的开头逐出 KV 缓存，同时保留缓存的后缀。我们围绕这一策略构建 Penelope，共同设计驱逐策略、KV 重新计算和统一的 GPU-CPU 缓存管理。返回的请求重用保留在 GPU 或 CPU 内存中的 KV 缓存，并仅重新计算丢失的段，同时保留缓存后缀的重用。我们在 SGLang 中实现 Penelope，并使用真实代理轨迹在三个 Qwen3 模型大小上对其进行评估。与 SGLang 相比，Penelope 在仅使用 GPU 缓存的情况下，将首次标记的平均时间缩短了 60%，将作业完成时间缩短了 37%；在使用两层 GPU-CPU 缓存的情况下，分别将任务完成时间分别缩短了 76% 和 60%。

papers.title: C3: Speech-Guided KV Retrieval for Long-Context SpeechLLM Inference
papers.summary: Speech language models encode audio at a much higher rate than text, causing the KV cache to dominate the memory, bandwidth, and decoding cost of long-form generation. KV retrieval can reduce per-step access by attending to only a query-dependent subset of the cache, but existing methods are designed primarily for text and do not account for the structure of audio attention. We first show that retrieval errors may compound autoregressively into generation drift. We then analyze full audio attention during long-form generation and identify three properties relevant to retrieval: unequal attention concentration across query heads, non-contiguous audio support, and temporal continuity across decoding steps. Guided by these observations, we propose $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete), which organizes audio KVs in a hierarchical key-space index, lets query heads sharing a KV head compete for a common retrieval budget, and adaptively reallocates retrieval resolution through paired split-merge updates. Across long-form speech recognition, translation, and summarization on four SpeechLLMs, $C^3$ achieves the strongest overall performance among retrieval methods under comparable final-KV access budgets, with particularly large gains in the tight-budget regime, while improving long-context decoding efficiency and accelerator-memory scaling.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法新颖且实用，但证据仍待更严谨验证。
pros: 准确抓住SpeechLLM长上下文中KV缓存瓶颈，任务价值高

papers.title_zh: C3：用于长上下文语音LLM 推理的语音引导 KV 检索
papers.summary_zh: 语音语言模型以比文本高得多的速率对音频进行编码，导致 KV 缓存主导长格式生成的内存、带宽和解码成本。 KV 检索可以通过仅关注缓存的查询相关子集来减少每步访问，但现有方法主要针对文本设计，不考虑音频关注的结构。我们首先表明检索错误可能会自回归复合为生成漂移。然后，我们分析长格式生成过程中的完整音频注意力，并确定与检索相关的三个属性：查询头之间的注意力集中程度不同、不连续的音频支持以及解码步骤之间的时间连续性。在这些观察的指导下，我们提出 $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete)，它将音频 KV 组织在分层键空间索引中，让共享 KV 头的查询头竞争公共检索预算，并通过成对的拆分合并更新自适应地重新分配检索分辨率。在四个 SpeechLLM 上的长格式语音识别、翻译和摘要中，$C^3$ 在可比较的最终 KV 访问预算下实现了检索方法中最强的整体性能，在预算紧张的情况下获得了特别大的收益，同时提高了长上下文解码效率和加速器内存扩展。

papers.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
papers.summary: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. ACCT consists of three lightweight components: the Cartographer identifies query-relevant context tokens for each target layer and KV head; the Allocator determines how many context tokens each target layer and KV head retains under a shared total KV budget; and the Compiler transforms selected source KV into sparse target KV. The target model can therefore perform inference using the transferred KV without reprocessing the original context. We evaluate ACCT in two complementary settings comprising five general-capability benchmarks and six highly context-dependent tasks. Experiments show that ACCT matches or exceeds the target model's original inference performance even when reducing the KV cache size by 75%. At a context length of approximately 19K tokens, ACCT's KV conversion achieves a 6.5-21.2 times speedup over target context prefill. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transferring context computation across models under a limited KV budget.

papers.title_zh: ACCT：非对称跨法学硕士上下文转移
papers.summary_zh: 在现实世界的部署中，大型语言模型（LLM）系统日益从单一模型调用发展到动态调用不同模型进行推理的异构部署。然而，当跨模型重复使用相同的上下文时，每个新选择的目标模型通常必须再次处理它，从而反复产生大量的计算成本。因此，我们提出了ACCT（非对称跨LLM上下文传输），其目标是同一模型族内不同规模的模型之间的KV缓存传输。 ACCT将源模型产生的KV缓存转换为目标模型可以直接使用的稀疏KV状态，从而实现上下文计算的跨模型重用，并将上下文计算与下游推理解耦。 ACCT 由三个轻量级组件组成：Cartographer 识别每个目标层和 KV 头的查询相关上下文标记；分配器确定每个目标层和 KV 头在共享的总 KV 预算下保留多少个上下文令牌； Compiler将选定的源KV转换为稀疏的目标KV。因此，目标模型可以使用传输的 KV 进行推理，而无需重新处理原始上下文。我们在两个互补的环境中评估 ACCT，其中包括五个一般能力基准和六个高度依赖于上下文的任务。实验表明，即使将 KV 缓存大小减少 75%，ACCT 也能匹配或超过目标模型的原始推理性能。在大约 19K 令牌的上下文长度下，ACCT 的 KV 转换比目标上下文预填充实现了 6.5-21.2 倍的加速。这些结果证明了在有限的 KV 预算下跨模型转移上下文计算的可行性。

papers.title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
papers.summary: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage of a billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million tokens of context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

papers.title_zh: 使用分层树结构索引器进行次二次注意力
papers.summary_zh: 注意力的二次缩放是限制大型语言模型（LLM）的长上下文能力的基本瓶颈。各种方法试图规避这一点，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（例如，滑动窗口或具有固定大小状态的线性注意力变体），要么只能实现恒定因子的加速（例如，索引器本身按二次方缩放的稀疏注意力方法）。在本文中，我们推导了一种基于分层树结构索引器的渐近次二次稀疏注意力方法，我们将其称为 Zyphra 分层注意力（ZHA）。 ZHA 在 KV 缓存上构造一棵递归压缩的键摘要树，未来的查询从上到下遍历该树以检索键的稀疏子集。至关重要的是，通过迭代地增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力的总成本在序列长度上呈次线性增长，从而导致注意力的整体次二次（但超线性）缩放。我们证明，ZHA 可以廉价地应用于现有的预训练模型，只需十亿个令牌的简短 KL 蒸馏训练阶段，并保持长上下文检索和具有挑战性的推理、数学和代理编码评估任务的性能。此外，我们表明我们的方法对于树几何结构具有高度鲁棒性，包括高达 6 层的非常深的树。最后，我们开发了一个详细的性能模型，并表明我们的方法可二次扩展，显着优于超过 100 万个上下文标记的竞争方法，并最终有可能将有效上下文窗口扩展到数亿或数十亿个标记。

papers.title: Dynamical Memory Transformer: Selective Recurrent Memories with Constant Cost Attention
papers.summary: Transformers retain an explicit history of the sequence, allowing attention to directly retrieve past representations. However, the size of the KV-Cache and the cost of a new token increase with the context length. State Space Models compress the past into a fixed-size recurrent state, at the cost of reduced addressability. We present the Dynamical Memory Transformer (DMT), a hybrid architecture that separates sequence encoding from information reading. The encoder uses several memory units, each implemented by a dynamical system with a complex diagonal recurrent matrix. An input-dependent leak rate controls their updates. The decoder then uses attention to read and combine their outputs, without going through the token history. The formulation of the recurrence allows an associative scan with O(T ) total work and O(log T ) parallel depth, with fixed dimensions. During autoregressive inference, the recurrent states and the convolution cache remain fixed in size. We compare DMT with Mamba and Transformer on cognitive and language modeling tasks, and show its strengths and limitations: DMT achieves the best results on several cognitive tasks and language modeling performance close to that of Transformer, but remains behind Mamba in language modeling. On selective copy, DMT also shows stronger length extrapolation than Mamba and Transformer. These results demonstrate that parallel dynamical memory units are a promising mechanism for retaining and using information over sequences.

papers.title_zh: 动态记忆变压器：具有恒定成本注意力的选择性循环记忆
papers.summary_zh: Transformers 保留了序列的明确历史记录，允许注意力直接检索过去的表示。然而，KV-Cache 的大小和新令牌的成本随着上下文长度的增加而增加。状态空间模型将过去压缩为固定大小的循环状态，但代价是降低了可寻址性。我们提出了动态内存转换器（DMT），这是一种将序列编码与信息读取分开的混合架构。编码器使用多个存储单元，每个存储单元均由具有复杂对角循环矩阵的动态系统实现。依赖于输入的泄漏率控制着它们的更新。然后，解码器使用注意力来读取并组合它们的输出，而不需要遍历令牌历史记录。递归的公式允许使用 O(T ) 总功和 O(log T ) 平行深度（具有固定尺寸）进行关联扫描。在自回归推理期间，循环状态和卷积缓存的大小保持固定。我们在认知和语言建模任务上将 DMT 与 Mamba 和 Transformer 进行比较，并展示其优点和局限性：DMT 在多项认知任务上取得了最佳结果，语言建模性能接近 Transformer，但在语言建模方面仍落后于 Mamba。在选择性复制方面，DMT 还表现出比 Mamba 和 Transformer 更强的长度外推能力。这些结果表明，并行动态记忆单元是保留和使用序列信息的有前途的机制。

papers.title: Where KV-Cache Error Lives in Looped Language Models: A Diagnostic Study of Ouro and Huginn
papers.summary: A looped language model applies one block of layers 4 times per token and keeps a key/value (KV) plane for each loop. We study where storage error changes the next-token distribution and how shared-weight error accumulates, using Ouro-1.4B (4 loops) on GSM8K and MATH and Huginn-0125 (32 loops) on GSM8K-derived chains, with dense, simulated quantization. Per unit of error, values carry 94% of the diagonal Fisher mass, but measured KL is dominated by keys with larger quantization errors. Local second-order prediction follows the measured KL of typical sequences, including 136 held-out chains, but misses a few confident rows, and a local second-order factor for shared weights at 32 loops ranges from 1.65 (INT8) to 4.09 (INT4), so it depends on the error direction. A cell-level allocator lowers one-step KL at 25-48% of BF16 bytes, while paired task-accuracy comparisons depend on budget and the 25% gap against K4V2 shrinks to near zero under a post hoc answer-extraction check. A later Ouro-2.6B test retains the key/value split but falsifies measured-cost allocation's advantage over Fisher at 31%; across all 21 ledger registrations, 60 of 176 criteria failed.

pros: 聚焦循环LLM中KV误差定位，问题定义具体且有价值

papers.title_zh: KV-Cache 错误存在于循环语言模型中：Ouro 和 Huginn 的诊断研究
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型对每个标记应用一个层块 4 次，并为每个循环保留一个键/值 (KV) 平面。我们使用 GSM8K 上的 Ouro-1.4B（4 个循环）和 GSM8K 衍生链上的 MATH 和 Huginn-0125（32 个循环），通过密集的模拟量化，研究存储误差在何处改变下一个令牌分布以及共享权重误差如何累积。每单位误差，值携带对角费舍尔质量的 94%，但测量的 KL 主要由具有较大量化误差的键主导。局部二阶预测遵循典型序列的测量KL，包括136个保留链，但遗漏了一些置信行，并且32个循环共享权重的局部二阶因子范围从1.65（INT8）到4.09（INT4），因此它取决于误差方向。单元级分配器将单步 KL 降低为 BF16 字节的 25-48%，而配对任务精度比较取决于预算，并且在事后答案提取检查下与 K4V2 的 25% 差距缩小到接近于零。后来的 Ouro-2.6B 测试保留了键/值分割，但伪造了测量成本分配相对于 Fisher 的 31% 优势；在所有 21 个分类账注册中，176 个标准中有 60 个未通过。

papers.title: Attention Maps Know When to Think: Training-Free Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard reasoning strategy in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), showing strong performance in complex vision-language tasks such as reasoning segmentation. However, our analysis reveals that indiscriminate CoT usage can lead to degraded performance by inducing unnecessary reasoning, a phenomenon we term overthinking. In reasoning segmentation, overthinking often leads to misalignment between the query's intent and visual grounding. To address this, we propose Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT), a training-free adaptive framework that selectively triggers CoT based on the input's intrinsic difficulty. We find that the entropy of the model's attention maps reliably reflects task difficulty: low entropy indicates confident, localized grounding, while high entropy suggests uncertainty and potential benefit from CoT. DA-CoT uses this entropy signal to determine whether to apply CoT prompting. Additionally, we introduce a Bidirectional Rethinking mechanism that enables the model to automatically flip its reasoning decision when the initial output fails, enhancing robustness by recovering from failures induced by overthinking and underthinking. DA-CoT demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Reasoning Segmentation benchmarks while significantly improving inference efficiency.
