papers.title_zh: 注意力图知道何时思考：用于推理分割的免训练难度感知思维链
papers.summary_zh: 思想链（CoT）提示已成为多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）中的标准推理策略，在复杂的视觉语言任务（例如推理分割）中表现出强大的性能。然而，我们的分析表明，不加区别地使用 CoT 可能会引发不必要的推理，从而导致性能下降，这种现象我们称之为过度思考。在推理分割中，过度思考往往会导致查询意图与视觉基础之间的不一致。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了难度感知思想链（DA-CoT），这是一种无需训练的自适应框架，可以根据输入的内在难度有选择地触发 CoT。我们发现模型注意力图的熵可靠地反映了任务难度：低熵表明自信、局部接地，而高熵表明 CoT 的不确定性和潜在好处。 DA-CoT 使用该熵信号来确定是否应用 CoT 提示。此外，我们引入了双向重新思考机制，使模型能够在初始输出失败时自动翻转其推理决策，通过从过度思考和思考不足引起的失败中恢复来增强鲁棒性。 DA-CoT 通过在推理分割基准上实现最先进的性能，同时显着提高推理效率，展示了其有效性。

papers.title: HiState: Hierarchical Prefix Cache Management for Hybrid LLM Serving in Agentic Workloads
papers.summary: Hybrid large language models combine full-attention and recurrent linear layers to reduce inference costs. Prefix caching can further reduce redundant computation across requests, but a recurrent checkpoint cannot recover an earlier state corresponding to a shorter prefix. Existing hybrid prefix caching systems retain checkpoints at selected boundaries to support common reuse patterns in conventional conversations. However, agent workloads modify and revisit earlier contexts, exposing reusable prefixes whose checkpoints were never saved or have already been evicted. A straightforward approach is to retain more checkpoints to reduce recomputation, but their cumulative footprint can displace reusable prefixes from other sessions and cause additional cache misses. To address these problems, we present HiState, a prefix cache management system for hybrid models serving agent workloads. Our key observation is that prefix reuse accesses all matching key-value (KV) entries but only one recurrent checkpoint, regardless of how many checkpoints are retained. This asymmetry allows HiState to retain historical checkpoints on SSD while prioritizing fast memory for KV entries: each hit retrieves only one checkpoint whose size is independent of context length. Within this hierarchy, we propose adaptive interval control to balance checkpoint storage against recomputation, and unified eviction to coordinate checkpoint sparsification with reclamation of stale trajectories. We implement HiState on top of vLLM and evaluate it on two public coding-agent trace datasets and controlled microbenchmarks. On real agent traces, HiState achieves up to 5.73x and 5.44x speedups in p99 TTFT over vLLM-Marconi and SGLang-HiCache, respectively.

papers.title_zh: HiState：代理工作负载中混合 LLM 服务的分层前缀缓存管理
papers.summary_zh: 混合大型语言模型结合了全注意力层和循环线性层，以降低推理成本。前缀缓存可以进一步减少请求之间的冗余计算，但是循环检查点无法恢复与较短前缀相对应的早期状态。现有的混合前缀缓存系统在选定的边界保留检查点，以支持传统对话中的常见重用模式。然而，代理工作负载会修改并重新访问早期上下文，从而暴露其检查点从未保存或已被逐出的可重用前缀。一种简单的方法是保留更多检查点以减少重新计算，但它们的累积占用空间可能会取代其他会话中的可重用前缀并导致额外的缓存未命中。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 HiState，这是一个用于服务代理工作负载的混合模型的前缀缓存管理系统。我们的主要观察结果是，前缀重用会访问所有匹配的键值 (KV) 条目，但只会访问一个循环检查点，无论保留多少个检查点。这种不对称性允许 HiState 在 SSD 上保留历史检查点，同时优先考虑 KV 条目的快速内存：每次命中仅检索一个检查点，其大小与上下文长度无关。在这个层次结构中，我们提出自适应间隔控制来平衡检查点存储和重新计算，并提出统一驱逐来协调检查点稀疏化和陈旧轨迹的回收。我们在 vLLM 之上实现 HiState，并在两个公共编码代理跟踪数据集和受控微基准上对其进行评估。在真实代理跟踪上，HiState 在 p99 TTFT 中分别比 vLLM-Marconi 和 SGLang-HiCache 实现高达 5.73 倍和 5.44 倍的加速。

papers.title: KV-Cache Patching: Tracing How and Where Fine-Tuned Behaviors Arise
papers.summary: Fine-tuning a language model changes how it responds, but where is this fine-tuned behavior instantiated? To better understand this, we evaluate whether the change in model behavior arises only during the generation of the answer tokens where the change manifests, or whether altered processing of previous tokens causes it via the attention mechanism. For this, we patch the KV cache from a LoRA fine-tuned model into the unmodified base model, and vice versa. Our results show that for some behaviors, like responding in German or emergent misalignment, patching the KV cache can indeed transfer them from the fine-tuned to the base model. Correspondingly, patching the KV cache from base to fine-tune can partially or fully remove fine-tuned behavior. Furthermore, we find that the effect of patching grows with how much of the KV cache is patched and concentrates at a few pivotal positions, with system-prompt and chat-template tokens having disproportionate influence.
papers.comment: Interpretability as a Science Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://jonasloos.github.io/kv-patching

papers.title_zh: KV-Cache 修补：跟踪微调行为如何以及在何处出现
papers.summary_zh: 微调语言模型会改变它的响应方式，但是这种微调的行为在哪里实例化呢？为了更好地理解这一点，我们评估模型行为的变化是否仅在生成发生变化的答案标记期间出现，或者是否是通过注意机制对先前标记的处理改变引起的。为此，我们将 KV 缓存从 LoRA 微调模型修补到未修改的基本模型中，反之亦然。我们的结果表明，对于某些行为，例如用德语响应或紧急错位，修补 KV 缓存确实可以将它们从微调模型转移到基本模型。相应地，将 KV 缓存从基础补丁到微调可以部分或完全删除微调行为。此外，我们发现修补的效果随着 KV 缓存的修补量而增加，并且集中在几个关键位置，其中系统提示和聊天模板令牌具有不成比例的影响。

papers.title: LEAP: Efficient LLM Inference Scheduling with Generalizable Length Prediction
papers.summary: Length-aware scheduling reduces request latency in LLM serving by prioritizing shorter requests. However, despite their large model sizes, length predictors can suffer degraded ranking performance under domain and task shifts, and adapting them can require costly retraining. Their prediction overhead can further offset the benefits of scheduling. To improve the generalization and efficiency of length-aware scheduling, we propose \textbf{LEAP}, a length prediction system with fast online adaptation and asynchronous CPU execution. LEAP reuses the serving model's prefill hidden states, which contain information about the output length, and extracts this signal through a linear readout. To adapt to substantial domain and task shifts, it updates the readout at test time through recursive least squares, using completed requests as supervision without gradient computation or historical-data replay. Prediction and updates run asynchronously on CPU, while prediction and initial batch ordering overlap the remaining GPU prefill. Across the evaluated cross-domain transfers, LEAP retains strong ranking performance, and online adaptation improves Spearman correlation by 64.7\% under a larger domain shift. Serving experiments show that LEAP reduces average per-token latency by 15.9--40.8\% compared with the evaluated length predictors, while achieving 1.9\% higher throughput with $30{,}569\times$ fewer predictor parameters than the strongest evaluated baseline.

papers.title_zh: LEAP：具有可泛化长度预测的高效 LLM 推理调度
papers.summary_zh: 长度感知调度通过优先考虑较短的请求来减少 LLM 服务中的请求延迟。然而，尽管模型规模很大，但长度预测器在领域和任务转移下可能会遭受排名性能下降的影响，并且适应它们可能需要昂贵的再训练。它们的预测开销可以进一步抵消调度的好处。为了提高长度感知调度的泛化性和效率，我们提出了 \textbf{LEAP}，一种具有快速在线自适应和异步 CPU 执行的长度预测系统。 LEAP 重用服务模型的预填充隐藏状态（其中包含有关输出长度的信息），并通过线性读数提取该信号。为了适应实质性的领域和任务变化，它通过递归最小二乘法更新测试时的读数，使用已完成的请求作为监督，而无需梯度计算或历史数据重放。预测和更新在 CPU 上异步运行，而预测和初始批量排序与剩余的 GPU 预填充重叠。在评估的跨域转移中，LEAP 保留了强大的排名性能，在线适应在较大的域转移下将 Spearman 相关性提高了 64.7%。服务实验表明，与评估的长度预测器相比，LEAP 将平均每个令牌延迟降低了 15.9--40.8\%，同时实现了 1.9\% 的吞吐量提高，且预测器参数比最强的评估基线少了 $30{,}569\times$。

papers.title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: Long-horizon LLM agents play an important role in solving complex and sustained tasks, with ever-growing interaction contexts. However, these accumulated contexts will raise substantial computational cost and obscure key decision-relevant evidence. Existing methods typically train external compressors or context-management agents to rewrite context as shorter hard-token sequences, but such external selection may not align with the LLM's evolving representation and is necessarily lossy. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC), a training-free compression method using soft tokens within LLM agent for long-horizon tasks. Specifically, ASTC uses the model's native recurrent dynamics to determine the already absorbed information, leveraging the commonly-used hybrid Gated Delta Network (GDN)-attention. It then carries this information forward as agentic soft tokens while retaining exact values as hard tokens. The resulting compact sequence reduces later-layer computation and yields reusable KV caches, extending the savings across the agent's trajectory. Extensive experiments on long-horizon tasks show that ASTC matches or exceeds the uncompressed agent's accuracy with up to 50.68% fewer end-to-end Attention Pairs, while trained compressors require 15.4 to 103.7 times more Attention Pairs per successful task. These findings highlight agentic soft tokens as a model-native way to carry absorbed context forward as the task representation evolves.

papers.title_zh: 针对长期 LLM 代理的模型内上下文压缩和代理软令牌
papers.summary_zh: 长期 LLM 代理在解决复杂且持续的任务以及不断增长的交互环境中发挥着重要作用。然而，这些积累的上下文将增加大量的计算成本并掩盖关键的决策相关证据。现有方法通常训练外部压缩器或上下文管理代理将上下文重写为更短的硬令牌序列，但这种外部选择可能与 LLM 的不断发展的表示不一致，并且必然是有损的。在本文中，我们介绍了 Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC)，这是一种在 LLM 代理中使用软令牌进行长期任务的免训练压缩方法。具体来说，ASTC 使用模型的原生循环动力学来确定已经吸收的信息，利用常用的混合门控 Delta 网络 (GDN) 注意力。然后，它将这些信息作为代理软令牌转发，同时保留精确值作为硬令牌。由此产生的紧凑序列减少了后层计算并产生可重用的 KV 缓存，从而在代理的轨迹上扩展了节省。对长视野任务的大量实验表明，ASTC 可以匹配或超过未压缩智能体的准确度，端到端注意力对减少了 50.68%，而训练有素的压缩器每个成功任务需要的注意力对增加了 15.4 到 103.7 倍。这些发现强调了代理软令牌作为一种模型本机方式，可以随着任务表示的发展而将吸收的上下文向前推进。

papers.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
papers.summary: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.

papers.title_zh: 专家表现出结构化冗余：混合专家大型语言模型的结构保留专家剪枝
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏MoE机制显着改善了模型容量和推理​​效率之间的权衡。然而，实际部署仍然需要存储所有专家，从而导致大量的内存开销。我们证明 MoE 层中的专家输出表现出结构化冗余。在不同的模型和任务类别中，专家输出的稳定排名和熵有效排名始终远低于名义专家数量，而专家输出分布也表现出较少的有效模式。受这些观察的启发，我们将专家剪枝重新表述为保留结构的专家子集选择问题，并通过贪婪策略对其进行有效优化，而不是仅对单个专家进行独立评分和排名或对专家组合进行详尽搜索。我们在统一结构保持框架下提出了两种专家剪枝方法：投影能量专家剪枝（PEEP），通过最大化加权投影能量来保留功能子空间；以及分布覆盖专家剪枝（DCEP），通过最小化加权覆盖误差来保留分布几何。这两种方法都将路由器派生的权重作为先验，使它们能够共同保留专家之间的全局结构关系，同时考虑到个别专家的局部重要性。 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的实验表明，在专家保留率分别为 75% 和 50% 的情况下，我们的方法在大多数基准测试中都优于最先进的基线，并且在一般任务和数学推理任务中始终实现最佳平均性能。

papers.title: TraceSpec: Understanding and Improving Speculative Decoding for LLM Agents
papers.summary: LLM agents execute tasks through repeated model calls over evolving histories of reasoning, actions, and tool feedback. Aggregate speculative-decoding metrics merge these distinct decisions, providing limited guidance on where draft supervision is needed. We present TraceSpec, a framework connecting trajectory evaluation with adaptive draft training. It combines dynamic execution with fixed-prefix replay and introduces TraceSpec-Traj, a corpus of 10,000 training states and 2,500 test states spanning browsing and software engineering. Analysis of five speculative baselines reveals that aggregate acceptance can rise with context length while declining within matched late browsing actions. Workload and phase further distinguish these trends, motivating supervision guided by trajectory conditions. TraceSpec trains on intermediate assistant turns and allocates a fixed prediction budget using state-conditioned estimates of prefix-aware acceptance gaps. Across three target sizes and two temperatures, it improves replay throughput by 12.5% to 22.6% over its DSpark base. Qwen3-4B ablations show that adaptive allocation increases accepted length by 3.3% to 10.0% over fixed full-turn supervision, with additional comparisons substantiating the roles of state conditioning and consecutive-token agreement. The resulting evaluation resources, trajectory findings, and training strategy connect the analysis of agent execution to practical draft improvement.

papers.title_zh: TraceSpec：理解和改进 LLM 代理的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理通过对推理、操作和工具反馈的演变历史进行重复的模型调用来执行任务。聚合推测解码指标合并了这些不同的决策，为需要草稿监督的地方提供了有限的指导。我们提出了 TraceSpec，一个将轨迹评估与自适应草稿训练连接起来的框架。它将动态执行与固定前缀重放相结合，并引入了 TraceSpec-Traj，这是一个包含 10,000 个训练状态和 2,500 个测试状态的语料库，涵盖浏览和软件工程。对五个推测基线的分析表明，总体接受度会随着上下文长度的增加而上升，而在匹配的后期浏览操作中则下降。工作量和阶段进一步区分了这些趋势，激发了轨迹条件指导下的监督。 TraceSpec 对中间助理轮次进行训练，并使用前缀感知接受差距的状态条件估计来分配固定的预测预算。在三种目标大小和两种温度下，它的重放吞吐量比 DSpark 基础提高了 12.5% 至 22.6%。 Qwen3-4B 消融表明，与固定全轮监督相比，自适应分配将接受长度增加了 3.3% 至 10.0%，并通过额外的比较证实了状态调节和连续令牌协议的作用。由此产生的评估资源、轨迹发现和训练策略将代理执行分析与实际草案改进联系起来。

papers.title: ARK: Avoiding Routing Collisions for KV Cache Transfer in Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.summary: Disaggregated LLM inference separates the prefill and decode phases across GPU pools, generating massive KV-cache transfers. Because these transfers last hundreds of milliseconds to seconds, they behave as mega elephant flows that dominate link bandwidth utilization. In this regime, stateless ECMP can perform poorly: hash collisions may overload one spine link while leaving others idle, stretching transfer times by seconds. Yet this same persistence makes coordination practical. Since these flows are long-lived, even lightweight one-to-all coordination can be amortized over their lifetime. We present ARK, a distributed elephant-flow path reservation mechanism. ARK coordinates senders to choose source ports whose hashes map concurrent flows onto distinct spines, without requiring switch changes or receiver-side packet reordering. Packet-level RDMA simulations show that ARK reduces mean and P95 FCT by up to 27.3% and 34.0% under moderate load, and further reduces mean TTFT by up to 12.9%.
papers.comment: 7 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the ACM SIGCOMM 2026 Conference (SIGCOMM '26)
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the ACM SIGCOMM 2026 Conference (SIGCOMM '26), pp. 2067-2073, 2026

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用，但创新与证据尚不够硬。
pros: 准确抓住解耦推理中KV迁移象流导致ECMP碰撞的关键瓶颈
无需交换机改造且避免接收端乱序重组，工程落地性较强

papers.title_zh: ARK：避免分解 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存传输的路由冲突
papers.summary_zh: 分解的 LLM 推理将 GPU 池中的预填充和解码阶段分开，从而生成大量 KV 缓存传输。由于这些传输持续数百毫秒到数秒，因此它们的行为就像巨型流量一样，主导着链路带宽利用率。在这种情况下，无状态 ECMP 的性能可能很差：哈希冲突可能会使一个主干链路过载，同时使其他链路空闲，从而将传输时间延长数秒。然而，同样的坚持使得协调变得切实可行。由于这些流是长期存在的，因此即使是轻量级的一对多协调也可以在其生命周期内摊销。我们提出了ARK，一种分布式大象流路径预留机制。 ARK 协调发送方选择源端口，其哈希值将并发流映射到不同的主干上，无需更改交换机或接收方数据包重新排序。数据包级 RDMA 模拟表明，ARK 在中等负载下将平均 FCT 和 P95 FCT 降低高达 27.3% 和 34.0%，并进一步将平均 TTFT 降低高达 12.9%。

papers.title: Kernel-based Interpolatory Methods for Context Compression of Attention Mechanisms
papers.summary: The bottleneck of attention mechanisms, which are the fundamental building block of modern language models, is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. There has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context, also called KV-cache compression. In this article, we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel. In this formalism, attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants, this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. We thus introduce two novel KV-cache compression methods which we call GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM), respectively. As the cost of these methods is quadratic in terms of context length, we propose surrogate models based on the Taylor series, the Performer and the Random Fourier Features method which allow the compression to be done in linear time. Finally, we extend this result to the streaming attention setting, providing new methods which allow one to penalize the selection of interpolation nodes based on the previously interpolated context and to update the previous interpolation based on new information. We then provide numerical results on the convergence of the residuals and the output error in future queries and preliminary results on the LongBench-E benchmark showing performance comparable to the state-of-the-art methods. These experiments suggest that the range revealed by our Q-DAIM method could help identify where information is concentrated in the KV cache, thus enabling an efficient compression.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路新颖但实证与严谨性不足，潜力大于结论强度。

papers.title_zh: 用于注意力机制上下文压缩的基于核的插值方法
papers.summary_zh: 注意力机制是现代语言模型的基本构建模块，其瓶颈在于其上下文大小的二次复杂性。因此，人们对上下文压缩（也称为 KV 缓存压缩）越来越感兴趣。在本文中，我们首先在与其内核相关的希尔伯特空间中表述它，从而考虑压缩注意力机制上下文的问题。在这种形式中，注意力可以表示为两个线性映射的比率，其插值也是插值的比率，这使得我们可以直接考虑线性映射的插值。因此，我们引入了两种新颖的 KV 缓存压缩方法，分别基于广义经验插值法（GEIM）和 Q-离散经验插值法（Q-DEIM），称为 GAIM 和 Q-DAIM。由于这些方法的成本是上下文长度的二次方，因此我们提出了基于泰勒级数、表演者和随机傅立叶特征方法的代理模型，该模型允许在线性时间内完成压缩。最后，我们将此结果扩展到流式注意力设置，提供了新的方法，允许根据先前插值的上下文来惩罚插值节点的选择，并根据新信息更新先前的插值。然后，我们提供了未来查询中残差收敛和输出误差的数值结果，以及 LongBench-E 基准测试的初步结果，显示其性能可与最先进的方法相媲美。这些实验表明，我们的 Q-DAIM 方法揭示的范围可以帮助识别信息集中在 KV 缓存中的位置，从而实现有效的压缩。

papers.title: CoFiBreak: A Coarse-to-Fine Diversity Reward for Effective Multi-Turn Jailbreak
papers.summary: Automated red teaming trains an attacker large language model (LLM) to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM, but reinforcement learning can collapse attackers onto a narrow set of prompts when attack success is the only reward. Such a collapse of attack diversity can bias safety evaluation toward repeatedly testing near-duplicate attack patterns rather than the underlying harmful intents. Existing methods often trade off attack success or inference cost for greater content or strategy diversity. We propose CoFiBreak, a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that improves attack diversity while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost. The coarse reward broadens which strategies the attacker uses by encouraging strategies underrepresented within each GRPO group, while the fine reward broadens how those strategies are realized by discouraging reuse of the same personas, framings, and output formats after harmful-intent information is removed from prompt embeddings. Diversity rewards apply only to attacks that already exceed an effectiveness threshold, so diversity cannot be gained through ineffective attacks. Since both rewards are computed only during training, CoFiBreak also retains inference efficiency. Trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim, CoFiBreak discovers 1.6-2.0x as many distinct successful fine-grained strategies as the strongest baseline across frontier victims on HarmBench. It reaches 98.8% ASR@10 (attack success rate with 10 generations per intent) on AdvBench with the highest diversity score among all compared methods, which is 2.1x that of the strongest-attacking baseline. The resulting attacks transfer to unseen frontier LLMs, reaching 71.0% ASR@10 on AdvBench with the unseen victim Claude-Opus-4.6. The code will be released.
papers.comment: 10 pages main text, 24 pages total, 8 figures, 12 tables

papers.title_zh: CoFiBreak：有效多轮越狱的从粗到细的多样性奖励
papers.summary_zh: 自动红队训练攻击者大语言模型 (LLM)，以引发受害者 LLM 的有害响应，但当攻击成功是唯一奖励时，强化学习可以使攻击者陷入一组狭窄的提示中。攻击多样性的崩溃可能会使安全评估偏向于重复测试近乎重复的攻击模式，而不是潜在的有害意图。现有方法通常会牺牲攻击成功或推理成本来换取更大的内容或策略多样性。我们提出了 CoFiBreak，这是一种针对组相对策略优化（GRPO）的从粗到细的多样性奖励，可以提高攻击多样性，同时保持强大的攻击有效性和较低的推理成本。粗略奖励通过鼓励每个 GRPO 组中代表性不足的策略来扩大攻击者使用的策略，而精细奖励通过在从提示嵌入中删除有害意图信息后阻止重复使用相同的角色、框架和输出格式来扩大这些策略的实现方式。多样性奖励仅适用于已经超过有效性阈值的攻击，因此无法通过无效攻击获得多样性。由于这两个奖励仅在训练期间计算，因此 CoFiBreak 还保留了推理效率。使用 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 作为受害者进行训练后，CoFiBreak 发现，成功的不同细粒度策略的数量是 HarmBench 上跨边界受害者的最强基线的 1.6-2.0 倍。它在 AdvBench 上达到 98.8% ASR@10（每个意图 10 代的攻击成功率），在所有比较方法中多样性得分最高，是最强攻击基线的 2.1 倍。由此产生的攻击转移到了看不见的前沿 LLM，在 AdvBench 上达到了 71.0% ASR@10，而看不见的受害者 Claude-Opus-4.6。代码将被发布。

papers.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
papers.summary: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this race reproduces block verification, so the output follows the target model exactly. We evaluate TextSeal2 on three LLMs. At equal output token diversity, TextSeal2 detects 8 to 22 percentage points more 100-token answers than TextSeal at a false-positive rate of $10^{-3}$, and is comparable to textGrain while requiring no post-logits optimization. Under speculative decoding, it detects 18 and 22 percentage points more 200-token answers than TextSeal and textGrain, respectively, at the same acceptance rate.

papers.title_zh: TextSeal2：具有 Copula 混合和无记忆竞赛的无失真 LLM 水印
papers.summary_zh: 我们提出了 TextSeal2，这是一种用于大型语言模型的无失真水印，可将其信号保持在推测解码下：替换被拒绝草稿的令牌仍使用相同的密钥加有水印，并且接受率保持不变。它还保留了输出多样性，并且不会增加可测量的推理延迟。它的前身 TextSeal 通过抛硬币将每个令牌路由到两个密钥之一，从而恢复了 Gumbel-max 方案的多样性。这是次优的，因为检测器在不知道使用哪个键的情况下对两个键的分数进行平均。相反，TextSeal2 将两个或多个键合并为一个虚拟键，并通过 AutoMark 的高斯联结函数将其与新噪声耦合。可以通过这种方式合并任意数量的密钥，包括公开共享的密钥，而不会削弱检测。在推测性解码下，TextSeal2 通过另一场指数竞赛来验证密钥草稿，并在草稿竞赛的剩余部分上运行。通过无记忆，这场竞赛重现了区块验证，因此输出完全遵循目标模型。我们在三个法学硕士上评估 TextSeal2。在相同的输出标记多样性下，TextSeal2 检测到的 100 个标记答案比 TextSeal 多 8 到 22 个百分点，误报率为 10^{-3}$，并且与 textGrain 相当，同时不需要 post-logits 优化。在推测解码下，在相同的接受率下，它检测到的 200 个标记的答案分别比 TextSeal 和 textGrain 多 18 个百分点和 22 个百分点。

papers.title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
papers.summary: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unstable. This motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. We address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality, with larger gains as more loops are added. Looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. Parallel Loop Transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions, allowing loop stages to run concurrently. However, in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. We find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. Together, these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

papers.title_zh: 如何循环你的 Transformer：循环缩放、专业化和并行推理
papers.summary_zh: 变压器模型中的循环通过重复应用相同的变压器或其中的一部分来重用权重，使模型更深而不增加其参数数量。循环是否有用取决于哪个约束占主导地位：模型大小、训练计算或自回归推理效率。我们在从头开始训练的密集解码器变压器中联合研究这些权衡，改变模型的哪些部分被循环、应用多少个循环以及信息在循环之间传递的方式。我们的实验跨越具有多达 1B 个参数的模型，在多达 155B 个令牌上进行训练，并具有高达 $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOP 和 32 个循环。我们发现，循环整个变压器通常在固定参数预算下提供最强的质量，而循环中间层块在训练 FLOP 受到限制时提供更好的回报。添加循环并不总是有益的：增益最终会饱和、逆转或变得不稳定。这促使人们询问是否强制每个循环使用相同的权重会限制更深循环的好处。我们通过添加小型循环特定的低阶适配器来解决这个问题，这些适配器可以提高质量，并且随着添加更多循环而获得更大的增益。循环变压器还遭受与循环数量成比例的解码减慢。并行循环变压器通过在相邻令牌位置的循环之间传递隐藏状态来解决此问题，从而允许循环阶段同时运行。然而，在我们的实验中，原始配方并不能始终保持普通循环的质量增益。我们发现，在组合它们之前保留当前令牌嵌入并单独对其和先前令牌隐藏状态进行标准化可以在模型规模和训练预算上恢复强大的性能。总之，这些结果表明有效的循环需要将设计与资源约束和推理设置相匹配。

papers.title: Rimuru: Unified Memory Management for Modern LLM Serving via Elastic Expert Offloading
papers.summary: Modern LLMs strain device memory through large model weights and attention states, particularly in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing systems separately provision memory for model weights and attention states, imposing fixed fixed boundaries that cannot adapt to the changing memory demands of workloads. Under heavy workloads, insufficient state capacity limits request concurrency and reduces throughput; under light workloads, idle memory in one region cannot be reallocated to another, wasting device memory. Meanwhile, modern LLM architectures introduce heterogeneous tensors with diverse layouts and lifetimes, further complicating memory management. These problems motivate unified memory management for heterogeneous tensors. However, a shared pool alone does not make memory directly reusable across tensors with different allocation granularities and execution layouts. This paper presents Rimuru, a modern LLM serving system that unifies memory management through elastic expert offloading. Rimuru establishes a shared page pool to enables elastic memory sharing across heterogeneous tensors. To accommodate different allocation granularities, Rimuru introduces memory views that allow each tensor type to interpret the shared memory space using its own page size and page table. Furthermore, Rimuru combines huge-page alignment with a multi-level page allocator that splits and merges pages, enabling cross-type capacity reuse. A page-table-aware fused MoE kernel directly accesses non-contiguous expert weights, avoiding copy overhead. Building on these mechanisms, Rimuru employs a workload-aware adjuster that dynamically reallocates pages across tensor types according to runtime demands. Implemented on top of vLLM, Rimuru remains compatible with modern LLMs. Evaluations show that Rimuru achieves up to 19.03x baseline throughput and reduces TTFT by 98.1% on average.

papers.title_zh: Rimuru：通过弹性专家卸载实现现代 LLM 服务的统一内存管理
papers.summary_zh: 现代法学硕士通过较大的模型权重和注意力状态对设备内存造成压力，特别是在资源受限的情况下。现有系统分别为模型权重和注意力状态提供内存，强加了固定的边界，无法适应工作负载不断变化的内存需求。大负载下，状态容量不足会限制请求并发，降低吞吐量；在轻负载下，一个区域的空闲内存无法重新分配到另一区域，从而浪费设备内存。同时，现代 LLM 架构引入了具有不同布局和生命周期的异构张量，使内存管理进一步复杂化。这些问题促使异构张量的统一内存管理。然而，单独的共享池并不能让内存在具有不同分配粒度和执行布局的张量之间直接重用。本文介绍了 Rimuru，一种现代 LLM 服务系统，通过弹性专家卸载来统一内存管理。 Rimuru 建立了一个共享页面池，以实现跨异构张量的弹性内存共享。为了适应不同的分配粒度，Rimuru 引入了内存视图，允许每种张量类型使用自己的页面大小和页表来解释共享内存空间。此外，Rimuru 将大页对齐与多级页面分配器相结合，可拆分和合并页面，从而实现跨类型的容量重用。页表感知融合 MoE 内核直接访问非连续的专家权重，避免了复制开销。在这些机制的基础上，Rimuru 采用了一个工作负载感知调整器，可以根据运行时需求跨张量类型动态地重新分配页面。 Rimuru 在 vLLM 之上实施，仍然与现代 LLM 兼容。评估显示，Rimuru 实现了高达 19.03 倍基线吞吐量，平均 TTFT 降低了 98.1%。

papers.title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
papers.summary: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、实证扎实，但外推性仍待加强。
pros: 聚焦“仅接受token计收益”的能耗核算，问题定义精准且具有工程现实意义
实验设置贴近生产（SGLang、CUDA Graph、H100/H200、大batch、多语料），结论对部署决策有直接指导价值

papers.title_zh: 仅接受的令牌才算数：延迟目标下推测解码的能量核算
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型服务受到设施能力的限制。每个代币的能量决定了数据中心可以服务的代币数量，而延迟目标则限制了每个用户接收代币的速度。在解码期间，从存储器中读取每个生成的令牌的每个权重。批处理会在用户之间分摊此读取，但不会使单个用户更快。推测解码的作用是：起草者提出几个未来的令牌，目标模型在重复使用相同权重读取的单个前向传递中验证它们。因为每个起草的代币都必须验证是否被接受，所以节省的能源投机取决于有多少起草的代币被接受。这种节省很难确定。它因来自不同注意力系列的目标模型和起草方案而异，并且取决于所提供的文本。我们评估的每个起草者在对话中接受的标记都少于在代码中接受的标记，并且每个经过培训的起草者在罗曼什语（一种资源匮乏的语言）上接受的标记比在英语上接受的标记少。我们在 H100 和 H200 GPU 上测量生产服务条件（SGLang、启用 CUDA 图）下的推测解码，在 5 个语料库中批量大小高达 64。在密集模型中，验证（而不是起草）主导着能源成本。随着批次的增长，节省的空间会减少，因为批次已经共享了猜测将在接受的令牌之间划分的权重读取。在大批量情况下，区块起草者将验证推向算术和内存流量之间的平衡点，进入计算限制状态，在这种情况下，节省变成了损失，而接受度较低的起草者会提高每个代币的能量。通过推测来满足更严格的延迟目标会消耗额外的能量。批量越大，每个代币的能量就越低，无需投机。仅当接受度很高时，推测才会增加节省，并且在我们测试的模型上，它为保留延迟的 DVFS 留下了很少的空间。

papers.title: Low-Bit GDN Recurrent-State Quantization: Global Gradient-aware Allocation and Pure-Write Sliding Windows
papers.summary: Linear attention stores historical information in a recurrent state of fixed size, providing a compact memory representation for long-context inference. Reducing state precision further lowers per-request storage requirements, but quantized writeback errors enter subsequent recurrences, degrade prediction quality on long-reasoning tasks, and can be accompanied by repetitive generation and excessively long outputs. We propose Global Gradient-aware Allocation (GGA) and the Pure-Write Sliding Window (PW) to address precision allocation and recent-information maintenance. GGA combines candidate quantization residuals with gradient sensitivity to future prediction loss to allocate head bit widths under a model-wide mixed-precision budget. PW independently maintains recent pure writes as FP8 vector pairs, propagates them through the full GDN state transition, and merges them into the low-bit historical state only after they leave the window. Across seven evaluations on Qwen3.5-4B/9B, GGA allocation alone improves over STEPQuant@4 by 19.48/29.84 percentage points. Adding PW-S8 yields seven-task macro-averages of 69.83%/78.63%, improving over STEPQuant@4 by 38.39/41.21 percentage points, respectively. Both precision reallocation and window maintenance improve task scores while mitigating excessively long outputs: at @6, GGA reduces mean generation length, averaged equally across tasks, by 10.45%/14.65% relative to STEPQuant; adding PW-S8 to GGA@4 further reduces mean generation length by 32.32%/36.77%. Comparisons at similar storage budgets further show that using additional capacity to maintain recent writes yields higher task scores and shorter mean outputs than solely increasing the bit width of the accumulated state.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向长上下文推理的实用改进，潜力较强
pros: 针对低比特循环状态误差累积提出GGA+PW联合方案，问题定义与方法对应清晰
在两种模型与七项评测上报告了较大增益，并兼顾精度与生成长度稳定性

papers.title_zh: 低位 GDN 循环状态量化：全局梯度感知分配和纯写滑动窗口
papers.summary_zh: 线性注意力以固定大小的循环状态存储历史信息，为长上下文推理提供紧凑的内存表示。降低状态精度进一步降低了每个请求的存储要求，但量化写回错误会进入后续循环，降低长推理任务的预测质量，并且可能伴随重复生成和过长的输出。我们提出全局梯度感知分配（GGA）和纯写滑动窗口（PW）来解决精确分配和最新信息维护问题。 GGA 将候选量化残差与对未来预测损失的梯度敏感性相结合，以在模型范围的混合精度预算下分配头位宽度。 PW 独立地将最近的纯写入维护为 FP8 向量对，通过完整的 GDN 状态转换传播它们，并仅在它们离开窗口后将它们合并到低位历史状态。在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 的七次评估中，仅 GGA 分配就比 STEPQuant@4 提高了 19.48/29.84 个百分点。添加 PW-S8 的七任务宏平均值为 69.83%/78.63%，比 STEPQuant@4 分别提高了 38.39/41.21 个百分点。精度重新分配和窗口维护都提高了任务分数，同时减轻了过长的输出：在 @6 时，GGA 相对于 STEPQuant 减少了平均生成长度（跨任务平均）10.45%/14.65%；将 PW-S8 添加到 GGA@4 中，平均世代长度进一步减少了 32.32%/36.77%。类似存储预算的比较进一步表明，与仅增加累积状态的位宽度相比，使用额外的容量来维护最近的写入会产生更高的任务分数和更短的平均输出。

papers.title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义新颖且实用，但证据深度仍有限。
pros: 明确指出dLLM缓存复用误差与AR场景本质差异，问题切中痛点
提出TRACE与分层保精策略，兼顾可实现性与跨任务实证表现
cons: 摘要未体现统计显著性、开销拆解与更广基线对比，严谨性仍待加强

papers.title_zh: 扩散语言模型的 KV 缓存量化
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存量化在自回归语言模型中得到了很好的研究，其中缓存的前缀状态在因果注意下是准确的，并且量化主要是缓存重建问题。扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 打破了这一假设。快速 dLLM 推理在去噪步骤中重用 KV 状态，但双向令牌表示可能会随着屏蔽令牌的显示而改变，因此重用的缓存可能已经与应用量化之前的完全重新计算不同。我们研究了这种缓存重用错误下的 KV 缓存量化。我们将 KIVI 和 KVQuant 应用于 Fast-dLLM 式前缀和双缓存重用，并引入 TRACE 和 dLLM-KVQ。 TRACE 重建可行的 dLLM，揭示来自提示答案对的轨迹，提供与迭代屏蔽解码相匹配的校准状态。 dLLM-KVQ 使用这些轨迹来选择每层 K 缓存条目，这些条目根据输出和注意力级别的行为指标保持高精度，同时应用标准的低位值量化。在 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH 和 MBPP 上的 LLaDA 和 Dream 评估中，dLLM-KVQ 在报告的 4 位和 2 位前缀/双缓存设置的量化方法中获得了最高的平均得分。

papers.title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
papers.summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法实用但证据仍需更扎实。
pros: 准确识别dLLM与AR调度失配，提出统一工作量度量与跨阶段共批调度思路

papers.title_zh: DWISE：去噪工作负载通知调度引擎
papers.summary_zh: 与自回归大型语言模型 (AR-LLM) 不同，扩散 LLM (dLLM) 通过并行迭代地对许多标记进行去噪来生成文本，为高效推理提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，现有的服务框架使用专为 AR 模型设计的策略来安排 dLLM 请求，即先到先服务 (FCFS) 准入和预填充优先级。我们发现这两项政策都不适合 dLLM，浪费了他们的大部分速度。 FCFS 忽略了 dLLM 请求的解码成本在到达时是高度异构且未知的，从而导致严重的队头阻塞。预填充优先级广泛用于 AR-LLM 服务，以保持较低的首次令牌时间，但会大幅降低 dLLM 效率，因为仅运行提示的轮次会使大部分批次闲置。我们推出 DWISE，这是一种基于去噪工作负载的调度引擎，可实现高效的 dLLM 服务。 DWISE 通过剩余工作来安排请求，以预填充和去噪共享的块级单元来衡量，因此两个阶段共享一轮。为了预测未知的去噪工作负载，DWISE 在准入时将基于提示的轻量级预测器与第一轮去噪的隐藏状态的单一细化相结合，捕获提示中缺少的特定于模型的信息，并且不需要额外的模型执行。 DWISE 在 SGLang 中实施，并在突发工作负载下对来自三个 dLLM 系列的五个模型进行了评估，与 SGLang 相比，平均端到端延迟平均降低了 5.4$\times$，最高可达 14.9$\times$，同时保持任务准确性。该代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
papers.summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)

papers.title_zh: 用于下一个 POI 推荐的类别锚定大型语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 下一个兴趣点 (POI) 推荐旨在根据时空签到数据预测用户的下一个目的地，并作为许多基于位置的服务的基础。最近的进展通过将用户轨迹文本化以利用他们的语义推理能力，将大型语言模型（LLM）纳入到这项任务中。然而，使用此类模型直接生成 POI 标识符并不可靠：POI 是稀疏、本地化和长尾的实体，自然语言语义较弱，这在高级移动意图和具体 POI 预测之间造成了语义与实体之间的差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 ANCHOR，这是一种类别锚定框架，用于在下一个 POI 推荐中实现语义到实体的基础。具体来说，ANCHOR 首先在紧凑且稳定的语义空间中估计类别级别的移动意图，而不是直接预测具体的 POI 实体。然后，通过整合三个互补的移动性证据来源（类别锚、历史访问记忆和用户偏好），将推断出的意图扎根到候选集中。最后，历史感知重排序器通过将每个候选 POI 与用户的历史移动模式和当前上下文进行匹配来选择目标 POI。对三个真实世界签到数据集的实验表明，ANCHOR 在报告的指标上始终优于代表性的传统、结构增强和基于 LLM 的基线。进一步的分析验证了语义到实体基础的有效性，并显示了候选覆盖范围、排名质量和推理效率之间的有利权衡。

papers.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
papers.summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.
papers.comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026, Sydney as a poster

papers.title_zh: 解锁预训练自回归图像模型中的任意阶生成
papers.summary_zh: 自回归 (AR) 图像生成器原则上功能强大，但在实践中缺乏灵活性：使用固定光栅扫描顺序进行训练将图像分布的单个因式分解硬编码到模型中，使其无法在推理时进行修复、覆盖或编辑。现有的解决方案，包括现代离散扩散系列，从头开始对令牌排序的混合进行训练，花费的计算量大约是标准光栅扫描训练的 3 倍；离散扩散通过构建进一步牺牲了与 AR 推理生态系统（KV 缓存、vLLM）的兼容性。我们认为这个成本是不必要的。预训练的光栅扫描 AR 模型已经学习了图像标记上的联合分布；它缺乏的不是知识，而是通过非顺序条件路径表达知识的能力。我们提出了一种方法，使用两个组件将预训练的光栅扫描模型调整为任意阶生成器：未来感知的位置嵌入，以可忽略的开销解决目标位置可识别性问题，以及排序课程，跟踪从预训练的解决方案到良好的任意阶盆地的稳定优化路径。应用于两种架构和两种规模（LlamaGen-L/XL、RAR-L/XL）的四个基本模型时，该方法在 ImageNet 修复（FID 6.21 与 10.44）和修复方面大大优于 MaskGIT，与 MAR-L 具有竞争力，以类条件 FID 增加 1.2-1.9 倍来换取这种灵活性，并且在预训练之外花费 13-33% 的额外计算成本，而标准 AR 推理堆栈保持不变。我们的结果表明，修复、修复和编辑不需要添加到自回归图像模型中。它们可以从现有的中解锁。代码可在 https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation 获取。

papers.title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding, verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship, with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. We evaluate this across 10 sparse MoE models (30B--1T parameters, 8--512 experts) and find recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size. We find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes, but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and GPU execution dynamics. At low batch size, MoE layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights; on H100, kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of MoE kernels relative to attention, with L2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. Across draft tokens, routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. We model this effect using a maximum-entropy Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4\% error, and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.
papers.comment: Accepted as at NeurIPS 2026 main track conference

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、洞察扎实，但外推性待验证
pros: 挑战并修正了MoE上SD经典凹形速度规律，经验覆盖面广
提出IPF最大熵建模解释路由重叠，误差低且能复现实测趋势
cons: 摘要未体现端到端服务指标与不同硬件/负载下泛化，结论外推风险仍在

papers.title_zh: 为什么推测解码在稀疏 MoE 模型上比预测的效果更好
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过利用解码的内存限制性质，在单次前向传递中验证多个草稿令牌，加速自回归推理。对于专家混合 (MoE) 模型，先前的工作预测了凹加速-批量大小关系，由于专家饱和，增益在中间批量大小处达到峰值。我们对 10 个稀疏 MoE 模型（30B--1T 参数，8--512 名专家）进行了评估，发现最近的细粒度模型打破了这一趋势，在低批量大小下表现出更高的加速。我们发现验证成本不仅受激活专家字节的影响，还受草稿令牌和 GPU 执行动态之间的时间重叠的影响。在小批量大小下，细粒度模型中的 MoE 层所占的运行时间份额比权重要小得多；在 H100 上，内核分析将这主要归因于 MoE 内核相对于注意力的更高带宽利用率，L2 吸收了共同路由专家的重复读取。在草案代币中，相对于独立性假设，路由重叠进一步减少了验证期间激活的独特专家。我们使用最大熵迭代比例拟合 (IPF) 框架对这种效果进行建模，该框架根据路由重叠统计数据预测独特的专家计数，误差小于 4%，并大幅缩小与真实模型曲线的差距，并从合成路由中捕获定性低批量趋势。

papers.title: TableTune: Measured, Self-Correcting Draft-Length Tables for Dynamic Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model (LLM) serving only while the GPU has spare compute, so the best draft length, the number of tokens a small drafter guesses per step, shrinks as the batch grows. vLLM lets operators set the draft length for each batch size with a hand-written table, but nothing measures or corrects that table. We present TableTune. Its tuner times the decoding step for every batch size and draft length on vLLM's own serving path and computes, in minutes, the table that maximizes throughput. Its controller, a vLLM plugin, tracks how many guesses are accepted in live traffic and rebuilds the table while serving. We measure TableTune only against other ways to speculate. On an H100, the tuned table delivers at least 94% of the throughput of the best fixed draft length at every load in four of five drafter settings (88% in the fifth) without the operator having to know which length that is. Against reimplementations of TurboSpec- and Nightjar-style control on the same engine, its worst-case loss is never higher than theirs, and with the EAGLE-3 drafter it is 3% against 9% and 12%. On a mixture-of-experts model, vLLM's documented table loses up to 18% and the tuned table at most 3%. Starting from mistuned tables, the controller raises throughput by up to 58% (up to 45% on vLLM's default runner), and after a workload switch with the DFlash drafter it recovers 96% of a stale table's loss. In llm-d's optimized-baseline deployment as shipped, two Qwen3-32B replicas on four GPUs, the tuned table is up to 32% faster than a fixed draft length of 3 and up to 25% faster than vLLM's documented table at high load, and the controller raises the documented table's throughput by up to 29%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但学术新意与证据仍偏弱。
pros: 问题定位准确，直接解决vLLM手工表难维护的痛点
端到端在真实部署与负载切换下展示了可观吞吐收益
cons: 核心方法更像系统化调参与反馈控制，理论机制与跨模型泛化证据不足

papers.title_zh: TableTune：用于动态推测解码的测量自校正草稿长度表
papers.summary_zh: 仅当 GPU 有空闲计算时，推测性解码才能加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务，因此最佳草稿长度（小型起草者每步猜测的标记数量）会随着批次的增长而缩小。 vLLM 允许操作员使用手写表格设置每个批次大小的草稿长度，但没有任何措施或纠正该表格。我们推出 TableTune。它的调谐器在 vLLM 自己的服务路径上为每个批量大小和草稿长度计算解码步骤，并在几分钟内计算出最大化吞吐量的表。它的控制器是一个 vLLM 插件，跟踪实时流量中接受的猜测数量，并在服务时重建表。我们仅根据其他推测方式来衡量 TableTune。在 H100 上，调谐台在五种牵伸器设置中的四种（第五种为 88%）中的每种负载下提供最佳固定牵伸长度吞吐量的至少 94%，而操作员无需知道具体长度。相对于在同一台发动机上重新实现 TurboSpec 和 Nightjar 式控制，其最坏情况下的损失永远不会高于它们的损失，而使用 EAGLE-3 牵伸机时，其损失为 3%、9% 和 12%。在专家混合模型上，vLLM 的记录表损失高达 18%，而调整表最多损失 3%。从错误调整的表开始，控制器将吞吐量提高了高达 58%（在 vLLM 的默认运行器上高达 45%），并且在使用 DFlash 起草器进行工作负载切换后，它恢复了过时表损失的 96%。在 llm-d 出厂时的优化基线部署中，四个 GPU 上有两个 Qwen3-32B 副本，调整后的表比固定草稿长度 3 快 32%，比高负载下 vLLM 的记录表快 25%，并且控制器将记录表的吞吐量提高了 29%。

papers.title: FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving
papers.summary: KV cache reuse accelerates LLM serving, but existing systems manage host DRAM and NVMe SSD as a tiered hierarchy where DRAM acts as an intermediate cache. Production LLM workloads break both premises of this hierarchy. First, bimodal reuse defeats DRAM temporal filtering, since workloads are dominated either by one-shot blocks with long reuse distances or by multi-gigabyte agentic sessions that exceed DRAM capacity, putting SSD on the critical read path. Second, DRAM staging and eviction-ordered layout bottleneck SSD restoration. Holding host staging buffers for in-flight prefixes causes contention under load that aborts prefetches, while incremental eviction scatters a session's blocks across the SSD and prevents large sequential reads. We present FlatCake, a flat KV storage architecture that exposes host DRAM and NVMe SSD as peer media in a unified 64-bit address space. Exploiting the fact that KV blocks are write-once, immutable, and reused at session scope, FlatCake places each block directly onto its target medium in session-contiguous, layer-major order at creation time and never migrates it. FlatCake streams coalesced SSD reads directly into a bounded GPU window via GPUDirect Storage and decouples DRAM and SSD request queues to prevent head-of-line blocking. On a production Claude Code trace with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, FlatCake sustains a 94% cache hit rate as load increases (versus 64% for Mooncake), eliminates Mooncake's $6.5\times$--$6.7\times$ SSD read amplification, and reduces peak-load mean TTFT by $1.6\times$ while improving total token throughput by $1.6\times$. Across 8K--128K contexts on Llama-3.1-70B, FlatCake further reduces mean TTFT by up to $2.4\times$ over Mooncake and $1.8\times$ over Mooncake-GDS.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，工程贡献强，但证据广度仍待加强。
pros: 提出“扁平KV存储+统一地址空间”直击分层缓存失效痛点
系统设计与实现细节完整，端到端收益在真实生产轨迹上较显著
cons: 评测主要对比Mooncake系，跨系统基线与消融充分性仍不足
结论依赖特定工作负载与硬件栈，通用性和可复现性风险未完全消除

papers.title_zh: FlatCake：用于 LLM 服务的扁平 KVCache 存储架构
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存重用可加速 LLM 服务，但现有系统将主机 DRAM 和 NVMe SSD 作为分层结构进行管理，其中 DRAM 充当中间缓存。生产 LLM 工作负载打破了这种层次结构的两个前提。首先，双模式重用击败了 DRAM 时间过滤，因为工作负载要么由具有长重用距离的一次性块主导，要么由超过 DRAM 容量的多 GB 代理会话主导，从而将 SSD 置于关键读取路径上。其次，DRAM 分级和驱逐顺序布局瓶颈 SSD 恢复。为运行中的前缀保留主机暂存缓冲区会导致负载下的争用，从而中止预取，而增量逐出会将会话的块分散在 SSD 上并阻止大量顺序读取。我们推出了 FlatCake，这是一种扁平 KV 存储架构，它将主机 DRAM 和 NVMe SSD 作为统一的 64 位地址空间中的对等介质公开。利用 KV 块一次性写入、不可变且在会话范围内重用的事实，FlatCake 在创建时以会话连续、层主顺序将每个块直接放置到其目标介质上，并且从不迁移它。 FlatCake 通过 GPUDirect Storage 将合并的 SSD 读取直接流式传输到有界 GPU 窗口中，并解耦 DRAM 和 SSD 请求队列以防止队头阻塞。在使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的生产 Claude 代码跟踪中，随着负载增加，FlatCake 维持了 94% 的缓存命中率（而 Mooncake 为 64%），消除了 Mooncake 的 $6.5\times$--$6.7\times$ SSD 读取放大，并将峰值负载平均 TTFT 降低了 $1.6\times$，同时将总令牌吞吐量提高了 $1.6\times$。在 Llama-3.1-70B 上的 8K--128K 上下文中，FlatCake 比 Mooncake 进一步降低了平均 TTFT 高达 2.4\times$，比 Mooncake-GDS 降低了 1.8\times$。

papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
papers.summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但泛化证据仍需更强。
pros: 提出将MTP梯度精确分解并恢复KL有效梯度，机制解释清晰且有理论味道
方法工程代价极低（近一行改动、无额外参数/开销）且在多尺度报告了稳定收益
cons: 证据主要来自中小规模（至1.2B）与特定设置，缺少更大模型、更多数据配方及长程下游任务的独立验证

papers.title_zh: 正确完成多令牌预测
papers.summary_zh: 多标记预测 (MTP) 现在是语言模型预训练中的常见成分，因为它提高了下游性能并通过推测解码实现更快的推理。我们发现了标准 MTP 训练中的一个缺陷，其中 MTP 梯度的残余分量会干扰下一个令牌和多令牌学习，并且随着规模的增加，这种情况越来越严重。具体来说，MTP 交叉熵梯度可以精确地分解为 KL 自蒸馏项，该项将每个 MTP 头拉向模型自己的下一个令牌预测 (NTP) 分布并改进推测解码，以及具有低信噪比并掩盖有用 KL 信号的残差。我们介绍了 KL 梯度恢复技巧：当两个分布共享一个线性输出头时，可以通过直通梯度路由组合它们的交叉熵梯度来精确恢复它们的 KL 散度的梯度。与直接最小化 KL 不同，此技巧不需要词汇大小的 Logit 矩阵，并且与标准融合交叉熵内核兼容。这使得软多令牌预测（Soft-MTP）成为可能，这是对 MTP 的一行代码更改，通过重用现有的 NTP 和 MTP 交叉熵计算来消除噪声残差并仅反向传播 KL 自蒸馏信号。 Soft-MTP 支持 DeepSeek 和 Meta 风格的 MTP，不添加任何参数，并且不会产生可测量的开销。从 167M 到 1.2B 参数，Soft-MTP 相对于标准 MTP 进行了改进，具有更低的 NTP 困惑度、更快的推测解码和更高的每个尺度的零样本精度、从 689M 开始更低的 MTP 困惑度以及在 1.2B 微调后更强的数学和代码推理。 Soft-MTP 在大多数指标上也匹配（如果不是超过的话）直接 KL 散度最小化。Soft-MTP 实际上是 MTP 优化的免费午餐。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP 找到。

papers.title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
papers.summary: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches ( 1.09-1.14$\times$) and E5M2 caches (1.25-1.30$\times$). On NVIDIA DGX Spark, GAAC accelerates decode attention at a 64K-token context by 1.19-1.27$\times$ and end-to-end W4A16 decode steps by 1.04-1.15$\times$. In serving, it reduces resident KV memory by approximately 26% and increases aggregate throughput by 13-29% under comparable KV-memory budgets. On Apple M4, GAAC achieves 1.02-1.25$\times$ attention speedups, demonstrating portability beyond NVIDIA GPUs. Code is available at https://github.com/Intelligent-Microsystems-Lab/GAAC.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值明显，但方法新颖性中等且证据仍需加强
pros: 聚焦KV缓存瓶颈，提出无损压缩并结合在线重构，系统设计完整
跨模型与跨硬件给出吞吐和时延收益，兼顾实用性与可移植性
cons: 压缩率提升幅度有限，核心思想主要依赖指数冗余编码，新颖性边际不高
摘要未体现充分消融与统计显著性分析，收益稳定性与边界条件仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: GAAC：无损 KV 压缩，在个人设备上实现带宽高效的 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 仅权重、有损量化大大降低了服务大型语言模型 (LLM) 的存储和内存需求，但不断增长的键值 (KV) 缓存仍然是个人设备上长上下文推理的瓶颈。我们提出了组自适应加法编解码器（GAAC），这是一种无损 KV 压缩和服务系统，它利用指数冗余来减少存储并加速注意力，而无需引入 KV 近似。 GAAC 在连续范围内使用校准的每通道基数加偏移代码对 BF16 指数进行编码。 GAAC 可以跨小组调整代码宽度，同时逐位保留 KV 值。融合注意力内核动态重建 KV 切片，避免全缓存解压缩。块式压缩和固定容量插槽支持增量缓存更新和分页服务。在五个测试模型中，GAAC 实现了 1.405-1.407$\times$ 无损 BF16 KV 压缩。我们还研究了低精度张量 FP8 E4M3 缓存（1.09-1.14$\times$）和 E5M2 缓存（1.25-1.30$\times$）的压缩性能。在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上，GAAC 将 64K 令牌上下文中的解码注意力加速了 1.19-1.27$\times$，将端到端 W4A16 解码步骤加速了 1.04-1.15$\times$。在服务方面，在相当的 KV 内存预算下，它减少了约 26% 的驻留 KV 内存，并将总吞吐量提高了 13-29%。在 Apple M4 上，GAAC 实现了 1.02-1.25$\times$ 注意力加速，展示了超越 NVIDIA GPU 的可移植性。
